papers.title: MUSA-PINN: Multi-scale Weak-form Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Fluid Flow in Complex Geometries
papers.abstract_en: While Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) offer a mesh-free approach to solving fluid-flow PDEs, standard point-wise residual minimization suffers from convergence pathologies in topologically complex domains like Triply Periodic Minimal Surfaces (TPMS). The locality bias of point-wise constraints fails to propagate global information through tortuous channels, causing unstable gradients and conservation violations. To address this, we propose the Multi-scale Weak-form PINN (MUSA-PINN), which reformulates Navier-Stokes equation constraints as integral conservation laws over hierarchical spherical control volumes. We enforce continuity and momentum conservation via flux-balance residuals on control surfaces. Our method utilizes a three-scale subdomain strategy-comprising large volumes for long-range coupling, skeleton-aware meso-scale volumes aligned with transport pathways, and small volumes for local refinement-alongside a two-stage training schedule prioritizing continuity. Experiments on steady incompressible flow in TPMS geometries show MUSA-PINN outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing relative errors by up to 93% and preserving mass conservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MUSA-PINN，一种多尺度弱形式物理信息神经网络，用于复杂几何中的流体流动。通过将Navier-Stokes方程约束重新表述为层次球体控制体积上的积分守恒律，并采用三尺度子域策略和两阶段训练，在TPMS几何中的稳态不可压缩流动实验中，相比基线减少相对误差达93%，并保持质量守恒。
Motivation: 标准PINN在拓扑复杂域（如三周期极小曲面）中因点式残差最小化的局部性偏差导致收敛困难、梯度不稳定和守恒违反。
Method: 提出多尺度弱形式PINN（MUSA-PINN），将Navier-Stokes方程约束重构为层次球体控制体积上的积分守恒律，通过控制面上的通量平衡残差强制连续性和动量守恒。采用三尺度子域策略（大体积长程耦合、骨架感知中尺度体积对齐传输路径、小体积局部细化）以及优先连续性的两阶段训练。
Result: 在TPMS几何中的稳态不可压缩流动实验中，MUSA-PINN相比最先进基线减少相对误差高达93%，并保持质量守恒。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了多尺度弱形式能有效解决复杂几何中PINN的收敛和守恒问题，但未讨论局限或未来工作。

papers.title: Understanding Sources of Demographic Predictability in Brain MRI via Disentangling Anatomy and Contrast
authors: Jorge Cardoso (and for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative)
papers.abstract_en: Demographic attributes can be predicted from medical images, raising concerns about bias in clinical AI systems. In X-ray imaging, acquisition characteristics have been shown to contribute substantially to this predictability. Whether the same holds in brain MRI remains unclear, as anatomical variation and acquisition-dependent contrast are deeply entangled in the image formation process, obscuring the origins of demographic signal. To address this, we propose a controlled framework based on disentangled representation learning, decomposing brain MRI into anatomy-focused representations that suppress acquisition influence and contrast embeddings that capture acquisition-dependent characteristics. Training predictive models for age, sex, and race on full images, anatomical representations, and contrast embeddings allows us to quantify the relative contributions of structure and acquisition to the demographic signal. Across three datasets and multiple MRI sequences, demographic predictability is found to be driven primarily by anatomical variation, with anatomy-focused representations largely preserving the performance of models trained on raw images. Contrast embeddings retain a weaker signal that is dataset-specific and does not generalise across sites. These findings suggest that effective mitigation must explicitly account for the primarily anatomical and secondarily acquisition-dependent origins of demographic signal, ensuring that any bias reduction generalizes robustly across domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究脑MRI中人口统计属性（年龄、性别、种族）可预测性的来源，通过解耦表示学习将图像分解为解剖表示和对比度嵌入，发现可预测性主要由解剖变异驱动，对比度嵌入仅贡献弱且数据集特定的信号，且不跨站点泛化。
Motivation: 脑MRI中人口统计信号可被预测，引发临床AI偏差担忧。与X光不同，脑MRI中解剖变异与采集依赖的对比度深度纠缠，其来源尚不明确，需定量分离二者贡献。
Method: 提出基于解耦表示学习的可控框架，将脑MRI分解为抑制采集影响的解剖表示和捕获采集依赖的对比度嵌入，再分别训练预测模型以量化结构（anatomy）与采集（contrast）对人口统计信号的贡献。
Result: 在三个数据集及多种MRI序列上，人口统计可预测性主要由解剖变异驱动，解剖表示几乎保持原始图像的预测性能；对比度嵌入呈现弱信号，且具有数据集特异性，无法跨站点泛化。
Conclusion: 偏差缓解策略需明确考虑人口统计信号主要源于解剖结构、次要源于采集依赖特征，以确保偏置减少方法能跨域稳健泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Understanding LoRA as Knowledge Memory: An Empirical Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Continuous knowledge updating for pre-trained large language models (LLMs) is increasingly necessary yet remains challenging. Although inference-time methods like In-Context Learning (ICL) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) are popular, they face constraints in context budgets, costs, and retrieval fragmentation. Departing from these context-dependent paradigms, this work investigates a parametric approach using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) as a modular knowledge memory. Although few recent works examine this concept, the fundamental mechanics governing its capacity and composability remain largely unexplored. We bridge this gap through the first systematic empirical study mapping the design space of LoRA-based memory, ranging from characterizing storage capacity and optimizing internalization to scaling multi-module systems and evaluating long-context reasoning. Rather than proposing a single architecture, we provide practical guidance on the operational boundaries of LoRA memory. Overall, our findings position LoRA as the complementary axis of memory alongside RAG and ICL, offering distinct advantages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过系统实证研究，探索将LoRA（Low-Rank Adaptation）作为模块化知识记忆（knowledge memory）的机制，分析其存储容量、优化内化、多模块扩展及长上下文推理等设计空间，而非提出单一架构。结果表明LoRA可作为RAG和ICL之外的互补记忆轴，具有实际优势。
Motivation: 现有知识更新方法如ICL和RAG受限于上下文预算、成本和检索碎片化，而基于参数化的LoRA记忆虽被初步探索，但其容量和组合性的基本机制尚不清楚。
Method: 对LoRA记忆的设计空间进行首次系统性实证研究，包括存储容量表征、内化优化、多模块系统缩放和长上下文推理评估。
Result: 提供了LoRA记忆操作边界的实践指导，指出LoRA可作为RAG和ICL的互补记忆轴。
Conclusion: LoRA记忆在参数化知识更新中具有独特优势，但具体性能数据未在摘要中给出，研究重点在于设计空间探索而非单一架构。

papers.title: 1D-Bench: A Benchmark for Iterative UI Code Generation with Visual Feedback in Real-World
papers.abstract_en: Design-to-code translates high-fidelity UI designs into executable front-end implementations, but progress remains hard to compare due to inconsistent datasets, toolchains, and evaluation protocols. We introduce 1D-Bench, a benchmark grounded in real e-commerce workflows, where each instance provides a reference rendering and an exported intermediate representation that may contain extraction errors. 1D is short for one day, representing the efficient completion of design-to-code tasks in less than one day. Models take both as input, using the intermediate representation as structural cues while being evaluated against the reference rendering, which tests robustness to intermediate representation defects rather than literal adherence. 1D-Bench requires generating an executable React codebase under a fixed toolchain with an explicit component hierarchy, and defines a multi-round setting in which models iteratively apply component-level edits using execution feedback. Experiments on commercial and open-weight multimodal models show that iterative editing generally improves final performance by increasing rendering success and often improving visual similarity. We further conduct a pilot study on post-training with synthetic repair trajectories and reinforcement learning based editing, and observe limited and unstable gains that may stem from sparse terminal rewards and high-variance file-level updates. The data and scripts used in this study are available in an anonymized repository at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/d2c-benchmark-A9C4/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出1D-Bench，一个基于真实电商工作流的UI代码生成基准。每个实例提供参考渲染图和可能含提取错误的中间表示，要求模型生成可执行的React代码库，并支持多轮迭代编辑。实验表明迭代编辑能提升渲染成功率和视觉相似度，但基于强化学习的后训练效果有限且不稳定。
Motivation: 当前设计到代码的进展难以比较，因为存在不一致的数据集、工具链和评估协议。需要统一的基准来评估模型在真实场景中的鲁棒性。
Method: 1D-Bench使用真实电商工作流中的参考渲染图和中间表示（可能含错误），要求生成React代码库并定义多轮迭代编辑设置，模型基于执行反馈进行组件级编辑。
Result: 实验显示迭代编辑普遍提升最终性能，提高渲染成功率并改善视觉相似度。后训练（合成修复轨迹和强化学习编辑）仅带来有限且不稳定的收益。
Conclusion: 1D-Bench是一个具有挑战性的基准，强调了处理中间表示缺陷和迭代改进的重要性，但强化学习后训练效果有限，可能源于稀疏终端奖励和高方差文件级更新。

summary_sections.motivation: 当前设计到代码的进展难以比较，因为存在不一致的数据集、工具链和评估协议。需要统一的基准来评估模型在真实场景中的鲁棒性。
summary_sections.method: 1D-Bench使用真实电商工作流中的参考渲染图和中间表示（可能含错误），要求生成React代码库并定义多轮迭代编辑设置，模型基于执行反馈进行组件级编辑。
summary_sections.result: 实验显示迭代编辑普遍提升最终性能，提高渲染成功率并改善视觉相似度。后训练（合成修复轨迹和强化学习编辑）仅带来有限且不稳定的收益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 1D-Bench是一个具有挑战性的基准，强调了处理中间表示缺陷和迭代改进的重要性，但强化学习后训练效果有限，可能源于稀疏终端奖励和高方差文件级更新。

papers.title: Assessing Ionospheric Scintillation Risk for Direct-to-Cellular Satellite Communications using Frequency-Scaled GNSS Observations
papers.abstract_en: One of the key issues facing Direct-to-Cellular (D2C) satellite communication systems is ionospheric scintillation on the uplink and downlink, which can significantly degrade link quality. This work investigates the spatial and temporal characteristics of amplitude scintillation at D2C frequencies by scaling L-band scintillation observations from Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) receivers to bands relevant to D2C operation, including the low-band, and 3GPP's N255 and N256. These observations are then compared to scaled radio-occultation scintillation observations from the FORMOSAT-7/COSMIC-2 (F7/C2) mission, which can be used in regions that do not possess ground-based scintillation monitoring stations. As a proof of concept, five years of ground-based GNSS scintillation data from Sharjah, United Arab Emirates, together with two years of F7/C2 observations over the same region, corresponding to the ascending phase of Solar Cycle 25, are analyzed. Both space-based and ground-based observations indicate a pronounced diurnal scintillation peak between 20--22 local time, particularly during the equinoxes, with occurrence rates increasing with solar activity. Ground-based observations also reveal a strong azimuth dependence, with most scintillation events occurring on southward satellite links. The scintillation occurrence rate at the low-band is more than twice that observed at N255 and N256, highlighting the increased robustness of higher D2C bands to ionospheric scintillation. These results demonstrate how GNSS scintillation observations can be leveraged to characterize and anticipate scintillation-induced D2C link impairments, which help in D2C system design and the implementation of scintillation mitigation strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过将GNSS L波段振幅闪烁观测缩放至D2C频段（低波段、N255、N256），分析了电离层闪烁对直接到蜂窝(D2C)卫星通信的影响。基于阿联酋沙迦五年地面数据和FORMOSAT-7/COSMIC-2两年掩星数据的分析表明，闪烁在地方时20-22时和分点季节达到峰值，且随太阳活动增加；低波段闪烁发生率为N255/N256的两倍以上。研究展示了利用GNSS闪烁观测评估D2C链路风险并指导系统设计的可行性。
Motivation: 电离层闪烁会严重降低D2C卫星通信的上下行链路质量，但针对D2C频段（尤其是低波段及3GPP N255/N256）的闪烁特性研究不足，缺乏利用现有GNSS观测进行风险评估的方法。
Method: 将地面GNSS接收机和F7/C2掩星任务L波段振幅闪烁观测通过频率缩放至D2C相关频段，并对比分析五年地面数据与两年掩星数据中闪烁的空间时间分布特征。
Result: 地面与空间观测均揭示闪烁在20-22 LT和分点季节显著，随太阳活动增强；地面数据显示强方位依赖性（多数发生在南向链路）；低波段闪烁发生率高出N255/N256一倍以上。
Conclusion: GNSS闪烁观测可有效表征和预测D2C链路干扰，有助于系统设计及闪烁缓解策略的实施。

papers.title: Calculating Mutual Information between a Reward Maximizer and its Environment
papers.abstract_en: An important question in the field of AI is the extent to which successful behaviour requires an internal representation of the world. In this work, we quantify the amount of information an optimal policy provides about the underlying environment. We consider a Controlled Markov Process (CMP) with $n$ states and $m$ actions, assuming a uniform prior over the space of possible transition dynamics. We prove that observing a deterministic policy that is optimal for any non-constant reward function then conveys exactly $n \log m$ bits of information about the environment. Specifically, we show that the mutual information between the environment and the optimal policy is $n \log m$ bits. This bound holds across a broad class of objectives, including finite-horizon, infinite-horizon discounted, and time-averaged reward maximization. These findings provide a precise information-theoretic lower bound on the ``implicit world model'' necessary for optimality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在受控马尔可夫过程（CMP）框架下，量化了最优策略关于环境的信息量。假设转移动力学空间上的均匀先验，证明对于任何非常数奖励函数的最优确定性策略，其与环境之间的互信息恰好为 n log m 比特，其中 n 是状态数，m 是动作数。该下界对有限步、折扣和平均奖励最大化目标均成立。
Motivation: 人工智能领域一个重要问题是：成功行为是否需要世界内部表征？本文旨在从信息论角度提供精确的下界。
Method: 考虑一个具有 n 个状态和 m 个动作的受控马尔可夫过程，假设转移动力学空间上的均匀先验。分析非常数奖励函数下的最优确定性策略，计算策略与环境之间的互信息。
Result: 证明最优确定性策略与环境之间的互信息为 n log m 比特，适用于有限步、无限步折扣和时间平均奖励最大化等目标。
Conclusion: 给出了最优性所需的“隐式世界模型”的信息论下界，表明策略必须编码大量环境信息才能达到最优。

papers.title: SQuTR: A Robustness Benchmark for Spoken Query to Text Retrieval under Acoustic Noise
papers.abstract_en: Spoken query retrieval is an important interaction mode in modern information retrieval. However, existing evaluation datasets are often limited to simple queries under constrained noise conditions, making them inadequate for assessing the robustness of spoken query retrieval systems under complex acoustic perturbations. To address this limitation, we present SQuTR, a robustness benchmark for spoken query retrieval that includes a large-scale dataset and a unified evaluation protocol. SQuTR aggregates 37,317 unique queries from six commonly used English and Chinese text retrieval datasets, spanning multiple domains and diverse query types. We synthesize speech using voice profiles from 200 real speakers and mix 17 categories of real-world environmental noise under controlled SNR levels, enabling reproducible robustness evaluation from quiet to highly noisy conditions. Under the unified protocol, we conduct large-scale evaluations on representative cascaded and end-to-end retrieval systems. Experimental results show that retrieval performance decreases as noise increases, with substantially different drops across systems. Even large-scale retrieval models struggle under extreme noise, indicating that robustness remains a critical bottleneck. Overall, SQuTR provides a reproducible testbed for benchmarking and diagnostic analysis, and facilitates future research on robustness in spoken query to text retrieval.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 49th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR '26), July 20--24, 2026, Melbourne, VIC, Australia
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SQuTR，一个用于口语查询到文本检索（spoken query to text retrieval）鲁棒性评估的基准，包含大规模数据集（37,317条独特查询，来自6个英语和中文数据集）和统一评估协议。通过200名真实说话人的语音合成与17类环境噪声混合，在可控SNR下测试级联和端到端检索系统，发现噪声显著降低性能，且不同系统下降幅度差异大，大规模模型在极端噪声下仍表现不佳。
Motivation: 现有评估数据集局限于简单查询和有限噪声条件，无法充分评估复杂声学扰动下口语查询检索系统的鲁棒性。
Method: 构建SQuTR：聚合6个常用文本检索数据集的37,317条查询，使用200个真实说话人语音合成，混合17类真实环境噪声并控制SNR水平，提供统一评估协议。
Result: 大规模实验表明检索性能随噪声增加而下降，不同系统下降幅度差异显著；即使在极端噪声下，大规模检索模型也表现困难，鲁棒性仍是关键瓶颈。
Conclusion: SQuTR作为可重复的基准测试平台，有助于诊断分析并推动口语查询到文本检索鲁棒性的未来研究。

papers.title: Egocentric Bias in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual perspective taking--inferring how the world appears from another's viewpoint--is foundational to social cognition. We introduce FlipSet, a diagnostic benchmark for Level-2 visual perspective taking (L2 VPT) in vision-language models. The task requires simulating 180-degree rotations of 2D character strings from another agent's perspective, isolating spatial transformation from 3D scene complexity. Evaluating 103 VLMs reveals systematic egocentric bias: the vast majority perform below chance, with roughly three-quarters of errors reproducing the camera viewpoint. Control experiments expose a compositional deficit--models achieve high theory-of-mind accuracy and above-chance mental rotation in isolation, yet fail catastrophically when integration is required. This dissociation indicates that current VLMs lack the mechanisms needed to bind social awareness to spatial operations, suggesting fundamental limitations in model-based spatial reasoning. FlipSet provides a cognitively grounded testbed for diagnosing perspective-taking capabilities in multimodal systems.
papers.comment: Accepted at CogSci 2026 (Best Undergraduate Student Paper)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlipSet基准，用于评估视觉语言模型的二级视觉观点采择（L2 VPT）能力。通过要求模型从他人视角模拟2D字符串的180度旋转，测试了103个模型，发现大多数模型表现低于随机水平，且错误大多重现了摄像机视角，表明系统性的自我中心偏见。控制实验显示模型在单独的社会认知或空间推理上表现尚可，但无法将其整合，揭示了当前VLM在空间推理上的根本局限。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在视觉观点采择方面缺乏系统性评估，且现有模型表现出的自我中心偏见未被充分诊断。
Method: 提出了FlipSet基准，通过180度旋转2D字符串的任务隔离空间变换与3D场景复杂性，专门测试二级视觉观点采择能力。
Result: 103个视觉语言模型中绝大多数表现低于随机水平，约四分之三的错误重复了摄像机视角；控制实验表明模型在单独的心智推理和空间旋转任务上表现较好，但整合时失败，呈现组合性缺陷。
Conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型缺乏将社会意识与空间操作结合的机制，在基于模型的空间推理上存在根本局限。

papers.title: DECO: Decoupled Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation with a Plugin Tactile Adapter
papers.abstract_en: Bimanual dexterous manipulation relies on integrating multimodal inputs to perform complex real-world tasks. To address the challenges of effectively combining these modalities, we propose DECO, a decoupled multimodal diffusion transformer that disentangles vision, proprioception, and tactile signals through specialized conditioning pathways, enabling structured and controllable integration of multimodal inputs, with a lightweight adapter for parameter-efficient injection of additional signals. Alongside DECO, we release DECO-50 dataset for bimanual dexterous manipulation with tactile sensing, consisting of 50 hours of data and over 5M frames, collected via teleoperation on real dual-arm robots. We train DECO on DECO-50 and conduct extensive real-world evaluation with over 2,000 robot rollouts. Experimental results show that DECO achieves the best performance across all tasks, with a 72.25% average success rate and a 21% improvement over the baseline. Moreover, the tactile adapter brings an additional 10.25% average success rate across all tasks and a 20% gain on complex contact-rich tasks while tuning less than 10% of the model parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DECO，一种解耦多模态扩散变压器，用于双臂灵巧操作。它通过专用条件路径分离视觉、本体感觉和触觉信号，并引入轻量级触觉适配器以参数高效方式注入额外信息。同时发布 DECO-50 数据集，包含 50 小时、超过 500 万帧的真实双臂灵巧操作数据。实验表明，DECO 在超过 2000 次实际机器人 rollout 中平均成功率达 72.25%，比基线提升 21%；触觉适配器额外带来 10.25% 的平均成功率提升，在复杂接触任务上提升 20%，且仅调整不到 10% 的模型参数。
Motivation: 双臂灵巧操作依赖于多模态输入的整合，但现有方法难以有效结合视觉、本体感觉和触觉等不同模态信号。
Method: 提出解耦多模态扩散变压器（DECO），通过专用条件路径分别处理视觉、本体感觉和触觉信号，实现结构化、可控的多模态融合。同时设计轻量级触觉适配器，以参数高效的方式注入触觉信息。
Result: 在 DECO-50 数据集上训练，经 2000 余次真实机器人 rollout 验证，平均成功率为 72.25%，较基线提升 21%；触觉适配器额外带来 10.25% 的平均成功率提升，在复杂接触任务上提升 20%，且仅微调不到 10% 的模型参数。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，解耦多模态条件注入与轻量适配器可显著提升双臂灵巧操作的多模态融合效率。数据集与模型将开源。

papers.title: Hierarchical Latent Structures in Data Generation Process Unify Mechanistic Phenomena across Scale
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary studies in mechanistic interpretability have uncovered many puzzling phenomena in the neural information processing of Transformer-based language models, such as induction heads, function vectors, and the Hydra effect. Some of these individual phenomena have been independently tied to different data distributional properties, while some have been loosely associated with model architecture and how Transformers process information. However, a unified understanding of the relationship between data, model architecture, and optimization remains lacking, failing to answer the fundamental question: why do these three phenomena appear universally across different model families and scales, despite their seeming disconnect? In this work, we answer this question by unifying these three phenomena as consequences of hierarchical latent structures in the data generation process, coupled with decorrelated gradients across additive model components and directional concavity in the representation geometry. We validate our theoretical results in a toy model regime and in a large-scale synthetic data regime, comparing them with language models trained on natural language data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，将Transformer语言模型中的induction heads、function vectors和Hydra效应三种现象解释为数据生成过程中层级潜在结构、去相关梯度与表示几何方向凹性的共同结果。在玩具模型和大规模合成数据上验证了理论，并与自然语言训练的模型进行对比。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对Transformer中多种机理现象（如induction heads、function vectors、Hydra效应）的统一理解，无法回答它们为何跨模型与规模普遍出现。
Method: 从数据生成过程的层级潜在结构出发，结合去相关的梯度与表示几何的方向凹性，建立统一的理论框架，并在玩具模型和合成数据上验证。
Result: 理论表明这些现象是前述三个因素的必然结果，实验支持了理论预测。
Conclusion: 数据中的层级潜在结构是驱动这些机理现象的关键，为理解Transformer内部信息处理提供了统一视角。

papers.title: PluRel: Synthetic Data unlocks Scaling Laws for Relational Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Relational Foundation Models (RFMs) facilitate data-driven decision-making by learning from complex multi-table databases. However, the diverse relational databases needed to train such models are rarely public due to privacy constraints. While there are methods to generate synthetic tabular data of arbitrary size, incorporating schema structure and primary-foreign key connectivity for multi-table generation remains challenging. Here we introduce PLUREL, a framework to synthesize multi-tabular relational databases from scratch. In a step-by-step fashion, PLUREL models (1) schemas with directed graphs, (2) inter-table primary-foreign key connectivity with bipartite graphs, and, (3) feature distributions in tables via conditional causal mechanisms. The design space across these stages supports the synthesis of a wide range of diverse databases, while being computationally lightweight. Using PLUREL, we observe for the first time that (1) RFM pretraining loss exhibits power-law scaling with the number of synthetic databases and total pretraining tokens, (2) scaling the number of synthetic databases improves generalization to real databases, and (3) synthetic pretraining yields strong base models for continued pretraining on real databases. Overall, our framework and results position synthetic data scaling as a promising paradigm for RFMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PLUREL框架，用于从零开始合成多表关系数据库，以支持关系基础模型（RFM）的训练。通过分步建模模式、主外键连接和特征分布，PLUREL能生成多样化的数据库，且计算轻量。实验首次观察到RFM预训练损失与合成数据库数量和预训练token呈幂律缩放，合成数据规模扩展能提升在真实数据库上的泛化性能。
Motivation: 关系基础模型需要大量多样的关系数据库进行训练，但由于隐私限制，真实数据库很少公开。现有合成表格数据方法难以处理多表结构和主外键连接。
Method: 提出PLUREL框架，分三步合成多表关系数据库：(1)用有向图建模模式；(2)用二分图建模跨表主外键连接；(3)通过条件因果机制建模表中的特征分布。设计空间支持生成多样化数据库，计算开销低。
Result: 实验首次发现：(1)RFM预训练损失随合成数据库数量和预训练token数量呈幂律缩放；(2)增加合成数据库数量能改善在真实数据库上的泛化性能；(3)合成预训练能为真实数据库上的继续预训练提供良好基模型。
Conclusion: 框架和结果表明合成数据缩放是关系基础模型的一个有前景的范式。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Entropy-Preserving Supervised Fine-Tuning via Adaptive Self-Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: The standard post-training recipe for large reasoning models, supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning (SFT-then-RL), may limit the benefits of the RL stage: while SFT imitates expert demonstrations, it often causes overconfidence and reduces generation diversity, leaving RL with a narrowed solution space to explore. Adding entropy regularization during SFT is not a cure-all; it tends to flatten token distributions toward uniformity, increasing entropy without improving meaningful exploration capability. In this paper, we propose CurioSFT, an entropy-preserving SFT method designed to enhance exploration capabilities through intrinsic curiosity. It consists of (a) Self-Exploratory Distillation, which distills the model toward a self-generated, temperature-scaled teacher to encourage exploration within its capability; and (b) Entropy-Guided Temperature Selection, which adaptively adjusts distillation strength to mitigate knowledge forgetting by amplifying exploration at reasoning tokens while stabilizing factual tokens. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning tasks demonstrate that, in SFT stage, CurioSFT outperforms the vanilla SFT by 2.5 points on in-distribution tasks and 2.9 points on out-of-distribution tasks. We also verify that exploration capabilities preserved during SFT successfully translate into concrete gains in RL stage, yielding an average improvement of 5.0 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CurioSFT，一种熵保持的有监督微调方法，通过自适应自蒸馏增强大推理模型的探索能力。在数学推理任务上，CurioSFT 在分布内任务上比标准 SFT 提升 2.5 个点，分布外任务提升 2.9 个点，且在后续强化学习阶段平均提升 5.0 个点。
Motivation: 标准 SFT 容易导致模型过于自信、生成多样性降低，削弱后续强化学习的探索空间；直接添加熵正则化又会使分布过于均匀，无益于有意义的探索。
Method: 该方法包括两部分：(a) 自探索蒸馏，通过温度缩放的教师分布引导模型在能力范围内探索；(b) 熵引导温度选择，自适应调整蒸馏强度，在推理token上增强探索、在事实token上保持稳定。
Result: 在数学推理任务上，CurioSFT 在分布内任务比标准 SFT 高 2.5 分，分布外任务高 2.9 分；后续强化学习阶段平均提升 5.0 分。
Conclusion: CurioSFT 能在 SFT 阶段保留探索能力，并转化为 RL 阶段的增益，优于标准 SFT 和熵正则化。

papers.title: Where Not to Learn: Prior-Aligned Training with Subset-based Attribution Constraints for Reliable Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Reliable models should not only predict correctly, but also justify decisions with acceptable evidence. Yet conventional supervised learning typically provides only class-level labels, allowing models to achieve high accuracy through shortcut correlations rather than the intended evidence. Human priors can help constrain such behavior, but aligning models to these priors remains challenging because learned representations often diverge from human perception. To address this challenge, we propose an attribution-based human prior alignment method. We encode human priors as input regions that the model is expected to rely on (e.g., bounding boxes), and leverage a highly faithful subset-selection-based attribution approach to expose the model's decision evidence during training. When the attribution region deviates substantially from the prior regions, we penalize reliance on off-prior evidence, encouraging the model to shift its attribution toward the intended regions. This is achieved through a training objective that imposes attribution constraints induced by the human prior. We validate our method on both image classification and click decision tasks in MLLM-based GUI agent models. Across conventional classification and autoregressive generation settings, human prior alignment consistently improves task accuracy while also enhancing the model's decision reasonability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于归因的人类先验对齐方法，通过子集选择归因技术暴露模型的决策证据，并在训练中对偏离先验区域的归因进行惩罚，从而引导模型依赖正确的证据区域。在图像分类和MLLM-based GUI代理模型的点击决策任务上，该方法提升了任务准确性和决策合理性。
Motivation: 传统监督学习仅提供类别标签，模型易通过捷径相关性达到高准确率而非依赖预期证据；人类先验有助于约束模型行为，但表示学习常偏离人类感知，使对齐困难。
Method: 将人类先验编码为模型应依赖的输入区域（如边界框），利用高保真的子集选择归因方法在训练中暴露决策证据；当归因区域与先验区域偏差大时，惩罚对非先验证据的依赖，通过包含归因约束的训练目标实现对齐。
Result: 在图像分类和MLLM-based GUI代理模型的点击决策任务上，人类先验对齐一致提升了任务准确性和决策合理性。
Conclusion: 该方法能有效将人类先验融入模型训练，改善模型决策的证据可信度，适用于传统分类和自回归生成场景。

papers.title: Tracking Drift: Variation-Aware Entropy Scheduling for Non-Stationary Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Real-world reinforcement learning often faces environment drift, but most existing methods rely on static entropy coefficients/target entropy, causing over-exploration during stable periods and under-exploration after drift, and leaving unanswered the principled question of how exploration intensity should scale with drift magnitude. We show that, under standard assumptions, entropy scheduling in non-stationary maximum-entropy RL can be cast as the dynamic-regret trade-off between tracking a drifting comparator and stabilizing updates, yielding a square-root scaling rule for the entropy weight in terms of a online non-stationarity proxy. Building on this, we propose AES--Adaptive Entropy Scheduling--which adaptively adjusts the entropy coefficient/temperature online using observable drift proxies during training, requiring almost no structural changes and incurring minimal overhead. Across 4 algorithm variants, 12 tasks, and 4 drift modes, AES significantly reduces the fraction of performance degradation caused by drift and accelerates recovery after abrupt changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非平稳强化学习中环境漂移导致的探索策略失效问题，提出自适应熵调度方法（AES），将非平稳最大熵RL中的熵调度建模为动态遗憾权衡，推导出熵权重关于非平稳性代理的平方根缩放规则，并利用可观测漂移代理在线调整温度参数。在4种算法变体、12个任务和4种漂移模式下，AES显著减少了漂移导致的性能下降比例并加速了突变后的恢复。
Motivation: 现有非平稳RL方法通常采用静态熵系数或目标熵，导致稳定期过探索、漂移后欠探索，且缺乏探索强度与漂移幅度间关系的原则性理解。
Method: 提出AES（自适应熵调度）：基于动态遗憾权衡理论，推导熵权重与在线非平稳性代理的平方根缩放规则，并利用训练中可观测的漂移指标自适应调整熵系数/温度，无需重大架构改动且开销极小。
Result: 在4种算法变体、12个任务和4种漂移模式下，AES显著降低漂移导致的性能退化比例，并加速突变后的恢复速度。
Conclusion: AES通过原则性的熵调度规则有效提升了非平稳RL对环境漂移的鲁棒性，且实现简单、通用性强。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: M2I2HA: Multi-modal Object Detection Based on Intra- and Inter-Modal Hypergraph Attention
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multi-modal detection have significantly improved detection accuracy in challenging environments (e.g., low light, overexposure). By integrating RGB with modalities such as thermal and depth, multi-modal fusion increases data redundancy and system robustness. However, significant challenges remain in effectively extracting task-relevant information both within and across modalities, as well as in achieving precise cross-modal alignment. While CNNs excel at feature extraction, they are limited by constrained receptive fields, strong inductive biases, and difficulty in capturing long-range dependencies. Transformer-based models offer global context but suffer from quadratic computational complexity and are confined to pairwise correlation modeling. Mamba and other State Space Models (SSMs), on the other hand, are hindered by their sequential scanning mechanism, which flattens 2D spatial structures into 1D sequences, disrupting topological relationships and limiting the modeling of complex higher-order dependencies. To address these issues, we propose a multi-modal perception network based on hypergraph theory called M2I2HA. Our architecture includes an Intra-Hypergraph Enhancement module to capture global many-to-many high-order relationships within each modality, and an Inter-Hypergraph Fusion module to align, enhance, and fuse cross-modal features by bridging configuration and spatial gaps between data sources. We further introduce a M2-FullPAD module to enable adaptive multi-level fusion of multi-modal enhanced features within the network, meanwhile enhancing data distribution and flow across the architecture. Extensive object detection experiments on multiple public datasets against baselines demonstrate that M2I2HA achieves state-of-the-art performance in multi-modal object detection tasks.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 13 figures, The theoretical derivation was refined, some data was updated, and experiments were added
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态目标检测中模态内有效信息提取和跨模态对齐的挑战，提出基于超图理论的多模态感知网络 M2I2HA。模型包含模态内超图增强模块（Intra-Hypergraph Enhancement）和模态间超图融合模块（Inter-Hypergraph Fusion），以及自适应多级融合模块 M2-FullPAD。在多个公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法在多模态目标检测任务上达到了最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有方法（CNN、Transformer、SSM）在模态内长程依赖、高阶关系建模或跨模态对齐上存在局限，难以有效提取任务相关信息。
Method: 提出基于超图的多模态感知网络，包括：1) 模态内超图增强模块，捕捉模态内多对多高阶关系；2) 模态间超图融合模块，对齐并融合跨模态特征；3) M2-FullPAD 模块，实现网络内自适应多级融合。
Result: 在多个公开数据集上的目标检测实验表明，M2I2HA 达到了多模态目标检测任务的最先进性能。
Conclusion: 基于超图的多模态融合方法能有效建模高阶依赖并实现跨模态对齐，在复杂环境下提升检测鲁棒性。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有方法（CNN、Transformer、SSM）在模态内长程依赖、高阶关系建模或跨模态对齐上存在局限，难以有效提取任务相关信息。
summary_sections.method: 提出基于超图的多模态感知网络，包括：1) 模态内超图增强模块，捕捉模态内多对多高阶关系；2) 模态间超图融合模块，对齐并融合跨模态特征；3) M2-FullPAD 模块，实现网络内自适应多级融合。
summary_sections.result: 在多个公开数据集上的目标检测实验表明，M2I2HA 达到了多模态目标检测任务的最先进性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 基于超图的多模态融合方法能有效建模高阶依赖并实现跨模态对齐，在复杂环境下提升检测鲁棒性。

papers.title: Graph Regularized PCA
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate data often exhibit complex dependencies that violate the assumption of isotropic residual noise. For such cases, we introduce Graph Regularized PCA (GR-PCA). It is a graph-based regularization of PCA that incorporates the dependency structure of the data features by learning a sparse precision graph and biasing loadings toward the low-frequency Fourier modes of the corresponding graph Laplacian. Consequently, high-frequency signals are suppressed, while graph-coherent low-frequency ones are preserved, yielding interpretable principal components aligned with conditional relationships. We evaluate GR-PCA on synthetic data spanning diverse graph topologies, signal-to-noise ratios, and sparsity levels. Compared to mainstream alternatives, it concentrates variance on the intended support, produces loadings with lower graph-Laplacian energy, and remains competitive in out-of-sample reconstruction. When high-frequency signals are present, the graph Laplacian penalty prevents overfitting, reducing the reconstruction accuracy but improving structural fidelity. The advantage over PCA is most pronounced when high-frequency signals are graph-correlated, whereas PCA remains competitive when such signals are nearly rotationally invariant. The procedure is simple to implement, modular with respect to the precision estimator, and scalable, providing a practical route to structure-aware dimensionality reduction that improves structural fidelity without sacrificing predictive performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出图正则化PCA (GR-PCA)，通过学习数据特征的稀疏精度图并偏向图拉普拉斯的低频傅里叶模式，对PCA进行基于图的正则化，从而抑制高频信号、保留图一致的低频信号，生成与条件关系对齐的可解释主成分。在合成数据上实验表明，GR-PCA能更好集中方差、降低图拉普拉斯能量，并保持竞争性的样本外重构能力。
Motivation: 多元数据通常呈现复杂依赖关系，违反各向同性残差噪声假设，标准PCA无法捕获这种结构，需要一种结构感知的降维方法。
Method: 引入GR-PCA，核心是图拉普拉斯惩罚项，通过倾斜载荷向低频傅里叶模式，同时学习稀疏精度图以整合特征依赖结构。实现上模块化、可扩展，与精度估计器独立。
Result: 在合成数据上，GR-PCA相比主流方法，在目标支撑上集中方差，产生更低图拉普拉斯能量的载荷，样本外重构保持竞争力；当高频信号存在时，图拉普拉斯惩罚防止过拟合，虽降低重构精度但改善结构保真度。
Conclusion: GR-PCA提供了一种实用、结构感知的降维途径，在不牺牲预测性能的前提下提升结构保真度，特别当高频信号与图相关时优势明显。

papers.title: Mechanistic Evidence for Preserved-but-Misaligned Representations in Non-IID FedAvg
papers.abstract_en: Federated Averaging (FedAvg) often degrades under non-IID client data, but it remains unclear whether this degradation reflects the loss of client-learned representations or a failure to use representations that are still present. We study this question mechanistically in sparse client-trained vision models, using dense-model controls to test whether the observed effects depend on sparsity. Our analysis combines class-specific circuit discovery, linear probing of frozen representations, head-only finetuning, and sparse feature dictionaries. Across CNN and ResNet models on CIFAR-10 and Fashion-MNIST, severe label skew can drive some per-class accuracies near zero even when class-specific internal structure remains recoverable. Linear probes substantially outperform the aggregated classifier, head-only finetuning partially restores accuracy, and USAE transfer reveals a largely shared feature basis between IID and non-IID models. Together, these diagnostics suggest that, in our setting, non-IID FedAvg degradation is not fully explained by representational erasure; it also reflects misalignment between preserved internal structure and the final prediction pathway. We release code, trained checkpoints, extracted circuits, and experiment logs at the following repository: \href{https://github.com/ha405/FedMI/tree/icml}{FedMI}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过机制分析方法，研究联邦平均（FedAvg）在非独立同分布客户端数据下的性能退化原因。实验发现，在CNN和ResNet模型上，即使某些类别的分类准确率接近零，模型内部仍然保留了可恢复的类别特定结构，线性探测和头部微调能部分恢复性能。这表明退化并非完全由于表示丢失，而是保留的内部结构与最终预测路径之间的错位（misalignment）所致。
Motivation: FedAvg在非IID数据下性能下降，但原因究竟是客户端学习到的表示丢失，还是表示存在但未被有效利用？现有研究缺乏对此问题的机制性解释。
Method: 结合类别特异性电路发现、冻结表示的线性探测、仅头部微调以及稀疏特征字典（USAE迁移）等诊断工具，在稀疏训练视觉模型上进行分析，并以密集模型作为对照。
Result: 在CIFAR-10和Fashion-MNIST上，严重标签偏斜使某些类别准确率接近零，但线性探测准确率显著高于聚合分类器；头部微调部分恢复准确率；USAE迁移显示IID与非IID模型的特征基大部分共享。
Conclusion: 非IID FedAvg的退化不能完全归因于表示擦除，还反映了保留的内部结构与最终预测路径之间的错位。

papers.title: Calibratable Disambiguation Loss for Multi-Instance Partial-Label Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-instance partial-label learning (MIPL) is a weakly supervised framework that extends the principles of multi-instance learning (MIL) and partial-label learning (PLL) to address the challenges of inexact supervision in both instance and label spaces. However, existing MIPL approaches often suffer from poor calibration, undermining classifier reliability. In this work, we propose a plug-and-play calibratable disambiguation loss (CDL) for classification and calibration, which modulates a disambiguation objective by a top-vs-competitor prediction margin. The competitor is instantiated either as the second strongest candidate label or as the strongest non-candidate label, yielding two variants that respectively emphasize candidate-level separation and candidate-vs-non-candidate suppression. Theoretically, we analyze CDL as a margin-modulated momentum-based disambiguation loss (MDL) objective, derive a lower-bound and a pseudo-label confidence-alignment bound for calibration, and show through gradient and momentum analyses how margin shaping affects weight updates. Experimental results on benchmark and real-world MIPL datasets, together with representative PLL adaptation, confirm that our CDL significantly improves both classification accuracy and expected calibration error.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE TPAMI. The code can be found at \url{https://github.com/tangw-seu/MIPLCDL}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可校准的消歧损失（CDL），用于多实例部分标签学习（MIPL），通过顶部与竞争对手预测边距来调节消歧目标，理论分析给出了下界和校准界，实验证明提高了分类精度和期望校准误差。
Motivation: 现有MIPL方法校准能力差，分类器可靠性不足。
Method: 提出插件式可校准消歧损失（CDL），基于顶部与竞争对手预测边距调节消歧目标，有两种变体（候选标签间分离和候选与非候选抑制）。
Result: 在基准和真实MIPL数据集上，CDL显著提高了分类精度和期望校准误差。
Conclusion: CDL是一种有效的校准损失，可改善分类器可靠性。

papers.title: AnySleep: a channel-agnostic deep learning system for high-resolution sleep staging in multi-center cohorts
papers.abstract_en: Sleep is essential for health, yet studying its dynamics requires manual sleep staging, a labor-intensive step in research and clinical care. Across centers, polysomnography (PSG) recordings are traditionally scored in 30-s epochs for pragmatic, not physiological, reasons and vary in electrode count, montage, and subject characteristics. These constraints challenge harmonized multi-center studies and the discovery of robust biomarkers on shorter timescales. We present AnySleep, a deep neural network that scores sleep from any electroencephalography (EEG) or electrooculography (EOG) data at adjustable temporal resolutions. We trained and validated the model on over 20,000 overnight recordings (> 200,000 hours of EEG and EOG) from 28 datasets across multiple clinics to promote robust generalization across sites. The model attains state-of-the-art performance and surpasses or equals established baselines at 30-s epochs. Performance improves with more channels, yet remains strong when EOG is absent or only EOG or single EEG derivations (frontal, central, or occipital) are available. On sub-30-s timescales, the model captures short wake intrusions consistent with arousals and improves prediction of pathophysiological conditions (obstructive sleep apnea, narcolepsy type 1, insomnia) over 30-s scoring. We make the model publicly available to facilitate large-scale studies with heterogeneous electrode setups and accelerate biomarker discovery in sleep.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AnySleep，一个与通道无关的深度学习系统，用于高分辨率睡眠分期。模型使用超过20,000晚的PSG记录训练，在30秒epoch上达到SOTA，并能处理不同电极配置，在亚30秒时间尺度上捕捉短暂唤醒，改善对病理条件的预测。
Motivation: 传统睡眠分期依赖人工逐30秒评分，耗时且电极配置多变，妨碍多中心研究和生物标志物发现。
Method: 提出AnySleep深度神经网络，可接受任意EEG或EOG数据，在可调时间分辨率下进行睡眠分期。
Result: 在28个数据集、>200,000小时数据上训练，30秒epoch上达到或超过现有基线；随通道数增加性能提升，但单通道或仅EOG也能保持强性能；亚30秒分辨率能捕捉到符合觉醒的短暂唤醒，并改善对阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停、1型发作性睡病、失眠的预测。
Conclusion: AnySleep可促进大规模异质电极设置的研究，加速生物标志物发现，模型公开可用。

papers.title: Visual Species Recognition with Large Multimodal Models as Post-Hoc Correctors
papers.abstract_en: Visual Species Recognition (VSR) is a fundamental task in scientific disciplines that require species-level identification, including ecology, palynology, evolutionary biology, systematics, and phylogenetics. Automating VSR through machine learning can significantly accelerate these efforts. However, species-level annotation requires extensive domain expertise, making large-scale labeled datasets difficult to obtain. Consequently, few-shot learning (FSL) is a practical paradigm, where an expert model is trained using only a few labeled examples. Meanwhile, Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have demonstrated unprecedented zero-shot visual recognition capabilities, raising the question of whether they can serve as an alternative to FSL expert models for VSR. We start this work with a systematic comparison between FSL expert models and LMMs, revealing that, despite advanced prompting strategies, contemporary LMMs significantly underperform FSL expert models. Interestingly, we find that LMMs possess a complementary strength: given an image and a shortlist of candidate species generated by an expert model, LMMs can often recover the correct label when the expert model's top prediction is incorrect. Motivated by this, we propose Post-hoc Correction (POC), a simple training-free framework that leverages an LMM to post-process an expert model's top predictions. We develop a multimodal prompting strategy to enable POC to improve FSL expert models by 6.4 accuracy points, averaged over five VSR benchmarks. We show that POC generalizes across diverse FSL methods, visual encoders, and LMMs, making it a practical and effective framework for VSR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较少样本学习专家模型与大多模态模型在视觉物种识别中的表现，发现现有LMMs显著落后于FSL专家模型，但LMMs具有互补优势：给定图像和专家模型生成的候选物种列表，LMMs可纠正专家模型的错误预测。因此提出Post-hoc Correction (POC)框架，无需训练，利用LMM后处理专家模型的top预测，通过多模态提示策略在五个VSR基准上平均提升6.4个精度点。
Motivation: 视觉物种识别需要领域专家标注，大规模标注困难，少样本学习是实用范式。同时大多模态模型零样本能力强，但直接用于VSR效果不佳。本文旨在利用LMMs的互补能力来改进FSL专家模型。
Method: 提出POC框架，无需训练，使用多模态提示策略，将专家模型的top预测短列表作为输入，利用LMM进行后处理纠正。
Result: 在五个VSR基准上，POC平均提升FSL专家模型6.4个精度点，且适用于不同FSL方法、视觉编码器和LMMs。
Conclusion: POC是一个实用且有效的框架，能够泛化到多种配置，为VSR提供简单有效的改进。

papers.title: GAINS: Gaussian-based Inverse Rendering from Sparse Multi-View Captures
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Gaussian Splatting-based inverse rendering extend Gaussian primitives with shading parameters and physically grounded light transport, enabling high-quality material recovery from dense multi-view captures. However, the accuracy of these methods degrades under sparse-view settings, where limited observations lead to severe ambiguity between geometry, reflectance, and lighting. We introduce GAINS (Gaussian-based Inverse rendering from Sparse multi-view captures), a two-stage inverse rendering framework that leverages foundation models as priors to stabilize geometry and material estimation. The core technical contribution of this paper is an inverse rendering framework that unifies foundation model priors with physically-based representations in an optimization scheme. GAINS first refines geometry using monocular depth, normal, and diffusion priors, and then employs segmentation, intrinsic image decomposition (IID), and diffusion priors to regularize material recovery. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that GAINS significantly improves material parameter accuracy, relighting quality, and novel-view synthesis compared to state-of-the-art Gaussian-based inverse rendering methods. While GAINS outperforms and remains competitive across a wide range of objects captured with 4 to 32 cameras, the improvement is particularly pronounced under sparse-view settings, where ambiguity is high and learning-based priors become especially beneficial. Project page: https://patrickbail.github.io/gains/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GAINS，一种基于高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）的两阶段逆向渲染框架，利用基础模型先验（monocular depth, normal, diffusion, segmentation, IID）在稀疏多视角（4-32相机）下稳定几何与材质估计。实验表明，GAINS在合成和真实数据集上显著提升材质参数精度、重光照质量和新视角合成性能，尤其在稀疏视角下优势明显。
Motivation: 现有高斯泼溅逆向渲染方法在密集视角下效果良好，但在稀疏视角下因观测不足导致几何、反射率和光照之间的严重歧义，性能下降。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段利用单目深度、法线和扩散先验细化几何；第二阶段采用分割、内在图像分解（IID）和扩散先验正则化材质恢复。统一了基础模型先验与物理表示。

papers.title: RippleBench: Capturing Ripple Effects Using Existing Knowledge Repositories
papers.abstract_en: Targeted interventions on language models, such as unlearning or model editing, aim to modify specific information, but their effects often propagate to related, unintended areas (e.g., removing virology content may degrade performance on allergies); these side-effects are commonly referred to as the ripple effect. We introduce RippleBench-Maker, an automatic pipeline that retrieves semantic neighbors of any source concept from a knowledge repository and generates multiple-choice questions at varying semantic distances. We instantiate this framework using WikiRAG, an open-source RAG system over English Wikipedia, to construct RippleBench-WMDP-Bio (584 seed topics, 352,961 questions), and evaluate eight unlearning methods on Llama3-8B-Instruct. All eight exhibit accuracy drops that are largest near the unlearned target and decay with semantic distance, each with a distinct propagation profile. We replicate these findings across Mistral-7B, Zephyr-7B, and Yi-34B; cross-model delta curves are nearly identical, suggesting ripple effects are a property of the unlearning method rather than the base model. We validate all major pipeline stages using a four-experiment Mechanical Turk study (5,200+ responses, 61 workers). We release all code, data, and infrastructure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RippleBench，一个用于评估语言模型干预（如遗忘或编辑）引发连锁效应的自动基准。通过知识库检索语义邻居并生成多选题，构建 RippleBench-WMDP-Bio 数据集（584个种子主题，352,961个问题），评估八种遗忘方法在 Llama3-8B-Instruct 上的表现，发现所有方法在目标附近准确率下降最大，且传播曲线在不同模型间高度相似，表明连锁效应主要归因于方法本身而非基座模型。
Motivation: 现有语言模型干预方法（如遗忘、编辑）可能引发连锁效应（ripple effect），即修改特定信息会意外影响相关但未预期的领域，缺乏系统评估此类副作用的基准。
Method: 提出自动流水线 RippleBench-Maker，从知识库中检索源概念的语义邻居，生成不同语义距离的多选题。基于 WikiRAG 系统（英文维基百科的检索增强生成）实例化为 RippleBench-WMDP-Bio，包含584个种子主题和352,961个问题。
Result: 八种遗忘方法在 Llama3-8B-Instruct 上均显示准确率下降，目标附近下降最大，随语义距离衰减；在 Mistral-7B、Zephyr-7B、Yi-34B 上交叉模型衰减曲线近乎一致，表明连锁效应是方法属性而非模型属性。通过 Mechanical Turk 研究（5200+回答，61名工人）验证了流水线各阶段。
Conclusion: RippleBench 提供了一个标准化、可扩展的连锁效应评估框架，并揭示了遗忘方法本身的传播特性独立于基座模型。

papers.title: Together, Then Apart: Balancing Alignment and Distinctiveness for Multimodal Survival Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal survival analysis aims to improve cancer prognosis using heterogeneous biomedical data, such as histopathology images and genomic profiles. A common strategy is to align representations across modalities so that shared signals can be captured. However, strong cross-modal alignment can also remove modality-specific evidence that is critical for survival prediction. In this paper, we revisit multimodal survival learning from a simple observation: effective models should first discover shared patterns across modalities, and then preserve modality-specific signals. This motivates a representation learning principle that we refer to as Together Then Apart. Based on this idea, we propose TTA, a framework that balances cross-modal alignment and representation distinctiveness. TTA first performs prototype-based alignment to capture shared survival-related structures between modalities. It then encourages modality-specific distinctiveness through an anchor-guided contrastive objective. To further account for modality imbalance and noisy correspondences, we model cross-modal interactions using unbalanced optimal transport. We evaluate the proposed approach on multiple TCGA cancer cohorts with paired histopathology and genomic data. TTA consistently improves survival prediction over recent multimodal survival models. Moreover, the learned prototype structures reveal interpretable cross-modal patterns associated with clinical outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TTA框架，通过先进行原型对齐再保留模态特异性特征，平衡多模态生存分析中的对齐与区分性，提升癌症预后预测性能。
Motivation: 现有方法过度对齐多模态表示会丢失模态特异性证据，影响生存预测。
Method: 提出Together Then Apart原则，先用原型对齐捕获共享结构，再用锚定对比学习保持模态特异性，并使用非平衡最优传输处理模态不平衡和噪声对应。
Result: 在多个TCGA癌症队列上，TTA持续优于现有模型，且学到的原型结构揭示了与临床结果相关的可解释多模态模式。
Conclusion: 平衡对齐与区分性对多模态生存分析至关重要，原型结构提供了可解释性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Benchmarking Nighttime Traffic Sign Recognition with Illumination-Adaptive Detection and Semantic Attribute Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Traffic signboards are vital for road safety and intelligent transportation systems. Yet, recognizing traffic signs at night remains underexplored due to the scarcity of real-world public datasets capturing low-light degradations and distractor classes. Existing benchmarks are predominantly daytime and do not reflect challenges such as headlight glare, motion blur, sensor noise, and vandalized or ambiguous signage. To address these gaps, we introduce INTSD, a large-scale nighttime traffic sign dataset collected across diverse regions of India. INTSD contains street-level images spanning 41 traffic signboard classes, multiple distractor categories, and varied lighting and weather conditions, designed to support both detection and fine-grained classification under nighttime scenarios. To benchmark INTSD, we conduct extensive evaluations using state-of-the-art detection and classification models under standardized protocols. Additionally, we present LENS-Net, a strong baseline that integrates an end-to-end adaptive illumination-aware detector with a multimodal classifier that fuses vision-language representations with soft semantic attribute reasoning over learnable shape and color embeddings. Experiments demonstrate that models trained exclusively on daytime data fail substantially under real nighttime conditions - a gap that is recovered once INTSD is introduced in training, even when controlling for data volume. These results validate INTSD as a complementary nighttime training resource and establish competitive baselines for future research. The code and dataset are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了INTSD，一个大规模的印度夜间交通标志数据集，涵盖41个类别和多种退化场景（如头灯眩光、运动模糊、传感器噪声），并提出了LENS-Net基线模型，结合自适应光照检测器和多模态分类器，利用视觉-语言表示和软语义属性推理。实验表明，仅白天训练的模型在夜间数据上表现显著下降，而加入INTSD训练后性能恢复。
Motivation: 夜间交通标志识别因缺乏真实世界的公共数据集而未被充分研究，现有基准主要为白天场景，无法反映头灯眩光、运动模糊、传感器噪声等夜间挑战。
Method: 提出LENS-Net，包含一个端到端的自适应光照感知检测器和一个多模态分类器，后者融合视觉-语言表示和基于可学习形状与颜色嵌入的软语义属性推理。
Result: 仅白天训练的模型在真实夜间条件下性能大幅下降，引入INTSD后（即使控制数据量）性能恢复，验证了INTSD作为补充夜间训练资源的有效性。
Conclusion: INTSD数据集和LENS-Net基线为夜间交通标志识别提供了基准，并证明了夜间专用训练数据的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LEGO-SLAM: Language-Embedded Gaussian Optimization SLAM
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have enabled Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) systems to build photorealistic maps. However, these maps lack the open-vocabulary semantic understanding required for robotic interaction. Integrating language features into SLAM remains a significant challenge, as storing high-dimensional features incurs excessive memory and rendering overhead, while existing methods with static models lack adaptability for novel environments. We propose LEGO-SLAM (Language-Embedded Gaussian Optimization SLAM), a framework that achieves real-time, open-vocabulary mapping within a 3DGS-based SLAM system. At the core of our method is a scene-adaptive autoencoder that distills high-dimensional language embeddings into a compact 16-dimensional feature space, reducing the memory per Gaussian and accelerating rendering. Unlike static approaches, our encoder adapts online to unseen scenes. These compact features also enable a language-guided pruning strategy that identifies semantic redundancy, reducing the map's Gaussian count by up to 58% while maintaining rendering quality. Furthermore, we introduce a language-based loop detection approach that reuses the language features already extracted for mapping, eliminating the need for a separate detection model. Experiments demonstrate that LEGO-SLAM achieves competitive mapping quality and tracking accuracy, all while providing open-vocabulary capabilities at 15 FPS. Our project page is available at https://lab-of-ai-and-robotics.github.io/LEGO-SLAM/
papers.comment: Project page :https://lab-of-ai-and-robotics.github.io/LEGO-SLAM/ Submitted to IEEE RA-L
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LEGO-SLAM 将语言嵌入集成到 3DGS 的 SLAM 系统中，提出场景自适应自编码器将高维语言嵌入压缩至 16 维，并利用语言引导的剪枝策略减少高斯点数量，同时引入基于语言的回环检测。实验表明该方法在保持 15 FPS 实时性的同时提供开放词汇语义理解能力。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 的 SLAM 系统缺乏开放词汇语义理解，无法支持机器人交互；直接存储高维语言特征会导致内存和渲染开销过大，而静态模型无法适应新环境。
Method: 提出场景自适应自编码器在线蒸馏语言嵌入至 16 维紧凑特征；基于紧凑特征的语言引导剪枝策略识别语义冗余，减少高斯点数量；复用映射中的语言特征实现基于语言的回环检测。
Result: 剪枝策略减少最多 58% 高斯点且保持渲染质量；系统在 15 FPS 下实现开放词汇映射，且跟踪精度和建图质量与现有方法相当。
Conclusion: LEGO-SLAM 证明了将语言特征高效集成到实时 3DGS-SLAM 中的可行性，为机器人开放词汇交互提供了新路径。

papers.title: When and Why Does Multi-Agent Debate Fail and Does It Really Underperform?
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent debate (MAD) was proposed as a promising approach for ensembling the wisdom of multiple large language models (LLMs) to improve reasoning and provide effective supervision to superhuman LLMs. However, increasing empirical evidence suggests that MAD may not outperform or even significantly underperform single-agent approaches (SA), raising doubts about the benefits of MAD. In this work, we investigate this issue by analyzing the incentive structures of popular MAD paradigms: (i) competitive MAD (CopMAD) where agents compete by holding opposing positions; (ii) consensus-seeking MAD (CosMAD) where agents are driven to seek consensus. We show that both paradigms suffer from debate hacking: CopMAD reduces to a cheap-talk game, where agents produce misleading messages to win the game, while CosMAD filters out informative disagreements for premature consensus. Consequently, agents in both CopMAD and CosMAD fail to jointly resolve the ambiguity and seek the truth. To this end, we introduce ColMAD, a collaborative protocol that reframes MAD as a non-zero-sum game to encourage agents to provide informative while truthful messages. Through extensive benchmarking on challenging tasks such as error detection, we show that ColMAD significantly outperforms previous MAD protocols up to 10 percentage points. Under the same budgets, ColMAD effectively brings non-trivial improvements over SA methods, implying that the protocol design is critical to realizing the potential of MAD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了多智能体辩论（MAD）范式中竞争型（CopMAD）和共识型（CosMAD）的激励缺陷，发现两者分别退化为廉价谈话游戏和过早共识，导致无法有效聚合信息。为此提出协作型协议ColMAD，将辩论重构为非零和博弈，鼓励智能体生成信息丰富且真实的讯息。在错误检测等挑战性任务上，ColMAD相比之前MAD协议提升最多10个百分点，并在同等预算下显著优于单智能体方法。
Motivation: 现有MAD方法在经验上常不如单智能体，甚至显著更差，但其失败原因尚未被系统理解。本文旨在揭示MAD范式中的激励结构问题，并设计有效的改进协议。
Method: 通过博弈论分析CopMAD和CosMAD的激励结构，指出CopMAD是廉价谈话游戏（智能体为获胜而发送误导信息），CosMAD则过滤信息性分歧导致过早共识。提出ColMAD协作协议，将MAD重新定义为非零和博弈，通过设计奖励机制鼓励智能体同时提供信息丰富且真实的讯息。
Result: 在错误检测等挑战性任务上，ColMAD相比之前MAD协议提升最多10个百分点；在相同预算下，ColMAD相比单智能体方法带来非平凡改进。
Conclusion: 协议设计对发挥MAD潜力至关重要，ColMAD通过协作激励有效避免了先前范式的失败模式，实现了优于单智能体的性能。

summary_sections.method: 通过博弈论分析CopMAD和CosMAD的激励结构，指出CopMAD是廉价谈话游戏（智能体为获胜而发送误导信息），CosMAD则过滤信息性分歧导致过早共识。提出ColMAD协作协议，将MAD重新定义为非零和博弈，通过设计奖励机制鼓励智能体同时提供信息丰富且真实的讯息。
summary_sections.result: 在错误检测等挑战性任务上，ColMAD相比之前MAD协议提升最多10个百分点；在相同预算下，ColMAD相比单智能体方法带来非平凡改进。
summary_sections.conclusion: 协议设计对发挥MAD潜力至关重要，ColMAD通过协作激励有效避免了先前范式的失败模式，实现了优于单智能体的性能。

papers.title: Higher Embedding Dimension Creates a Stronger World Model for a Simple Sorting Task
papers.abstract_en: We investigate how embedding dimension affects the emergence of an internal "world model" in a transformer trained with reinforcement learning to perform bubble-sort-style adjacent swaps. Models achieve high accuracy even with very small embedding dimensions, but larger dimensions yield more faithful, consistent, and robust internal representations. In particular, higher embedding dimensions strengthen the formation of structured internal representation and lead to better interpretability. After hundreds of experiments, we observe two consistent mechanisms: (1) the last row of the attention weight matrix monotonically encodes the global ordering of tokens; and (2) the selected transposition aligns with the largest adjacent difference of these encoded values. Our results provide quantitative evidence that transformers build structured internal world models and that model size improves representation quality in addition to end performance. We release our metrics and analyses, which can be used to probe similar algorithmic tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在强化学习训练下，transformer执行冒泡排序式相邻交换任务时，嵌入维度如何影响内部“世界模型”的涌现。即使嵌入维度很小，模型也能达到高准确率，但更大维度带来更忠实、一致和鲁棒的内部表征，并改善可解释性。实验发现两个一致机制：注意力权重矩阵最后一行单调编码全局顺序，所选交换与这些编码值的最大相邻差值对齐。
Motivation: 探索嵌入维度对transformer内部世界模型形成的影响，以及模型大小如何影响表征质量而非仅终端性能。
Method: 使用强化学习训练transformer执行冒泡排序风格的相邻交换任务，改变嵌入维度大小，并通过数百次实验分析内部表征的结构和一致性。
Result: 小嵌入维度即可达到高准确率，但更大维度产生更忠实、一致和鲁棒的内部表征，并发现两个一致机制：注意力权重矩阵最后一行单调编码全局顺序，所选交换与编码值的最大相邻差值对齐。
Conclusion: 提供了transformer构建结构化内部世界模型的定量证据，表明模型大小改善表征质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Attention Misses Visual Risk: Risk-Adaptive Steering for Multimodal Safety Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Even modern AI models often remain vulnerable to multimodal queries in which harmful intent is embedded in images. A widely used approach for safety alignment is training with extensive multimodal safety datasets, but the costs of data curation and training are often prohibitive. To mitigate these costs, inference-time alignment has recently been explored, but they often lack generalizability across diverse multimodal jailbreaks and still incur notable overhead due to extra forward passes for response refinement or heavy pre-deployment calibration procedures. Here, we identify insufficient visual attention to safety-critical image regions as one of the key causes of multimodal safety failures. Building on this insight, we propose Multimodal Risk-Adaptive Steering (MoRAS), which enhances safety-critical visual attention via concise visual contexts for accurate multimodal risk assessment. This risk signal enables risk-adaptive steering for direct refusals, reducing inference overhead while remaining generalizable across diverse multimodal jailbreaks. Notably, MoRAS requires only a small calibration set to estimate multimodal risk, substantially reducing pre-deployment overhead. We conduct various empirical validations across multiple benchmarks and MLLM backbones, and observe that the proposed MoRAS consistently mitigates jailbreaks, preserves utility, and reduces computational overhead compared to state-of-the-art inference-time defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态安全对齐中模型对图像中危险意图的视觉注意不足问题，提出多模态风险自适应引导（MoRAS），通过简洁视觉上下文增强安全关键视觉注意，实现风险自适应拒绝回答，降低推理开销并提升跨多种多模态越狱攻击的泛化能力。实验表明MoRAS能稳定缓解越狱、保持有用性并降低计算开销。
Motivation: 现有推理时对齐方法要么缺乏泛化性，要么因额外前向传播或繁重校准带来显著开销。作者识别出对安全关键图像区域的视觉注意不足是多模态安全失败的关键原因，旨在通过轻量级方法提升视觉注意来改善安全对齐。
Method: 提出MoRAS，利用简洁视觉上下文生成准确的多模态风险信号，该风险信号用于风险自适应引导（risk-adaptive steering），直接拒绝危险查询。仅需小型校准集估计多模态风险，减少部署前开销。
Result: 在多个基准和MLLM骨干上，MoRAS一致地缓解越狱攻击，保持有用性，并降低计算开销，优于现有最先进的推理时防御方法。
Conclusion: MoRAS通过增强安全关键视觉注意和风险自适应引导，实现了高效且泛化的多模态安全对齐，降低了数据与训练成本。

papers.title: Learning Latent Energy-Based Models via Interacting Particle Langevin Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: We develop interacting particle algorithms for learning latent variable models with energy-based priors. To do so, we leverage recent developments in particle-based methods for solving maximum marginal likelihood estimation (MMLE) problems. Specifically, we provide a continuous-time framework for learning latent energy-based models, by defining stochastic differential equations (SDEs) that provably solve the MMLE problem. We obtain a practical algorithm as a discretisation of these SDEs and provide theoretical guarantees for the convergence of the proposed algorithm. Finally, we empirically validate the effectiveness of our method on synthetic and image datasets and demonstrate that using a particle based approach offers significant improvement in computational efficiency.
papers.comment: Accepted as an oral presentation at UAI'26
papers.journal_ref: Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI) 2026. Oral presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于相互作用粒子Langevin动力学的算法，用于学习具有能量基先验的潜变量模型。通过定义连续时间随机微分方程（SDE）来求解最大边际似然估计（MMLE）问题，并给出离散化后的实用算法及其收敛性理论保证。在合成数据集和图像数据集上的实验表明，该方法在计算效率上有显著提升。
Motivation: 传统学习方法在处理潜变量能量模型时面临计算挑战，现有粒子方法在MMLE问题上尚未充分利用粒子间的相互作用。
Method: 建立连续时间SDE框架，通过相互作用粒子系统求解MMLE问题，并离散化为实用算法，同时提供收敛性理论分析。
Result: 在合成和图像数据集上验证了方法的有效性，相比基线方法显著提高了计算效率。
Conclusion: 相互作用粒子方法为学习潜能量模型提供了一种高效且理论上有保证的途径。

papers.title: Leveraging Prior Knowledge of Diffusion Model for Person Search
papers.abstract_en: Person search aims to jointly perform person detection and re-identification by localizing and identifying a query person within a gallery of uncropped scene images. Existing methods predominantly utilize ImageNet pre-trained backbones, which may be suboptimal for capturing the complex spatial context and fine-grained identity cues necessary for person search. Moreover, they rely on a shared backbone feature for both person detection and re-identification, leading to suboptimal features due to conflicting optimization objectives. In this paper, we propose DiffPS (Diffusion Prior Knowledge for Person Search), a novel framework that leverages a pre-trained diffusion model while eliminating the optimization conflict between two sub-tasks. We analyze key properties of diffusion priors and propose three specialized modules: (i) Diffusion-Guided Region Proposal Network (DGRPN) for enhanced person localization, (ii) Multi-Scale Frequency Refinement Network (MSFRN) to mitigate shape bias, and (iii) Semantic-Adaptive Feature Aggregation Network (SFAN) to leverage text-aligned diffusion features. DiffPS sets a new state-of-the-art on CUHK-SYSU and PRW.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DiffPS框架，利用预训练扩散模型的先验知识（diffusion prior）来改进人物搜索（person search）任务。通过分析扩散先验的关键特性，作者设计了三个专用模块：扩散引导区域提议网络（DGRPN）、多尺度频率细化网络（MSFRN）和语义自适应特征聚合网络（SFAN），以解决检测与重识别之间的优化冲突。该方法在CUHK-SYSU和PRW数据集上取得了新的最优结果（SOTA）。
Motivation: 现有人物搜索方法主要使用ImageNet预训练的骨干网络，难以捕捉复杂空间上下文和细粒度身份线索；同时共享特征表示导致检测和重识别子任务目标冲突，产生次优特征。
Method: 提出DiffPS框架，包含三个模块：(i) 扩散引导区域提议网络（DGRPN）增强定位；(ii) 多尺度频率细化网络（MSFRN）缓解形状偏差；(iii) 语义自适应特征聚合网络（SFAN）利用文本对齐的扩散特征。利用预训练扩散模型的先验知识。
Result: 在CUHK-SYSU和PRW基准上取得了新的最好成绩（state-of-the-art）。
Conclusion: 利用扩散模型的先验知识可以有效消除人物检测与重识别之间的优化冲突，提升整体人物搜索性能。

papers.title: Affordance-Guided Diffusion Prior for 3D Hand Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: How can we reconstruct 3D hand poses when large portions of the hand are heavily occluded by itself or by objects? Humans often resolve such ambiguities by leveraging contextual knowledge -- such as affordances, where an object's shape and function suggest how the object is typically grasped. Inspired by this observation, we propose a generative prior for hand pose refinement guided by affordance-aware textual descriptions of hand-object interactions (HOI). Our method employs a diffusion-based generative model that learns the distribution of plausible hand poses conditioned on affordance descriptions, which are inferred from a large vision-language model (VLM). This enables the refinement of occluded regions into more accurate and functionally coherent hand poses. Extensive experiments on HOGraspNet, a 3D hand-affordance dataset with severe occlusions, demonstrate that our affordance-guided refinement significantly improves hand pose estimation over both recent regression methods and diffusion-based refinement lacking contextual reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于功能可供性（affordance）引导的扩散先验，用于处理严重遮挡下的3D手部重建。方法利用大视觉语言模型推断手-物交互的功能描述，并作为条件训练扩散模型，从而生成功能一致的合理手部姿态。在HOGraspNet数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著提升了遮挡区域的姿态估计准确性。
Motivation: 当手部被自身或物体严重遮挡时，现有方法难以准确重建3D手部姿态。人类常通过物体的形状和功能（即可供性）来推断抓取方式，而现有方法缺乏这种上下文推理。
Method: 提出一个扩散生成模型，以从大视觉语言模型推断的affordance文本描述为条件，学习合理手部姿态的分布，用于细化被遮挡区域的初始估计。
Result: 在HOGraspNet数据集上，该方法在严重遮挡场景下显著优于最近的回归方法和缺乏上下文推理的扩散细化方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用affordance引导的扩散先验可以有效改善遮挡情况下的手部姿态估计，使结果更准确且功能一致。

papers.title: Improved Robustness from Biologically Inspired Sparse Contrast Representations
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks surpass humans on many vision benchmarks, yet remain far less robust to distribution shifts such as illumination and weather changes. Existing approaches address this challenge by additional training data, extensive augmentation, architectural modifications, or test-time adaptation. In this work, we explore a complementary direction: inspired by the human retina, we propose a fixed, model-agnostic preprocessing module that extracts signals that are more stable with respect to variations of illumination. Our method combines color remapping with local contrast extraction, producing sparse representations that emphasize structural features. We study its impact on semantic segmentation by training on Cityscapes and evaluating generalization under adverse conditions on Dark Zurich and ACDC. Our results show that the biologically inspired preprocessing preserves in-distribution performance while consistently improving robustness in challenging lighting scenarios, such as nighttime, where annotated training data are scarce. Moreover, the segmentation accuracy remains stable even when the contrast-based representation is sparsified by up to 70%. These gains suggest that rethinking the input representation itself can improve robustness while also opening opportunities for lower-latency, transmission-aware imaging sensors when sparsity can be exploited close to acquisition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受人类视网膜启发，提出一种固定且与模型无关的预处理模块，通过颜色重映射和局部对比度提取生成稀疏表示，强调结构特征。在Cityscapes上训练语义分割模型，在Dark Zurich和ACDC等恶劣光照条件下测试，该方法在不损害分布内性能的前提下显著提升鲁棒性，且稀疏化70%后精度仍稳定。
Motivation: 现有深度神经网络在光照变化等分布偏移下鲁棒性不足，而现有方法依赖额外数据、增强或架构修改，本文探索通过改变输入表示本身来提升鲁棒性。
Method: 提出生物启发的固定预处理模块：结合颜色重映射与局部对比度提取，生成稀疏且强调结构的表示，作为模型无关的输入预处理。
Result: 在Cityscapes上保持分布内性能，同时在Dark Zurich和ACDC的夜间等挑战场景下鲁棒性一致提升，且稀疏化70%后分割精度仍然稳定。
Conclusion: 重新思考输入表示可提升鲁棒性，并为利用稀疏性的低延迟传输感知成像传感器提供机会。

papers.title: Evolution Strategies at Scale: LLM Fine-Tuning Beyond Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) for downstream tasks is an essential stage of modern AI deployment. Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as the dominant fine-tuning paradigm, underpinning many state-of-the-art LLMs. In contrast, evolution strategies (ES) has largely been overlooked due to the widespread belief that it does not scale to modern model sizes. This paper overturns this assumption by demonstrating the first successful application of ES to full-parameter fine-tuning of LLMs at the billion-parameter scale, without dimensionality reduction. ES can indeed search over extremely high-dimensional parameter spaces and outperform established RL implementations across multiple axes, including improved tolerance to long-horizon and delayed rewards, robustness across diverse base LLMs, reduced susceptibility to reward hacking, and improved training stability. These findings suggest that ES is not merely a viable alternative to RL, but a fundamentally different and powerful backpropagation-free post-training paradigm that opens a new direction for LLM fine-tuning beyond current RL-based approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文展示了进化策略(ES)在十亿参数级别的大型语言模型(LLM)全参数微调中的首次成功应用，无需降维。实验表明ES能够搜索极高维参数空间，并在多个指标上优于强化学习(RL)，包括对长时延奖励的容忍度、对不同基础LLM的鲁棒性、减少奖励破解以及提高训练稳定性。这些结果挑战了ES无法扩展到现代模型大小的普遍观点。
Motivation: 强化学习(RL)成为LLM微调的主流范式，而进化策略(ES)因其被认为无法扩展到现代模型规模而被忽视。本文旨在推翻这一假设，展示ES在十亿参数LLM微调中的可行性和优势。
Method: 将进化策略(ES)直接应用于十亿参数级别LLM的全参数微调，不使用维度缩减技术。通过搜索高维参数空间实现。
Result: ES在多项指标上超越RL实现，包括更好的长时延奖励容忍度、对不同基础LLM的鲁棒性、更少的奖励破解倾向以及更高的训练稳定性。
Conclusion: ES不仅是RL的可行替代，而且是一种根本不同的无反向传播后训练范式，为LLM微调开辟了超越RL的新方向。

papers.title: Evidence Recomposition and Predictive Context Residualization for Visual Attribution in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong vision-language performance, yet their token-level visual evidence remains difficult to inspect. Recent logit-lens attribution methods project each visual-token hidden state into the vocabulary space to explain generated words, but this token-wise readout introduces a mismatch: visual tokens are context-mixed by the model, while the attribution score is decoded independently at each token location. This often produces fragmented attribution maps and can be further affected by autoregressive context signals from preceding text tokens. We propose ERCR, an attribution framework built from Evidence Recomposition (ER) and Predictive Context Residualization (PCR). ER aggregates target evidence across multiple views with different token-to-region assignments, reducing attribution fragmentation caused by a single readout grid. PCR estimates a preceding-token context map with RBO-based rank relevance and subtracts its fitted component from the ER map to suppress context-token interference. Experiments on LLaVA, Qwen2-VL, and InternVL families across COCO Caption, GranDf, and OpenPSG show that ERCR improves visual evidence for target tokens and mitigates preceding-token context interference under the existing evaluation protocol. On Qwen2-VL-2B, ERCR improves TAM F1-IoU from 39.10 to 44.45 on COCO Caption and from 30.83 to 37.20 on GranDf. Overall, ERCR provides a practical refinement for token-level visual evidence inspection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ERCR框架，通过证据重组（ER）和预测性上下文残差化（PCR）改善多模态大语言模型中视觉归因的碎片化和上下文干扰问题。ER聚合多视图证据减少碎片化，PCR利用RBO排序相关性去除前文token干扰。在LLaVA、Qwen2-VL、InternVL等模型上，ERCR在COCO Caption、GranDf和OpenPSG数据集上提升了归因质量，例如Qwen2-VL-2B的TAM F1-IoU从39.10提升至44.45（COCO Caption）。
Motivation: 现有logit-lens归因方法因视觉token上下文混合和自回归信号干扰，导致归因图碎片化且受前文token影响。
Method: 提出证据重组（ER）聚合多视图证据，以及预测性上下文残差化（PCR）通过RBO排序相关性估计前文token上下文图并减去其拟合成分。
Result: 在多个MLLM和数据集上，ERCR显著提升目标token的视觉证据质量，减少前文token干扰。例如Qwen2-VL-2B在COCO Caption上TAM F1-IoU提升5.35点。
Conclusion: ERCR为token级视觉归因提供了实用的改进方案，但可能依赖特定评估协议。

papers.title: DeepTravel: An End-to-End Agentic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Autonomous Travel Planning Agents
papers.abstract_en: Travel planning (TP) agent has recently worked as an emerging building block to interact with external tools/resources for travel itinerary generation, ensuring an enjoyable user experience. Despite its benefits, existing studies rely on hand-craft prompt and fixed agent workflow, hindering more flexible and autonomous TP agents. This paper proposes DeepTravel, an end-to-end agentic reinforcement learning framework for building an autonomous travel planning agent, capable of autonomously planning, executing tools, and reflecting on tool responses to explore, verify, and refine intermediate actions in multi-step reasoning. To achieve this, we first construct a robust travel sandbox by caching transportation, accommodation and POI data, facilitating TP agent training without being constrained by real-world APIs limitations (e.g., inconsistent outputs). Moreover, we develop a hierarchical reward modeling system, where a trajectory-level verifier first checks spatiotemporal feasibility and filters unsatisfied travel itinerary, and then the turn-level verifier further validate itinerary's detail consistency with tool responses, enabling efficient and precise reward service. Finally, we propose the reply-augmented reinforcement learning method that enables TP agent to periodically replay from a failure experience buffer, emerging notable agentic capacity. We deploy the trained TP agent in the DiDi Enterprise Solutions application. A three-month online test shows that it achieves 82% accuracy in travel itinerary generation. Comprehensive offline evaluations further demonstrate that DeepTravel enables small-sized LLMs (e.g., Qwen3-32B) to significantly outperform frontier LLMs (e.g., OpenAI o1/o3 and DeepSeek-R1) and existing TP agent frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeepTravel，一个端到端智能体强化学习框架，用于构建自主旅行规划代理。该框架通过构建包含交通、住宿和POI数据的旅行沙盒，支持代理在无需真实API限制下训练；同时设计了分层奖励建模系统，包括轨迹级验证时空可行性和回合级验证细节一致性，并提出了回复增强强化学习方法，从失败经验缓冲中重放以提升能力。在线测试表明，该系统在滴滴企业版应用中达到82%的行程生成准确率，离线评估显示小规模LLM（如Qwen3-32B）显著超越前沿模型（如OpenAI o1/o3和DeepSeek-R1）及现有代理框架。
Motivation: 现有旅行规划代理依赖手工提示和固定工作流，缺乏灵活性和自主性，难以应对多步推理中的探索、验证和修正需求。
Method: 构建旅行沙盒作为训练环境；提出分层奖励建模，轨迹级验证时空可行性，回合级验证工具响应一致性；提出回复增强强化学习，从失败经验缓冲中周期性重放以增强智能体能力。
Result: 在线三个月测试中，行程生成准确率达82%；离线评估中，Qwen3-32B等小模型在多个基准上超越OpenAI o1/o3、DeepSeek-R1及现有旅行规划代理框架。
Conclusion: DeepTravel通过强化学习和分层奖励机制，使小规模LLM在自主旅行规划任务中达到甚至超越前沿模型性能，但摘要未讨论局限性。

papers.title: Linear Regression under Missing or Corrupted Coordinates
papers.abstract_en: We study multivariate linear regression under Gaussian covariates in two settings, where data may be erased or corrupted by an adversary under a coordinate-wise budget. In the incomplete data setting, an adversary may inspect the dataset and delete entries in up to an $η$-fraction of samples per coordinate; a strong form of the Missing Not At Random model. In the corrupted data setting, the adversary instead replaces values arbitrarily, and the corruption locations are unknown to the learner. Despite substantial work on missing data, linear regression under such adversarial missingness remains poorly understood, even information-theoretically. Unlike the clean setting, where estimation error vanishes with more samples, here the optimal error remains a positive function of the problem parameters. Our main contribution is to characterize this error up to constant factors across essentially the entire parameter range. Specifically, we establish novel information-theoretic lower bounds on the achievable error that match the error of (computationally efficient) algorithms. A key implication is that, perhaps surprisingly, the optimal error in the missing data setting matches that in the corruption setting-so knowing the corruption locations offers no general advantage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了高斯协变量下的多元线性回归在两种对抗性数据缺失/损坏场景中的信息论下界，刻画了最优误差直至常数因子，并发现缺失数据与损坏数据场景的最优误差相同。
Motivation: 尽管缺失数据问题已有大量研究，但在对抗性缺失（Missing Not At Random）下线性回归的信息论极限尚不明确，且最优误差不会随样本增长而消失。
Method: 通过建立匹配的信息论下界与计算高效算法误差，在几乎整个参数范围内刻画最优误差的常数因子。
Result: 缺失数据场景的最优误差与损坏数据场景匹配，即知道损坏位置不带来一般优势。
Conclusion: 本文完整刻画了对抗性缺失/损坏下线性回归的基本极限，且两种设置下最优误差一致。

papers.title: Efficient Conformal Prediction for Regression Models under Label Noise
papers.abstract_en: In high-stakes scenarios, such as medical imaging applications, it is critical to equip the predictions of a regression model with reliable confidence intervals. Recently, Conformal Prediction (CP) has emerged as a powerful statistical framework that, based on a labeled calibration set, generates intervals that include the true labels with a pre-specified probability. In this paper, we address the problem of applying CP for regression models when the calibration set contains noisy labels. We begin by establishing a mathematically grounded procedure for estimating the noise-free CP threshold. Then, we turn it into a practical algorithm that overcomes the challenges arising from the continuous nature of the regression problem. We evaluate the proposed method on two medical imaging regression datasets with Gaussian label noise. Our method significantly outperforms the existing alternative, achieving performance close to the clean-label setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对回归模型在含标签噪声的校准集上进行共形预测（Conformal Prediction）的问题，提出了一种基于数学推导的无噪声共形预测阈值估计方法，并将其转化为实用算法。在具有高斯标签噪声的两个医学影像回归数据集上，该方法显著优于现有替代方案，性能接近无噪声标签场景。
Motivation: 在医学影像等高风险场景中，回归模型的预测需要可靠的置信区间。现有共形预测假设校准集标签无噪，而实际中标签噪声普遍存在，导致区间覆盖不准确。
Method: 首先建立无噪声共形预测阈值的数学估计基础，然后针对回归问题的连续性挑战设计实用算法，通过处理标签噪声来校准阈值。
Result: 在两个医学影像回归数据集（含高斯标签噪声）上，所提方法显著优于现有替代方法，性能接近无噪声标签的设置。
Conclusion: 该方法有效缓解了标签噪声对共形预测的不利影响，为回归模型在噪声环境下的可靠区间估计提供了实用方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Real-Time Model Checking for Closed-Loop Robot Reactive Planning
papers.abstract_en: Reactive obstacle avoidance methods often cause agents to become trapped in local minima, because they can often only reason one step ahead (i.e., the next action based on the current state). In this paper, we use model checking to achieve reactive multi-step planning and obstacle avoidance on an autonomous robot. Our small, purpose-built model checking algorithm generates plans in situ (within the robot's code) based on ``core'' knowledge and attention as found in biological agents. This is achieved in real-time using no pre-computed data on a low-powered device. Our approach is based on chaining temporary control systems that are spawned to counteract disturbances in the local environment which disrupt an autonomous agent from its preferred action (or resting state). We mitigate state-space explosion by relying on temporary snapshots of the immediate environment, restricting the number of states. Multi-step planning using counter-examples generated by depth-first search and a negated LTL path property is applied to scenarios involving a cul-de-sac and a free-standing obstacle. Empirical results and informal proofs of two fundamental properties demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach for the creation of efficient multi-step plans for local obstacle avoidance. We significantly improve performance compared to a purely reactive agent that can only plan one step ahead. Our approach is an instructional case study for the development of safe and reliable navigation in the context of autonomous vehicles. We believe it also has general application in navigation for mission-critical mobile robots.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种实时模型检测方法用于闭环机器人反应式规划，通过链式临时控制系统实现多步规划与避障，避免局部最小值。算法在低功耗设备上实时运行，无需预计算数据，通过限制状态空间解决状态爆炸问题。实验表明在死胡同和独立障碍场景中，相比纯反应式代理显著提升性能。
Motivation: 反应式避障方法往往只考虑下一步动作，导致陷入局部最小值。需要一种能实时进行多步规划的方法。
Method: 基于生物体中的“核心”知识和注意力，设计小型的模型检测算法，在机器人代码内实时生成计划。通过链式临时控制系统来抵消局部环境干扰，使用深度优先搜索和否定的LTL路径属性生成反例实现多步规划。
Result: 在死胡同和独立障碍场景中，与仅能单步规划的反应式代理相比，性能显著提升。给出了两个基本属性的经验结果和非正式证明。
Conclusion: 该方法为自动驾驶车辆安全可靠导航提供了指导性案例研究，也适用于关键任务移动机器人导航。

papers.title: Diffusion Denoiser-Aided Gyrocompassing
papers.abstract_en: An accurate initial heading angle is essential for efficient and safe navigation across diverse domains. Unlike magnetometers, gyroscopes can provide accurate heading reference independent of the magnetic disturbances in a process known as gyrocompassing. Yet, accurate and timely gyrocompassing, using low-cost gyroscopes, remains a significant challenge in scenarios where external navigation aids are unavailable. Such challenges are commonly addressed in real-world applications such as autonomous vehicles, where size, weight, and power limitations restrict sensor quality, and noisy measurements severely degrade gyrocompassing performance. To cope with this challenge, we propose a novel diffusion denoiser-aided gyrocompass approach. It integrates a diffusion-based denoising framework with an enhanced learning-based heading estimation model. The diffusion denoiser processes raw inertial sensor signals before input to the deep learning model, resulting in accurate gyrocompassing. Experiments using both simulated and real sensor data demonstrate that our proposed approach improves gyrocompassing accuracy by 26% compared to model-based gyrocompassing and by 15% compared to other learning-driven approaches. This advancement holds particular significance for ensuring accurate and robust navigation in autonomous platforms that incorporate low-cost gyroscopes within their navigation systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩散去噪器辅助的陀螺罗经方法，通过扩散去噪框架处理原始惯性传感器信号，再输入增强的学习型航向估计模型，以提高低成本陀螺仪的初始航向角精度。在模拟和真实传感器数据上的实验表明，该方法相比基于模型的陀螺罗经精度提升26%，相比其他学习驱动方法提升15%。
Motivation: 低成本陀螺仪在外部导航辅助不可用时，如自动驾驶等场景，其噪声严重制约陀螺罗经性能，需要一种能有效去噪并提高航向估计精度的方法。
Method: 集成扩散去噪框架与增强的学习型航向估计模型，先对原始惯性传感器信号进行扩散去噪，再输入深度学习模型进行航向估计。
Result: 在模拟和真实传感器数据上，所提方法相比模型基陀螺罗经精度提升26%，相比其他学习方法提升15%。
Conclusion: 该方法对集成低成本陀螺仪的自主平台导航系统具有重要意义，能提供更准确鲁棒的航向估计。

papers.title: Automatic Labelling for Low-Light Pedestrian Detection
papers.abstract_en: Pedestrian detection in RGB images is a key task in pedestrian safety, as the most common sensor in autonomous vehicles and advanced driver assistance systems is the RGB camera. Low-light pedestrian detection lacks large public datasets and autolabelling pipelines. This research proposes a solution in the form of an automated infrared-RGB pipeline. The pipeline consists of 1) Infrared detection, where a fine-tuned model for infrared pedestrian detection is used 2) Label transfer process from the infrared detections to their RGB counterparts 3) Training object detection models using the generated labels for low-light RGB pedestrian detection. The research was performed using the KAIST dataset. For evaluation, three object detection models, DETR, YOLO, and RCNN, were trained on generated and ground truth labels. When compared on previously unseen images, the results showed that the models trained on generated labels out-performed the ones trained on ground-truth in 5 out of 6 cases for the mAP@50 and LAMR metrics, and outperformed ground-truth on mAP@50-95 in all cases. Acquired results indicate that the proposed auto-labelling pipeline could be used for scalable annotation of low-light datasets for pedestrian detection. The source code for this research is available on GitHub: https://github.com/BouzoulasDimitrios/IR-RGB-autoamed-low-light-pedestrian-labelling
