papers.title: Stochastic Quantum Spiking Neural Networks with Quantum Memory and Local Learning
papers.abstract_en: Neuromorphic and quantum computing have recently emerged as promising paradigms for advancing artificial intelligence, each offering complementary strengths. Neuromorphic systems built on spiking neurons excel at processing time series data efficiently through sparse, event-driven computation, consuming energy only upon input events. Quantum computing, on the other hand, operates on state spaces that grow exponentially in dimension with the number of qubits -- as a consequence of tensor-product composition -- with quantum states admitting superposition across basis states and entanglement between subsystems. Hybrid approaches combining these paradigms have begun to show potential, but existing quantum spiking models have important limitations. Notably, they implement classical memory mechanisms on single qubits, requiring repeated measurements to estimate firing probabilities, while relying on conventional backpropagation for training. In this paper, we propose a novel stochastic quantum spiking (SQS) neuron model that addresses these challenges. The SQS neuron uses multi-qubit quantum circuits to realize a spiking unit with internal quantum memory, enabling event-driven probabilistic spike generation in a single shot during inference. Furthermore, we study networks of SQS neurons, dubbed SQS neural networks (SQSNN), and demonstrate that they can be trained via a hardware-friendly local learning rule, eliminating the need for global classical backpropagation. The proposed SQSNN model is shown via experiments with both conventional and neuromorphic datasets to improve over previous quantum spiking neural networks, as well as over classical counterparts, when fixing the overall number of trainable parameters, highlighting its potential for event-driven applications such as neuromorphic integrated sensing and communications (N-ISAC).
papers.comment: Published in IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有量子脉冲神经网络（quantum spiking neural networks）中依赖经典记忆机制和全局反向传播的问题，提出了一种随机量子脉冲（SQS）神经元模型，使用多量子比特电路实现内部量子记忆，推理时单次即可产生概率脉冲。进一步构建SQSNN网络，并通过硬件友好的局部学习规则训练。实验表明，在相同可训练参数数量下，SQSNN在传统和神经形态数据集上优于之前的量子脉冲网络和经典模型，突出了其在事件驱动应用（如神经形态集成感知与通信N-ISAC）中的潜力。
Motivation: 现有量子脉冲模型在单个量子比特上实现经典记忆机制，需要重复测量来估计脉冲概率，且依赖全局反向传播训练，限制了硬件效率和扩展性。
Method: 提出随机量子脉冲（SQS）神经元，使用多量子比特电路实现内部量子记忆，推理时单次测量即可产生概率脉冲。构建SQSNN网络，采用硬件友好的局部学习规则替代全局反向传播进行训练。
Result: 在传统和神经形态数据集上的实验表明，在固定可训练参数总数下，SQSNN性能优于之前的量子脉冲神经网络和经典神经网络。
Conclusion: 该模型展示了量子神经形态计算在事件驱动应用中的潜力，如神经形态集成感知与通信（N-ISAC）。

papers.title: Inclusive Federated Learning Through Compliance-Weighted Noise Allocation in Healthcare AI
papers.abstract_en: Background: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training of clinical AI models without centralizing patient data, but adoption is limited by privacy concerns, heterogeneous institutional compliance, and resource disparities; standard differential privacy (DP) applies uniform noise to all clients, penalizing well-compliant or under-resourced institutions. Objective: We introduce a compliance-aware FL framework that adapts DP to institutional compliance, letting lower-compliance sites participate without uniformly penalizing others. Methods: A compliance scoring tool aligned with HIPAA, GDPR, NIST, ISO, and HL7/FHIR maps each client score to a per-step Gaussian noise scale for server-side DP-SGD on a small aggregator dataset. The formal $(ε,δ)$ bound applies to the aggregator dataset under a semi-honest aggregator; client-level DP needs secure aggregation (future work). We evaluate five FL strategies on PneumoniaMNIST and BreastMNIST (16 clients, 50 rounds, five seeds); the cumulative aggregator-dataset $ε$ is about 1434 (Breast) and 513 (Pneumonia) at $δ=10^{-5}$. Results: Including 12 lower-compliance clients (Experiment 1) versus a compliant-only baseline (Experiment 4) changed BreastMNIST accuracy by +4.5 (FedAvg), +6.8 (FedMedian), +5.2 (FedProx), +1.6 (FedYogi), and -4.1 (FedAdam) percentage points (pooled +2.8 pp; not significant at n=5; up to +17 pp per configuration); compliance-weighted allocation matched uniform server-side DP at equal mean noise (+0.1 pp), carrying no utility penalty, and first-round noise cost 1.3 pp (Breast) and 2.5 pp (Pneumonia, FedAvg). Conclusions: Compliance-weighted server-side DP lets lower-compliance institutions join FL without degrading performance, giving auditable per-site noise control at no utility cost; formal guarantees apply to the aggregator dataset, with client-level DP requiring secure aggregation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习中差分隐私（differential privacy, DP）对合规性不同的客户端施加统一噪声导致惩罚合规良好或资源不足机构的问题，提出一种合规感知的联邦学习框架。该框架通过合规评分工具（符合HIPAA、GDPR等标准）将每个客户端的分数映射为每步高斯噪声规模，在聚合器小数据集上应用DP-SGD。在PneumoniaMNIST和BreastMNIST数据集（16客户端，50轮）上的实验表明，纳入12个低合规客户端后，准确性变化在-4.1到+6.8个百分点之间，合规加权噪声分配在相同平均噪声下与均匀DP性能相当（+0.1 pp），无效用惩罚。
Motivation: 联邦学习在医疗AI中因隐私、机构合规差异和资源不均而受限；标准DP对所有客户端加统一噪声，惩罚了合规良好或资源不足的机构。
Method: 提出合规感知FL框架：使用基于HIPAA、GDPR、NIST、ISO和HL7/FHIR的合规评分工具，将每个客户端的合规分数映射为聚合器端DP-SGD每步的高斯噪声规模，并在半诚实聚合器假设下提供形式化(ε,δ)界限。
Result: 在PneumoniaMNIST和BreastMNIST上（16客户端，50轮，5个随机种子），纳入12个低合规客户端相比仅合规客户端基线，BreastMNIST准确率变化（百分点）：FedAvg +4.5，FedMedian +6.8，FedProx +5.2，FedYogi +1.6，FedAdam -4.1；合规加权噪声分配与均匀DP在相同平均噪声下性能相当（+0.1 pp），首轮噪声代价为1.3 pp（Breast）和2.5 pp（Pneumonia, FedAvg）。
Conclusion: 合规加权的服务器端DP允许低合规机构参与FL而不降低性能，提供可审计的每站点噪声控制且无效用代价；形式化保证适用于聚合器数据集，客户端级DP需安全聚合。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fast and Accurate Image Restoration and Generation with Rank Enhanced Linear Attention
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based models have made remarkable progress in image restoration (IR) tasks. However, the quadratic complexity of self-attention in Transformer hinders its applicability to high-resolution images. Existing methods mitigate this issue with sparse or window-based attention, yet inherently limit global context modeling. Linear attention, a variant of softmax attention, demonstrates promise in global context modeling while maintaining linear complexity, offering a potential solution to the above challenge. Despite its efficiency benefits, vanilla linear attention suffers from a significant performance drop in IR, largely due to the low-rank nature of its attention map. To counter this, we propose Rank Enhanced Linear Attention (RELA), a simple yet effective method that enriches feature representations by integrating a lightweight depthwise convolution. Building upon RELA, we propose an efficient and effective Vision Transformer, named LAformer. LAformer eliminates hardware-inefficient operations such as softmax and window shifting, enabling efficient processing of high-resolution images. Extensive experiments across 7 IR tasks and 21 benchmarks demonstrate that LAformer outperforms SOTA methods and offers significant computational advantages. Furthermore, we extend LAformer to diffusion-based and flow-based visual generation, showcasing its strong potential as a competitive alternative to DiT and SiT. Code and models are available at https://github.com/shallowdream204/LAformer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Transformer在图像恢复中二次复杂度问题，提出秩增强线性注意力(RELA)，通过轻量级深度可分离卷积提升特征表示，并构建LAformer。在7个IR任务和21个基准上超越SOTA，同时扩展至扩散和流生成模型。
Motivation: 标准自注意力二次复杂度限制高分辨率图像处理，稀疏/窗口注意力牺牲全局建模；线性注意力虽复杂度线性但低秩导致性能下降。
Method: 提出秩增强线性注意力(RELA)，在注意力映射中整合轻量深度可分离卷积以丰富特征表示；基于RELA构建LAformer，去除softmax和窗口偏移等硬件低效操作。
Result: 在7个图像恢复任务和21个基准上，LAformer超越SOTA方法，并具有显著计算优势；扩展至扩散和流生成模型，展现作为DiT和SiT替代的潜力。
Conclusion: 通过RELA有效解决线性注意力低秩问题，实现高效全局建模，LAformer在高分辨率图像恢复和生成中均具竞争力。

papers.title: Kernel PCA for Out-of-Distribution Detection: Non-Linear Kernel Selection and Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-Distribution (OoD) detection is vital for the reliability of deep neural networks, the key of which lies in effectively characterizing the disparities between OoD and In-Distribution (InD) data. In this work, such disparities are exploited through a fresh perspective of non-linear feature subspace. That is, a discriminative non-linear subspace is learned from InD features to capture representative patterns of InD, while informative patterns of OoD features cannot be well captured in such a subspace due to their different distribution. Grounded on this perspective, we exploit the deviations of InD and OoD features in such a non-linear subspace for effective OoD detection. To be specific, we leverage the framework of Kernel Principal Component Analysis (KPCA) to attain the discriminative non-linear subspace and deploy the reconstruction error on such subspace to distinguish InD and OoD data. Two challenges emerge: (i) the learning of an effective non-linear subspace, i.e., the selection of kernel function in KPCA, and (ii) the computation of the kernel matrix with large-scale InD data. For the former, we reveal two vital non-linear patterns that closely relate to the InD-OoD disparity, leading to the establishment of a Cosine-Gaussian kernel for constructing the subspace. For the latter, we introduce two techniques to approximate the Cosine-Gaussian kernel with significantly cheap computations. In particular, our approximation is further tailored by incorporating the InD data confidence, which is demonstrated to promote the learning of discriminative subspaces for OoD data. Our study presents new insights into the non-linear feature subspace for OoD detection and contributes practical explorations on the associated kernel design and efficient computations, yielding a KPCA detection method with distinctively improved efficacy and efficiency.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从非线性特征子空间角度出发，利用核主成分分析（KPCA）构建判别性子空间，通过重构误差区分分布内（InD）与分布外（OoD）数据。针对核函数选择问题，揭示了两种关键非线性模式并设计余弦-高斯核；针对大规模计算挑战，提出了两种低计算成本的核近似技术，并引入置信度信息进一步优化子空间。实验表明该方法在OoD检测上显著提升了功效与效率。
Motivation: 现有OoD检测方法在非线性特征子空间中对InD和OoD差异的刻画不足，且KPCA面临核函数选择困难和大规模核矩阵计算瓶颈。
Method: 提出基于KPCA的OoD检测方法：首先分析并确立余弦-高斯核以构建判别性子空间；然后引入两种近似技术（如基于数据置信度的改进）以高效计算该核矩阵。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在OoD检测任务上实现了更优的判别性能，且计算效率大幅提升。
Conclusion: 该工作从非线性子空间角度提供了新见解，并通过核设计与近似技术的实践探索，使KPCA方法在OoD检测中兼具高效与高精度。

papers.title: RAFP: Identifying LLM Lineages via Rare-Region Fingerprints
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly released under restricted licenses, creating a growing need for robust model ownership verification. Existing fingerprinting methods are often fragile under downstream finetuning, require invasive training modifications, or fail in black-box settings. We introduce RAFP, a robust framework for identifying LLM lineages via rare-region fingerprints. Our key insight is that downstream finetuning primarily updates common high-density language behaviors, while low-probability prompt regions receive weak optimization signal and limited gradient alignment under finetuned distribution. As a result, rare prompt-response behaviors remain stable across common model adaptations. RAFP is non-invasive, constructing fingerprints via discrete gradient-based optimization over rare prompts without modifying model weights. We provide a theoretical analysis showing that the likelihood change of rare-region fingerprints under finetuning remains bounded. Experiments across four LLM families and multiple downstream adaptations, including supervised finetuning, LoRA, quantization, prompt-template variation, and decoding changes, show that RAFP achieves strong fingerprint persistence and substantially outperforms prior fingerprinting baselines in black-box settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RAFP框架，利用稀有区域指纹（rare-region fingerprints）识别大语言模型（LLM）的血缘关系。核心思想是下游微调主要更新高密度语言行为，而低概率提示区域受到优化信号弱，因此稀有提示-响应行为在常见模型适应中保持稳定。RAFP非侵入式地通过离散梯度优化构造稀有提示指纹，无需修改模型权重。理论分析表明微调下稀有区域指纹似然变化有界。实验覆盖四个LLM家族和多种下游适应（监督微调、LoRA、量化、提示模板变化、解码变化），在黑盒设置中实现强指纹持久性并显著优于基线。
Motivation: 现有LLM所有权验证方法在下游微调后脆弱、需要侵入式训练修改或无法在黑盒设置中工作。
Method: RAFP通过离散梯度优化在稀有提示区域构造指纹，不修改模型权重；理论分析证明了微调下指纹似然变化有界。
Result: 在四个LLM家族和多种下游适应场景（监督微调、LoRA、量化、提示模板变化、解码变化）中，RAFP实现强指纹持久性，并在黑盒设置中显著优于现有指纹基线。
Conclusion: 稀有区域指纹在常见模型适应中保持稳定，为LLM所有权验证提供了一种鲁棒且非侵入式的方案。

papers.title: Optimal and Provable Calibration in High-Dimensional Binary Classification: Angular Calibration and Platt Scaling
papers.abstract_en: We study the fundamental problem of calibrating a linear binary classifier of the form $σ(\hat{w}^\top x)$, where the feature vector $x$ is Gaussian, $σ$ is a link function, and $\hat{w}$ is an estimator of the true linear weight $w^\star$. By interpolating with a noninformative $\textit{chance classifier}$, we construct a well-calibrated predictor whose interpolation weight depends on the angle $\angle(\hat{w}, w_\star)$ between the estimator $\hat{w}$ and the true linear weight $w_\star$. We establish that this angular calibration approach is provably well-calibrated in a high-dimensional regime where the number of samples and features both diverge, at a comparable rate. The angle $\angle(\hat{w}, w_\star)$ can be consistently estimated. Furthermore, the resulting predictor is uniquely $\textit{Bregman-optimal}$, minimizing the Bregman divergence to the true label distribution within a suitable class of calibrated predictors. Our work is the first to provide a calibration strategy that satisfies both calibration and optimality properties provably in high dimensions. Additionally, we identify conditions under which a classical Platt-scaling predictor converges to our Bregman-optimal calibrated solution. Thus, Platt-scaling also inherits these desirable properties provably in high dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究高维高斯特征下线性二元分类器σ(ŵ^T x)的校准问题。作者通过在机会分类器与非校准分类器之间插值构建校准预测器，插值权重取决于估计权重与真实权重的角度。理论上证明了该方法在高维渐进下是校准的且Bregman最优，并阐明了Platt缩放在高维下的最优性。
Motivation: 现有校准方法在高维环境下缺乏理论保证，特别是缺乏同时满足校准性和最优性的策略。
Method: 提出角校准（angular calibration）方法，利用非信息性的机会分类器与原始分类器进行插值，插值系数由角度∠(ŵ, w⋆)决定，该角度可一致估计。
Result: 在高维样本量与特征量同阶增长下，该方法被证明是校准的且唯一Bregman最优。此外，经典Platt缩放在该设定下收敛到同一最优解。
Conclusion: 该工作首次在高维下提供了同时满足校准和最优性可证明的校准策略，并为Platt缩放的优良性质提供了理论解释。

papers.title: Toward Metaphor-Fluid Conversation Design for Voice User Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Metaphors play a critical role in shaping user experiences with Voice User Interfaces (VUIs), yet existing designs often rely on static, human-centric metaphors that fail to adapt to diverse contexts and user needs. This paper introduces Metaphor-Fluid Design, a novel approach that dynamically adjusts metaphorical representations based on conversational use-contexts. We compare this approach to a Default VUI, which characterizes the present implementation of commercial VUIs commonly designed around the persona of an assistant, offering a uniform interaction style across contexts. In Study 1 (N=130), metaphors were mapped to four key use-contexts-commands, information seeking, sociality, and error recovery-along the dimensions of formality and hierarchy, revealing distinct preferences for task-specific metaphorical designs. Study 2 (N=91) evaluates a Metaphor-Fluid VUI against a Default VUI, showing that the Metaphor-Fluid VUI enhances perceived intention to adopt, enjoyment, and likability by aligning better with user expectations for different contexts. However, individual differences in metaphor preferences highlight the need for personalization. These findings challenge the one-size-fits-all paradigm of VUI design and demonstrate the potential of Metaphor-Fluid Design to create more adaptive and engaging human-AI interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出隐喻流体设计（Metaphor-Fluid Design），根据对话使用上下文动态调整语音用户界面（VUI）的隐喻表示。通过两项用户研究（N=130 和 N=91）比较了隐喻流体 VUI 与默认 VUI（基于助手角色）的效果，发现隐喻流体设计能增强用户采用意向、享受度和喜爱度，但个体差异表明需要个性化。该工作挑战了 VUI 设计中的一刀切范式。
Motivation: 现有 VUI 设计依赖静态的、以人为中心的隐喻，无法适应多样化上下文和用户需求。
Method: 提出隐喻流体设计，根据形式性和层级维度，将隐喻映射到四个关键对话上下文（命令、信息寻求、社交、错误恢复）。通过两项用户研究评估其效果。
Result: 研究1（N=130）揭示不同上下文对隐喻设计的偏好差异；研究2（N=91）表明隐喻流体 VUI 相比默认 VUI 提升了采用意向、享受度和喜爱度。
Conclusion: 隐喻流体设计有潜力创造更适应、更引人入胜的人机交互，但个体隐喻偏好差异要求进一步个性化。

papers.title: LVMark: Robust Watermark for Latent Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Rapid advancements in video diffusion models have enabled the creation of realistic videos, raising concerns about unauthorized use and driving the demand for techniques to protect model ownership. Existing watermarking methods suffer from two key limitations: they overlook temporal consistency due to conventional watermark decoders and degrade the visual quality of the generated videos. To address these issues, we introduce a robust watermarking method for latent video diffusion models named Latent Video Diffusion Watermarking (LVMark). We propose a novel watermark decoder tailored for generated videos by learning the consistency between adjacent frames. It ensures accurate message decoding, even under malicious attacks, by combining the low-frequency components of the three-dimensional wavelet domain with the color features of the video. Additionally, we train a latent decoder to maintain the visual fidelity of the generated video. Watermarks are embedded into layers with minimal impact on visual appearance using an importance-based weight modulation strategy. We optimize both the watermark decoder and the latent decoder of diffusion model, effectively balancing the trade-off between visual quality and bit accuracy. Our experiments show that our method embeds invisible watermarks into video diffusion models, ensuring robust decoding accuracy with 512-bit capacity, even under distortions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LVMark，一种针对潜在视频扩散模型的鲁棒水印方法。通过学习相邻帧一致性的水印解码器结合三维小波域低频分量和颜色特征实现鲁棒解码，并训练潜在解码器保持视觉质量，采用重要性权重调制策略嵌入水印。实验证明方法在512位容量下实现不可见水印且对失真鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有视频水印方法忽略时间一致性且降低生成视频的视觉质量，需要能保护模型所有权同时保持高质量的方法。
Method: 提出LVMark，包含一个针对生成视频的水印解码器，通过学习相邻帧一致性，结合三维小波域低频分量和颜色特征；同时训练潜在解码器维持视觉保真度，并通过基于重要性的权重调制策略将水印嵌入对视觉影响最小的层。
Result: 实验表明，方法嵌入不可见水印，在512位容量下仍能保持鲁棒的解码准确率，即使面对各种失真攻击。
Conclusion: 通过联合优化水印解码器和潜在解码器，有效平衡了视觉质量与比特精度，为视频扩散模型提供鲁棒的水印方案。

papers.title: Enabling Energy-Efficient Simultaneous Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning through Spiking Neural Networks with Active Dendrites for Bio-inspired Generalist Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated remarkable capabilities in training agents to solve complex tasks autonomously, such as mobile robots, UAVs/UGVs, and game-playing agents). However, scaling RL to master multiple tasks simultaneously (i.e., so-called multi-task RL) remains a significant challenge. Such a multi-task RL capability especially is important for agents to adapt to changes in real-world operational environments. State-of-the-art works show that, training agents with neural networks and shared structures across tasks promises improved generalization in simultaneous multi-task RL. However, they still suffer from task interference and incur high energy consumption due to intensive computation. To address this, we propose MTSpark, a novel methodology that enables energy-efficient simultaneous multi-task RL using spiking neural networks (SNNs) equipped with active dendrites for bio-inspired generalist agents. Specifically, MTSpark enhances a Deep Spiking Q-Network (DSQN) with active dendrites, a dueling structure, and task-specific context signals to dynamically form specialized sub-networks for individual tasks, while exploiting sparse operations for energy-efficient network processing. Experimental results demonstrate that MTSpark achieves higher performance and efficiency compared to state-of-the-art by obtaining high scores across three Atari games (i.e., Pong: -5.4, Breakout: 0.6, and Enduro: 371.2), approaching human-level performance (i.e., Pong: -3, Breakout: 31, Enduro: 368), while incurring similar memory and about 2x lower energy than state-of-the-art. These results show that our MTSpark potentially advances the frontiers toward energy-efficient generalist agents by combining RL and SNNs.

Method: MTSpark增强DSQN，集成活性树突、决斗结构和任务特定上下文信号，通过稀疏操作为每个任务动态构建专用子网络，实现节能的同时多任务学习。

papers.title: Image Matching Filtering and Refinement by Planes and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: This paper provides a consistent and extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art filtering and refinement methods on common image matching pipelines. Unlike previous comparisons, the designed benchmark also takes into account the more general, real, and practical cases where camera intrinsics are unavailable. Moreover, a novel and effective strategy combining non-deep traditional computer vision approaches based on planar constraints and cross correlation is presented. Experimental analysis provides several insights for current application design and future research directions. In particular, the choice of a proper evaluation protocol discloses the effective differences within the compared solutions which otherwise would tend to flatten. Moreover, the proposed classical algorithmic approach is competitive with recent deep methods. Besides providing robust baseline using traditional computer vision for the evaluation of deep-based methods, this knowledge is useful to improve and better understand the deep image matching architectures. On one hand, geometry-based filtering is effective in presence of outliers without degrading already robust deep pipelines; on the other hand cross-correlation refinement is valid in the case of corner-like keypoints and allows to not directly discard inaccurate matches by default in deep pipelines but to retain and refine them for achieving a better coverage of the scene.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对图像匹配管线中主流的滤波与优化方法进行了一致且广泛的评估，考虑了相机内参未知的实际场景，并提出了一种结合平面约束与互相关的非深度学习策略。实验表明该传统方法在性能上与近期深度方法竞争，并揭示了深度架构中几何滤波与互相关优化的不同作用。
Motivation: 现有图像匹配评估大多假设已知相机内参，且缺乏对滤波和优化方法在实际条件下的系统比较。
Method: 设计了一个包含相机内参未知情况的基准测试，并提出一种结合平面约束（如单应性）与互相关的非深度学习滤波与优化策略。
Result: 所提传统方法在多个指标上与深度方法竞争；几何滤波有效去除离群点而不破坏稳健的深度管线；互相关优化适用于角点型特征，可保留并优化不准确匹配以提高场景覆盖。
Conclusion: 该工作为基于深度学习的图像匹配提供了传统视觉基线，并指出不同滤波/优化策略的适用场景，有助于改进和理解深度架构。

papers.title: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Deep Learning Object Detection Models on Heterogeneous Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Modern applications such as autonomous vehicles, intelligent surveillance, and smart city systems increasingly require object detection on resource-constrained edge devices. Yet, there is still limited understanding of how different object detection models behave across heterogeneous edge devices and under varying scene complexity. In this paper, we benchmark YOLOv8 (Nano, Small, Medium), EfficientDet Lite (Lite0, Lite1, Lite2), and SSD (SSD MobileNet V1, SSDLite MobileDet) on Raspberry Pi 3, 4, 5 with/without Coral TPU accelerators, Raspberry Pi 5 with AI HAT+, Jetson Nano, and Jetson Orin Nano. We evaluate energy consumption, inference time, and accuracy, and further examine how accuracy changes with the number of objects in the input image. The results reveal clear trade-offs among accuracy, latency, and energy efficiency across model-device combinations. SSD MobileNet V1 achieves the lowest latency and energy consumption but the lowest accuracy, whereas YOLOv8 Medium achieves the highest accuracy at higher computational cost. TPU-based Raspberry Pi devices improve the efficiency of SSD and EfficientDet Lite while reducing YOLOv8 accuracy. Orin Nano offers the most favorable overall balance across most model families. The object-count-based analysis further shows that models achieve more similar accuracy on simpler images, while the accuracy gap widens as scene complexity increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在多种异构边缘设备（Raspberry Pi 3/4/5、Jetson Nano/Orin Nano等）上系统评估了YOLOv8、EfficientDet Lite和SSD系列目标检测模型的推理时间、能耗和准确率，并分析了场景复杂度（图像中目标数量）对准确率的影响。结果表明SSD MobileNet V1延迟和能耗最低但准确率最低，YOLOv8 Medium准确率最高但计算成本高，Orin Nano在大多数模型系列中取得最佳综合平衡。
Motivation: 当前在资源受限边缘设备上运行目标检测的需求日益增长，但对不同模型在不同边缘设备及不同场景复杂度下的行为缺乏系统理解。
Method: 在多种边缘设备（有无TPU加速器）上基准测试YOLOv8、EfficientDet Lite和SSD系列模型，测量能耗、推理时间和准确率，并分析准确率随图像中目标数量的变化。
Result: SSD MobileNet V1延迟和能耗最低但准确率最低，YOLOv8 Medium准确率最高但计算成本高；TPU加速的Raspberry Pi设备提高了SSD和EfficientDet Lite的效率但降低了YOLOv8准确率；Orin Nano在多数模型系列中综合平衡最好；场景复杂度增加时模型间准确率差距扩大。
Conclusion: 该基准测试揭示了模型-设备组合在准确率、延迟和能效之间的明确权衡，并指出场景复杂度是影响模型相对性能的重要因素。

papers.title: Beyond Perceptual Distance: Discrepancy Assessment on Deep Representation for Out-of-Distribution Detection with Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-Distribution (OoD) detection aims to justify whether a given sample is from the training distribution of the classifier-under-protection, i.e., In-Distribution (InD), or from an unknown out distribution. Recent researches have leveraged Diffusion Models (DMs) for OoD detection due to their powerful distribution modeling capability. Given an input image, an InD-pretrained DM produces a corresponding InD-aligned counterpart, which serves as a generative reference for comparison. However, existing DM-based methods typically assess this underlying discrepancy through visual-level distances in the raw image space, which may be misaligned with the distributional discrepancy relevant to OoD detection. In this work, we investigate the fundamentals of discrepancy assessment in DM-based OoD detection, asking how the discrepancy between an input and its DM-generated counterpart should be formulated, and in which representation spaces and with which metrics it should be measured. To this end, we propose to assess the discrepancy in a classifier-relative manner by exploiting the representation spaces of the classifier-under-protection, whose training on InD data encodes rich task-relevant InD knowledge. In particular, we quantify two types of discrepancy: feature-level covariate discrepancy in deep feature representations and logit-level concept discrepancy in output logits, enabling effective differentiation between InD and OoD samples. Moreover, a subspace-based strategy is devised to refine representations of the DM generation to promote discrepancy assessment. Together, these designs form our novel detection framework, namely DDR. Extensive experiments on the challenging large-scale ImageNet-1K dataset demonstrate the superior detection performance of DDR over both DM-based and non-DM-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于扩散模型（DM）的异常检测（OoD）中，现有方法在原始图像空间计算感知距离与分布性差异不一致的问题，提出在分类器表示空间（特征层和logit层）中量化两类差异（协变量差异和概念差异），并引入子空间策略优化生成结果，构成DDR框架。在ImageNet-1K上，DDR的检测性能优于现有基于DM和非DM的方法。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的OoD检测方法通常使用原始图像空间的视觉距离来度量输入与生成图像之间的差异，但这种感知距离可能无法准确反映与OoD检测相关的分布性差异。
Method: 提出DDR框架：利用被保护分类器的表示空间来评估差异——在深度特征表示中度量特征级协变量差异，在输出logit中度量logit级概念差异；并设计子空间策略优化扩散模型生成结果的表示以增强差异评估。
Result: 在大规模ImageNet-1K数据集上的实验表明，DDR在检测性能上优于基于扩散模型和非基于扩散模型的现有方法。
Conclusion: 论文强调在分类器相关表示空间中评估差异能更有效地区分InD和OoD样本，子空间策略进一步提升了检测效果。

papers.title: Seeing Through Uncertainty: Free-Energy-Inspired Real-Time Adaptation for Robust Visual Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Navigation in the natural world is a feat of adaptive inference, where biological organisms maintain goal-directed behaviour despite noisy and incomplete sensory streams. Central to this ability is the Free Energy Principle (FEP), which posits that perception is a generative process where the brain minimises Variational Free Energy (VFE) to maintain accurate internal models of the world. While Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have served as powerful analogues for biological brains, they typically lack the real-time plasticity required to handle abrupt sensory shifts. We introduce FEP-Nav, a biologically inspired framework for real-time perceptual adaptation in robust visual navigation. Motivated by the decomposition of VFE into prediction error and Bayesian surprise, FEP-Nav combines a Top-down Decoder, which provides an internal expectation of uncorrupted sensory input, with Adaptive Normalisation, which adjusts shifted feature distributions toward prior statistics. We interpret reconstruction and normalisation as approximate mechanisms for reducing the corresponding VFE-related terms during inference without gradient-based updates. Experiments across simulated and real-world visual corruptions show that FEP-Nav restores performance lost under visual corruption, outperforming non-adaptive baselines and strong adaptive methods. These results suggest that variational principles can provide a useful design perspective for robust autonomous behaviour under degraded sensory conditions.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FEP-Nav 是一种受自由能原理启发的视觉导航框架，通过 Top-down Decoder 提供未损坏感官输入的内部期望，结合 Adaptive Normalization 调整偏移的特征分布，在推理时无需梯度更新即可减少变分自由能相关项。实验表明，该方法在模拟和真实视觉损坏条件下恢复了性能损失，优于非自适应和强自适应基线。
Motivation: 生物有机体能够在嘈杂和不完整的感官流中保持目标导向行为，而深度神经网络缺乏应对感官突变的实时可塑性，需要一种生物启发的实时感知适应机制。
Method: 提出 FEP-Nav 框架，包含 Top-down Decoder（提供内部期望的未损坏输入）和 Adaptive Normalization（将偏移特征分布调整至先验统计量），通过重建和归一化近似减少变分自由能相关项，无需梯度更新。
Result: 在模拟和真实视觉损坏实验中，FEP-Nav 恢复了因视觉损坏而损失的性能，优于非自适应基线和强自适应方法。
Conclusion: 变分原理可为退化感官条件下的鲁棒自主行为提供有用的设计视角。

papers.title: The TopCoW Challenge -- Topology-Aware Circle of Willis Segmentation for CT and MR Angiography
papers.abstract_en: The Circle of Willis (CoW) is an important network of arteries connecting major circulations of the brain. Its vascular architecture is believed to influence the risk, severity, and outcome of serious neurovascular diseases. However, characterizing the highly variable CoW anatomy remains a manual and time-consuming expert task. The CoW is commonly imaged by two non-invasive angiographic imaging modalities, magnetic resonance angiography (MRA) and computed tomography angiography (CTA), yet few datasets with annotated CoW anatomy exist, and there have been no established benchmarks for comparing CoW segmentation algorithms. We organized the TopCoW benchmark challenge alongside the release of an annotated CoW dataset with 125 paired MRA and CTA scans from the same patients. Voxel-level annotations for 13 vessel components were created using virtual reality technology and verified by clinical experts. Participants submitted algorithms for CoW segmentation and variant classification, which we evaluated on internal and external test sets comprising 226 scans from over five centers. The benchmark includes voxel-level segmentation, CoW component detection, CoW variant classification, and two clinical application tasks. We received submissions from over 250 participants across six continents. Top-performing teams achieved over 90% Dice scores for CoW segmentation, over 80% F1 scores for detecting key vessel components, and over 70% balanced accuracy in CoW variant classification across nearly all test sets. The best algorithms also supported clinically relevant downstream tasks by accurately classifying fetal-type posterior cerebral arteries and localizing aneurysms in relation to CoW anatomy. This benchmark demonstrated the utility of CoW segmentation algorithms for some downstream clinical applications with explainability.
papers.comment: Summary paper for the TopCoW Challenge: 4 figures, 1 table, and supplementary material in appendix. Accepted for publication in NEJM AI. Datasets and best-performing algorithm Dockers are available at https://zenodo.org/records/15692630 and https://zenodo.org/records/15665435
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopCoW挑战赛聚焦于脑底动脉环（Circle of Willis, CoW）的分割与变异分类，发布了125对配对MRA和CTA扫描的标注数据集。最佳算法在CoW分割上Dice超过90%，关键组件检测F1超过80%，变异分类平衡准确率超过70%，并能支持胎儿型后交通动脉分类和动脉瘤定位等临床应用。
Motivation: CoW解剖结构高度变异，目前缺乏标注数据集和分割算法的基准测试，手动标注耗时且依赖专家知识。
Method: 组织TopCoW基准挑战赛，发布125对配对MRA/CTA扫描的13个血管组件体素级标注（使用虚拟现实技术并由临床专家验证），评估分割、组件检测、变异分类及两个临床任务。
Result: 最佳方法在内部和外部测试集（共226扫描，来自5个以上中心）上实现CoW分割Dice>90%，关键组件检测F1>80%，变异分类平衡准确率>70%，并准确分类胎儿型后交通动脉和定位动脉瘤。
Conclusion: 该基准证明了CoW分割算法在可解释性下游临床应用中的实用性。

papers.title: Spectral Diffusion Processes
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have proven to be a flexible and effective framework for modelling probability distributions on finite-dimensional spaces. However, many physical modelling problems such as time series are naturally described over function spaces. In this work we apply diffusion models to such stochastic processes. To do so we consider a spectral representation of the data, obtained using a kernel, thereby dissociating the stochastic part of the processes from their space-time structure. As a result, the stochasticity of the processes is entirely encoded in the spectral coefficients, which we truncate and model using standard finite-dimensional diffusion models. By truncating the representation in the spectral domain we ensure our resulting model defines valid stochastic processes, thereby naturally satisfying consistency and exchangeability criteria. Projecting our spectral diffusion models back to the original input space, we show that for any given marginals our approach corresponds to a diffusion model with correlated noise, with explicit covariance matrix given by the kernel. We demonstrate our method's effectiveness for modelling various multimodal datasets as well as conditional sampling by amortising our models with respect to a context set.
papers.comment: This version (v3) extends the previous workshop version (v2) with conditional sampling and theoretical results. Work carried out in 2022/23. V2 appeared in Score-based Methods Workshop at the 36th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2022)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出谱扩散过程（Spectral Diffusion Processes），通过核方法将随机过程的谱表示与扩散模型结合，使模型能够定义有效的随机过程并满足一致性和可交换性。该方法通过截断谱系数并使用标准有限维扩散模型建模，同时证明其等价于具有显式协方差矩阵的相关噪声扩散模型。实验展示了在多模态数据建模和条件采样上的有效性。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型主要针对有限维空间，而许多物理建模问题（如时间序列）需要函数空间上的概率分布建模。
Method: 使用核方法对数据进行谱表示，将随机过程的随机部分与时空结构解耦，截断谱系数并用有限维扩散模型建模，投影回原空间时等价于相关噪声扩散模型。
Result: 在多种多模态数据集上验证了模型有效性，并支持基于上下文集的条件采样。
Conclusion: 谱扩散过程为函数空间上的分布建模提供了新框架，其理论和实验表明该方法能够自然处理随机过程的一致性和可交换性。

papers.title: Diversity-Enriched Option-Critic
papers.abstract_en: Temporal abstraction allows reinforcement learning agents to represent knowledge and develop strategies over different temporal scales. The option-critic framework has been demonstrated to learn temporally extended actions, represented as options, end-to-end in a model-free setting. However, feasibility of option-critic remains limited due to two major challenges, multiple options adopting very similar behavior, or a shrinking set of task relevant options. These occurrences not only void the need for temporal abstraction, they also affect performance. In this paper, we tackle these problems by learning a diverse set of options. We introduce an information-theoretic intrinsic reward, which augments the task reward, as well as a novel termination objective, in order to encourage behavioral diversity in the option set. We show empirically that our proposed method is capable of learning options end-to-end on several discrete and continuous control tasks, outperforms option-critic by a wide margin. Furthermore, we show that our approach sustainably generates robust, reusable, reliable and interpretable options, in contrast to option-critic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对选项批判（option-critic）框架中多个选项行为相似或任务相关选项数量减少的问题，本文提出多样化增强的选项批判方法。通过在任务奖励之外引入基于信息论的内在奖励，并设计新的终止目标，鼓励选项集的多样性。在多个离散和连续控制任务上的实验表明，该方法能够端到端学习选项，显著优于原始选项批判，并且生成的选项更鲁棒、可复用、可靠且可解释。
Motivation: 现有选项批判框架存在两个主要问题：多个选项学习到非常相似的行为，或任务相关选项数量萎缩，这些问题不仅破坏了时间抽象的必要性，也影响了性能。
Method: 提出一种信息论内在奖励来增强任务奖励，并设计一个新的终止目标，以鼓励选项集中行为的多样性，从而端到端学习多样化的选项。
Result: 在多个离散和连续控制任务上，该方法端到端学习选项，性能大幅优于选项批判，并且生成的选项更鲁棒、可复用、可靠且可解释。
Conclusion: 该工作通过增加选项多样性有效解决了选项批判的常见缺陷，使得时间抽象在实际任务中更加可行和有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Propheticus: Machine Learning Framework for the Development of Predictive Models for Reliable and Secure Software
papers.abstract_en: The growing complexity of software calls for innovative solutions that support the deployment of reliable and secure software. Machine Learning (ML) has shown its applicability to various complex problems and is frequently used in the dependability domain, both for supporting systems design and verification activities. However, using ML is complex and highly dependent on the problem in hand, increasing the probability of mistakes that compromise the results. In this paper, we introduce Propheticus, a ML framework that can be used to create predictive models for reliable and secure software systems. Propheticus attempts to abstract the complexity of ML whilst being easy to use and accommodating the needs of the users. To demonstrate its use, we present two case studies (vulnerability prediction and online failure prediction) that show how it can considerably ease and expedite a thorough ML workflow.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the 30th IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE) 2019
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Propheticus是一个机器学习框架，旨在简化可靠和安全软件预测模型的开发。它通过抽象ML复杂性并提供易用性，帮助用户创建预测模型。论文通过漏洞预测和在线故障预测两个案例展示了框架能够简化和加速ML工作流程。
Motivation: 软件开发日益复杂，需要支持可靠和安全软件部署的创新解决方案。机器学习在可靠性领域有应用，但使用复杂且易出错，需要简化其使用流程。
Method: 提出了Propheticus框架，抽象机器学习复杂性，使其易于使用，并满足用户需求。通过两个案例研究（漏洞预测和在线故障预测）演示其使用。
Result: 两个案例研究表明Propheticus能够显著简化和加速完整的机器学习工作流程。
Conclusion: Propheticus降低了机器学习在可靠和安全软件预测建模中的使用门槛，有望支持更广泛的部署。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Partial Identification with Multiple Nonlinear Measurements of a Latent Regressor
papers.abstract_en: We study linear regression when the regressor is latent and observed only through multiple noisy measurements, each a smooth but possibly nonlinear function of the latent variable. The problem is acute in the measurement of occupational exposure to artificial intelligence, where competing scores yield downstream estimates that differ by a factor of eleven. A regression on any single measurement recovers a source-specific coefficient rather than the structural one. We fix the latent scale by requiring the consensus measurement function to be linear and bound the remaining curvature heterogeneity across sources relative to slope. Under this bound, the structural coefficient lies in a closed-form interval centered at a symmetric cross-source estimator. The interval is invariant to unknown source loadings, and its half-width is second order in the curvature bound and sharp to the same order. With at least four measurements, the bound is estimable from the joint distribution of the sources through a split-instrument auxiliary regression, and Imbens-Manski confidence intervals with the Stoye critical value attain uniform coverage over the curvature class, including at the point-identified boundary. The application matches six exposure measures to an American Community Survey panel of 8.88 million person-year observations for 2015 to 2024. The post-2022 employment coefficient changes sign between the language-model measures and the Webb patent-text measure, and an ex ante factor-analytic rule separates the Webb measure as a distinct construct. The five retained sources yield a loading-invariant consensus coefficient of -0.239, with a partial-identification half-width of 1.23 percent of the point estimate, or 1.88 percent at the one-sided 95 percent upper bound on the curvature. We read the application as measurement reconciliation rather than as a causal estimate of AI displacement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究当回归变量是潜变量且仅通过多个非线性噪声测量观测时，线性回归的偏识别问题。作者通过假设共识测量函数为线性并约束曲率异质性，得到结构系数的闭式区间，该区间对称于跨源估计量且半宽度是曲率边界的二阶量。应用在2015-2024年美国社区调查的888万人年数据中，六个AI暴露测量指标中五个保留的源产生载荷不变的共识系数-0.239，偏识别半宽度为点估计的1.23%。文章强调这是测量协调而非因果估计。
Motivation: 当潜回归变量仅通过多个非线性测量观测时，单个测量回归得到的是源特定系数而非结构系数；例如AI职业暴露的不同测量导致下游估计相差11倍，需要一种方法在存在测量异质性时识别结构系数。
Method: 假设共识测量函数为线性，并基于曲率异质性的有界性，推导出结构系数的闭式区间，该区间对称于跨源估计量且半宽度为曲率边界的二阶量；当至少有四个测量时，曲率边界可从联合分布通过分裂工具辅助回归估计，并使用Imbens-Manski置信区间和Stoye临界值获得均匀覆盖。
Result: 在888万人年观测中，六个AI暴露测量中五个保留的源产生载荷不变的共识系数-0.239，偏识别半宽度为点估计的1.23%（单侧95%上界为1.88%）。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种在多个非线性测量下进行测量协调的框架，而非因果估计；区间估计对未知源载荷不变，且半宽度是曲率边界的二阶量。

papers.title: Good Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Good tasks are correct, solvable, verifiable, well-specified, and hard for interesting reasons. The best tasks describe a real problem an experienced practitioner would recognize, in language a practitioner would use, with tests that verify the outcome rather than the approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出了衡量基准测试任务质量的五个标准：正确性、可解性、可验证性、良好指定性和有趣的困难性。最好的任务描述的是经验丰富的实践者认可的真实问题，并以验证结果而非方法的方式测试。
Motivation: 现有基准测试任务设计缺乏明确指导，论文旨在明确什么是好的任务，以帮助研究者构建更有意义的评估。
Method: 论文通过归纳提出五个属性定义好的任务，并强调任务描述应使用实践者语言，测试应验证结果而非方法。
Result: 无实验或定量结果，属于概念性讨论。
Conclusion: 好的基准测试应基于实践者认可的真实问题，并通过结果导向的测试来评估。

papers.title: RCWT: Measuring Task-Budget Displacement from Coordination Content in LLM Calls
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent and memory-augmented LLM systems often place coordination content, shared state, prior discussion, tool outputs, summaries, and role instructions, inside the same finite prompt used for the current task. This creates a practical allocation problem: every token spent on coordination is unavailable to task instructions or evidence when a call is assembled under a fixed context budget. We introduce the Roundtable Context Window Test (RCWT), a controlled protocol for measuring this task-budget displacement effect. RCWT varies coordination content while controlling total budget, position order, task family, and scoring. In the main context-dependent recall task at $W=4096$, three commercial models remain near baseline through moderate overhead and then degrade sharply once residual reference evidence falls to a few hundred tokens. Window-scaling summaries are consistent with a task-specific residual-budget interpretation rather than a fixed percentage threshold, but we treat this as descriptive evidence rather than a universal law. To test whether the fixed-budget cliff persists when task evidence remains intact, we add an intact-task ablation: the full task/reference block is kept present while coordination tokens increase by expanding total prompt length. In that setting, all tested calls return every scored field correctly across GPT-4.1-mini, Claude Haiku 4.5, and Gemini 2.5 Flash up to a 95\% coordination ratio. This ablation narrows the claim: the main RCWT cliff is best read as task-budget displacement, not as proof that coordination volume alone causes semantic interference in the original open-ended task. RCWT is therefore a measurement primitive for context-allocation budgeting, not a complete theory of multi-agent benefit or session-level coordination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出圆桌上下文窗口测试（RCWT），用于测量LLM调用中协调内容（共享状态、先前讨论、工具输出等）对任务预算的位移效应。在W=4096的上下文依赖召回任务中，三个商业模型在中等协调开销下保持基线，随后当剩余参考证据降至几百token时性能急剧下降。任务证据完整保留的消融实验表明，主要悬崖效应由任务预算位移引起，而非协调体积直接导致语义干扰。
Motivation: 多智能体和内存增强的LLM系统将协调内容与任务指令放在同一有限提示中，导致token分配问题：每个用于协调的token在固定上下文预算下无法用于任务指令或证据。本文旨在系统测量这种任务预算位移效应。
Method: 提出RCWT协议，通过变化协调内容量同时控制总预算、位置顺序、任务族和评分，在上下文依赖召回任务中评估模型表现。并设计了任务证据完整保留的消融实验。
Result: 在W=4096的主任务中，三个模型在中等协调开销下保持基线，随后当剩余参考证据降至几百token时性能急剧下降。在保持任务证据完整的消融中，所有模型在协调比例达95%时仍正确返回所有字段。
Conclusion: RCWT是一种上下文分配预算的测量原语，而非多智能体收益或会话级协调的完整理论。主要悬崖效应由任务预算位移引起，而非协调体积直接导致语义干扰。

papers.title: Fine-Tuned Multi-Agent Framework for Detecting OCEAN in Life Narratives
papers.abstract_en: Accurately assessing personality from text is challenging because traits are latent, context-dependent, and often subtly expressed across long narratives. Large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities by processing extensive textual contexts, but pretraining of these models can induce latent "personality-like" biases, making single-model inferences inconsistent. We propose a fine-tuned multi-agent framework for detecting OCEAN personality traits, in which sub-agents are conditioned to adopt high, low, or neutral perspectives for each trait through masked language modeling (MLM) and psychometric supervision. A judge LLM aggregates and compares sub-agent outputs to generate final trait predictions, capturing multiple complementary perspectives while mitigating individual model biases. We evaluate the framework on life narrative dataset through quantitative and qualitative experiments, including baselines, ablations, and inference quality analyses. Our approach offers a scalable and interpretable method for text-based personality inference, highlighting the benefits of multi-agent reasoning grounded in psychometric supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个微调的多智能体框架（fine-tuned multi-agent framework），用于从生活叙事文本中检测OCEAN人格特质。通过掩码语言建模（MLM）和心理测量监督，子智能体采用高、低或中性视角，由法官LLM聚合输出。在生活叙事数据集上评估，展示了可扩展性和可解释性。
Motivation: 准确从文本中评估人格具有挑战性，因为特质是潜在的、上下文依赖的，且LLM预训练可能引入人格类偏见，导致单模型推理不一致。
Method: 提出微调的多智能体框架，子智能体通过MLM和心理测量监督采用不同视角，法官LLM聚合比较子智能体输出，生成最终预测。
Result: 在生活叙事数据集上进行定量和定性实验，包括基线、消融和推理质量分析，展示了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了可扩展和可解释的文本人格推理，突出了基于心理测量监督的多智能体推理的优势。

papers.title: The Benjamini--Hochberg Procedure Can Fail to Control the FDR for Correlated Two-Sided Gaussian Tests
papers.abstract_en: We show that the Benjamini--Hochberg procedure can fail to control the false discovery rate (FDR) at its nominal level for correlated two-sided Gaussian $p$-values. We construct a factor model for which, at level $α=0.01$, a rigorous interval-arithmetic certificate proves $FDR>0.0104$ for all sufficiently large numbers of hypotheses. This disproves a conjecture widely believed to be true for twenty years. Monte Carlo experiments are consistent with the theoretical result. The proof was obtained by GPT-5.6 Pro and carefully checked by the author.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明Benjamini-Hochberg程序在相关双侧高斯p值下无法在名义水平上控制FDR。构造因子模型，在α=0.01时严格证明FDR>0.0104，否定了流行20年的猜想。蒙特卡洛实验支持理论结果，证明由GPT-5.6 Pro获得并经作者核实。
Motivation: 挑战广泛相信的BH程序在相关检验下仍能控制FDR的猜想，实际发现反例。
Method: 构造因子模型，利用区间算术严格证明FDR下界。
Result: 在α=0.01时，FDR>0.0104，超出名义水平。
Conclusion: BH程序在相关双侧高斯检验中可能失效，需谨慎使用。

papers.title: RegHead: Non-Humanoid Head Blendshapes via Feed-Forward Registration
papers.abstract_en: We present RegHead, a framework for constructing semantic blendshape sets for animatable non-humanoid head avatars. With a fixed expression vocabulary, semantic blendshapes provide a low-dimensional and interpretable animation interface and support cross-identity retargeting. Building such blendshape sets remains expensive because (i) expression-consistent supervision is scarce, (ii) generated 4D assets typically lack correspondence, and (iii) facial motion is highly localized. We propose (1) a large-scale dataset of non-humanoid identities paired with a shared expression vocabulary, obtained by expanding a small artist-rigged library via fine-tuned image editing; (2) a dense stochastic anchor motion representation tailored to localized facial deformations; and (3) a fast feed-forward registration model that converts unregistered expression meshes into a corresponded blendshape basis by predicting anchor-based deformations from the neutral shape. Experiments show that our approach produces higher-fidelity expression meshes than baselines, while running orders of magnitude faster than optimization. We further demonstrate real-time retargeting from human face tracking signals to non-humanoid characters, capturing both head pose and localized facial motions. Our project page is available at https://snap-research.github.io/RegHead/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RegHead 框架，用于构建可动画的非人形头部头像的语义 blendshape 集合。通过扩展小规模艺术家制作的库生成大规模数据集，设计密集随机锚点运动表示，并训练快速前馈配准模型，将未配准的表情网格转换为对应的 blendshape 基。实验表明该方法比基线产生更高保真度的表情网格，且速度比优化方法快多个数量级，并实现了从人脸跟踪信号到非人形角色的实时重定向。
Motivation: 构建非人形头部头像的语义 blendshape 集合成本高昂，原因包括表情一致的监督数据稀缺、生成的 4D 资产缺乏对应关系，以及面部运动高度局部化。
Method: 提出三种贡献：(1) 通过微调图像编辑扩展小型艺术家库，构建大规模非人形身份与共享表情词汇配对的数据集；(2) 提出密集随机锚点运动表示，专门处理局部面部变形；(3) 训练快速前馈配准模型，通过从中性形状预测锚点变形，将未配准的表情网格转换为对应的 blendshape 基。
Result: 方法在表情网格保真度上优于基线，运行速度比优化方法快多个数量级；实现了从人脸跟踪信号到非人形角色的实时重定向，包括头部姿态和局部面部运动。
Conclusion: 该框架为可动画的非人形头部头像提供了高效、保真的 blendshape 生成方案，支持跨身份重定向和实时应用。

papers.title: Forgetful Attention: A Trainable Support-Vector Memory with Certified Selection and Exact Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Attention can be viewed as an online learner over context, yet existing test-time memories cannot certify that dropping a token leaves outputs unchanged or delete its influence outright. We introduce Support Vector Attention (SV-Attention), a max-margin memory whose weights are support coefficients of a one-class SVM with fixed box parameter C. Its active-set partition gives reserve tokens exactly zero weight, certifying output-preserving eviction; a reversible incremental solver deletes a token to recover the state produced by retraining without it under the same C. In fp64 experiments, decrement and refit recover identical partitions whenever the optimum is unique, and their decision functions match to a median deviation of about 10^-9 (10^-13 on learned keys); the 10^-2 worst case is confined to ill-conditioned duplicates and remains below coefficient decay in every regime. The exact path reuses the maintained KKT inverse in a custom backward. Training uses a separate stabilized batched approximation and does not carry the exact-deletion certificate; it reaches 9,125 tokens/s on a 3.22M-parameter model, while remaining 35.8 times slower than an MPS softmax reference. At matched budgets, certified selection reaches 0.86 vs. 0.32 rare-item recall and retains 0.80 vs. 0.05 deterioration hours on real MIMIC-IV streams. We also demonstrate surgical forgetting, exact editing, patient-record deletion, and a forgettable retrieval memory over real sentence embeddings. On enwik8, the hybrid obtains 2.178 BPC vs. 2.383 for a matched-state sliding-window Transformer across seven seeds (8.6% paired improvement, p=0.001); a three-seed TinyStories result is directionally positive but not significant (p=0.057).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出支持向量注意力（SV-Attention），一种基于最大间隔记忆的注意力机制，其权重由单类SVM的支持系数决定，能够证明剔除某个token后输出不变，并通过可逆增量求解器实现精确遗忘。在fp64实验中，递减和重新训练得到的分区一致，决策函数的中位偏差约10^-9；在enwik8上，混合模型获得2.178 BPC，优于滑动窗口Transformer的2.383 BPC（p=0.001）。
Motivation: 现有测试时记忆无法证明丢弃一个token后输出不变或彻底删除其影响，缺乏可认证的遗忘机制。
Method: 将注意力权重视为单类SVM的支持系数，利用主动集划分使保留token权重为零，实现可认证的逐出；通过可逆增量求解器删除一个token并恢复无该token时的状态。
Result: 在fp64实验中，递减和重新训练得到相同分区，决策函数中位偏差约10^-9；在enwik8上，混合模型获得2.178 BPC，比滑动窗口Transformer提升8.6%（p=0.001）；在MIMIC-IV流上，认证选择达到0.86罕见项召回率，而基线为0.32。
Conclusion: SV-Attention提供了可认证的精确遗忘能力，在保持性能的同时支持手术级遗忘和编辑，适用于需要可控遗忘的检索和序列建模任务。

papers.title: A Threshold Exceedance Framework for CBRN Uplift Evaluation in Frontier Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As frontier language models advance, policymakers and model developers need methods for assessing whether model access materially increases a non-expert actor's ability to plan high-consequence Chemical, Biological, Radiological, or Nuclear (CBRN) misuse relative to public tools alone. Existing CBRN evaluations differ in non-expert definitions, threat scope, baselines, scoring rubrics, and decision rules, making results difficult to compare across studies. We introduce a Threshold Exceedance Criteria (TEC) framework that decomposes an uplift study into independently executable components: determining non-expert participant eligibility, defining the CBRN threat scope for the study, and statistically estimating material uplift. We then operationalize the TEC framework in a large-scale empirical study using a design that determines two forms of uplift: generative (where a model assists plan creation from scratch) and revisionist (where a model assists refinement of an existing plan). The study produced attack plans across the CBRN domains, which we evaluated through subject-matter-expert review to estimate generative and revisionist uplift. Applying the framework, our empirical study revealed domain heterogeneity: under this controlled pre-release evaluation, model-assisted plans sometimes received expert-equivalent instructional ratings, but confirmed material uplift was limited to the radiological domain. These findings informed mitigation and deployment-governance decisions rather than characterizing deployed model behavior. We conclude with methodological lessons for future CBRN uplift evaluations, emphasizing prespecified criteria, explicit baselines, separation of generative and revisionist estimates, and careful distinction between preliminary screening signals and confirmed risk determinations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个阈值超越准则（TEC）框架，用于评估前沿语言模型在化学、生物、辐射、核（CBRN）领域对非专家用户的提升（uplift）。通过大规模实证研究，将提升分为生成性（从零创建计划）和修正性（完善现有计划）两种，发现模型辅助在某些领域（如放射学）产生了实质性提升，但整体上受控预发布评估中确认的提升有限。结论强调了预设标准、明确基线、区分生成性和修正性估计等未来评估的方法学建议。
Motivation: 现有CBRN提升评估方法在非专家定义、威胁范围、基线、评分规则和决策标准上不统一，导致结果难以跨研究比较，亟需一个标准化的框架来系统评估模型访问是否显著增加非专家行动者的高风险计划能力。
Method: 提出了阈值超越准则（TEC）框架，将提升研究分解为独立可执行的组件：确定非专家参与者资格、定义CBRN威胁范围、统计估计实质性提升。在大规模实证研究中，设计了两种提升形式（生成性和修正性），并通过主题专家评审评估攻击计划以估计提升。
Result: 实证研究揭示了领域异质性：在受控预发布评估中，模型辅助的计划有时获得专家等效的指导评级，但确认的实质性提升仅限于放射学领域。这些发现用于指导缓解和部署治理决策，而非描述已部署模型的行为。
Conclusion: 未来CBRN提升评估应强调预设标准、明确基线、分离生成性与修正性估计，并仔细区分初步筛选信号与确认的风险判定。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 实证研究揭示了领域异质性：在受控预发布评估中，模型辅助的计划有时获得专家等效的指导评级，但确认的实质性提升仅限于放射学领域。这些发现用于指导缓解和部署治理决策，而非描述已部署模型的行为。
summary_sections.conclusion: 未来CBRN提升评估应强调预设标准、明确基线、分离生成性与修正性估计，并仔细区分初步筛选信号与确认的风险判定。

papers.title: Comparing Semantic Navigation in Humans and Large Language Models using Natural Language Processing
papers.abstract_en: Semantic memory retrieval can be conceptualized as navigation through conceptual space. We compared semantic search dynamics between humans and three large language models (GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Pro, Claude-Sonnet-4.5) using verbal fluency data. By applying trajectory-based NLP metrics to the items generated by 82 human participants and LLM output across eight temperature settings, we quantified three complementary dimensions: entropy (step size predictability), distance to next (successive semantic steps), and distance to centroid (global dispersion). Humans exhibited higher entropy, larger semantic steps and broader dispersion than all LLMs, indicating more variable and exploratory search. Temperature tuning produced only partial alignments, as individual metrics matched between humans and LLMs at specific settings, but no configuration reproduced the complete human profile (in all dimensions). These findings suggest that human semantic search implements a distinctive balance between local exploitation and global exploration that current model architectures fail to reproduce.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过言语流畅性任务比较人类与三种大型语言模型（GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Pro, Claude-Sonnet-4.5）在语义空间中的导航行为。使用基于轨迹的自然语言处理指标（熵、到下一个的距离、到质心的距离）量化搜索动态，发现人类表现出更高的熵、更大的语义步长和更广的分散性，且温度调节无法完全复现人类模式。
Motivation: 语义记忆检索可类比为概念空间的导航，但大型语言模型是否具有类似人类的语义搜索动态尚不清楚。
Method: 收集82名人类被试和8个温度设置下LLM输出的言语流畅性数据，应用轨迹式NLP指标（熵、连续语义步长、全局分散度）进行量化比较。
Result: 人类在所有三个维度上均高于所有LLM；温度调节仅能在个别维度上匹配人类表现，但无法同时匹配全部三个维度。
Conclusion: 人类语义搜索表现出局部利用与全局探索之间的独特平衡，当前模型架构无法复现这一特征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Compos3D: Interactive Part-Based Composition for Creative Control in Generative 3D Models
papers.abstract_en: While generative AI has unlocked new opportunities for 3D content creation, current workflows often rely on multiple regenerations, which provides limited control and unpredictable outcomes. We present Compos3D, a system that introduces a compositional workflow for generative 3D modeling through remixing. Instead of repeatedly regenerating models, users generate multiple candidates from text or image prompts, select parts of interest via 2D image regions or 3D mesh segments, and assemble them into a coherent design. The system synthesizes these compositions into a refined 3D model, preserving high-level intent while resolving low-level geometry. To evaluate this approach, we conducted a controlled user study comparing remixing and regeneration workflows across both 2D and 3D modalities. Results show that the remixing workflow provides participants with greater creative control, stronger alignment with their intent, and higher satisfaction. We conclude with design recommendations for future AI-assisted 3D modeling workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Compos3D系统，通过基于部件组合的工作流实现生成式3D建模中的创意控制。用户从文本或图像提示生成多个候选模型，选择感兴趣的部分（2D图像区域或3D网格片段），并将其组装成连贯的设计。系统将这些组合合成精炼的3D模型，保留高层意图同时解决低层几何问题。受控用户研究显示，与再生工作流相比，组合工作流提供了更强的创意控制、意图一致性和满意度。
Motivation: 当前生成式3D内容创建工作流依赖多次再生，提供有限的控制和不可预测的结果，缺乏灵活的创意控制机制。
Method: 提出Compos3D系统，采用组合工作流：用户从文本/图像提示生成多个候选模型，通过2D图像区域或3D网格片段选择感兴趣部件，系统将其合成精炼的3D模型。
Result: 受控用户研究显示，组合工作流相比再生工作流在创意控制、意图对齐和满意度上均更优。
Conclusion: 组合式工作流为生成式3D建模提供了更好的创意控制，并为未来AI辅助3D建模工作流提出了设计建议。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cost-Governed RAG: Unified Per-Tenant Cost Attribution Across Retrieval and Generation in Multi-Tenant LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) deployments face a critical governance gap: while LLM generation cost is metered per token, the retrieval layer - vector memory, similarity compute, and embedding API calls - remains an unattributed shared cost, enabling invisible cross-subsidization among tenants. We present Cost-Governed RAG, an architecture that integrates a codebook-oblivious vector index (TurboVec) with a multi-tenant LLM governance gateway, creating a unified observability stack where embedding, retrieval, and generation costs are jointly attributable per tenant. The architecture exploits TurboVec's deterministic, closed-form memory formula to enable near-exact per-tenant retrieval cost calculation - a property unavailable in graph-based indexes with non-linear memory overhead. Deployed on Snowpark Container Services within a cloud data platform's governance boundary, the system achieves 99.96% end-to-end cost attribution accuracy across 100 simulated tenants (10M vectors, log-normal size distribution) with telemetry overhead below 0.04% of query latency. The architecture reduces retrieval infrastructure cost by 3.1-9.0x compared to managed vector database services under the pricing assumptions detailed in Section IV. We formalize a three-layer cost model and demonstrate that codebook-oblivious quantization enables deterministic per-tenant cost attribution while also removing the shared-codebook leakage surface present in trained quantizers - the latter observation being exploratory and subject to the limitations described in Section VII.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Cost-Governed RAG 架构，通过集成码本无关的向量索引（TurboVec）与多租户 LLM 治理网关，实现嵌入、检索和生成成本的每租户统一归因。在 100 个模拟租户（1000 万向量）上达到 99.96% 端到端成本归因准确率，遥测开销低于查询延迟的 0.04%，并将检索基础设施成本降低 3.1-9.0 倍。
Motivation: 企业 RAG 部署中，生成成本按 token 计量，但检索层（向量内存、相似度计算、嵌入 API）是共享未归因成本，导致租户间隐形交叉补贴，存在治理缺口。
Method: 提出 Cost-Governed RAG 架构，集成码本无关向量索引 TurboVec 与多租户治理网关，利用 TurboVec 确定性闭合形式内存公式实现近似精确的每租户检索成本计算，并形式化三层成本模型。
Result: 在 Snowpark Container Services 上部署，100 个模拟租户（1000 万向量，对数正态分布）上达到 99.96% 端到端成本归因准确率，遥测开销低于查询延迟的 0.04%，检索基础设施成本降低 3.1-9.0 倍。
Conclusion: 该架构实现了每租户成本透明归因，并消除了训练量化器中的共享码本泄露风险，但后者为探索性发现，受限于文中第七节所述条件。

papers.title: Overview of Cross-Component In-loop Filters in Video Coding Standards
papers.abstract_en: In-loop filters have been comprehensively explored during the development of video coding standards due to their remarkable noise-reduction capability. In the early stage of video coding, in-loop filters, such as Deblocking Filter, Sample Adaptive Offset, and Adaptive Loop Filter, were performed separately for each component. Recently, cross-component filters were studied to improve the chroma fidelity by exploiting correlations between the luma and chroma channels. This paper summarizes the cross-component filters used in the state-of-the-art video coding standard. Specifically, it includes the Cross-Component Adaptive Loop Filter and Cross-Component Sample Adaptive Offset. Cross-component filters aim to reduce compression artifacts based on the correlation between different components and provide more accurate pixel reconstruction values. In this paper, we introduce the origin, development, and status of cross-component filters in the current video coding standards. Finally, we had some discussions on the further evolutions of cross-component filters.
papers.comment: This paper was submitted and accepted by ZTE Communications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了视频编码标准中的跨分量环路滤波器，重点介绍跨分量自适应环路滤波器（CC-ALF）和跨分量样本自适应偏移（CC-SAO），阐述其起源、发展及在最新标准中的应用，并讨论未来演进方向。
Motivation: 视频编码中环路滤波器对降噪至关重要，早期对各分量独立滤波，近期利用亮度与色度通道相关性的跨分量滤波器可提升色度保真度，但缺乏统一梳理。
Method: 系统总结了跨分量自适应环路滤波器（CC-ALF）和跨分量样本自适应偏移（CC-SAO）的设计原理、标准演进及实现差异，并展望了未来改进方向。
Conclusion: 跨分量滤波器通过利用分量间相关性减少压缩伪影，提升像素重建精度，未来可向联合优化、机器学习辅助等方向发展。

papers.title: TRAIL: A Platform for Configurable Human--AI Teaming Experiments
papers.abstract_en: An AI teammate's design properties (personality, communication style, when it speaks) can shape a team's trust, coordination, and decisions. Studying this rigorously demands infrastructure no existing tool provides: reproducible configuration of an AI teammate embedded in instrumented, real-time collaboration sustained over time. We present the Team Research and AI Integration Lab (TRAIL), a web platform that makes the AI teammate a configurable, reproducible design object, pairing a Big Five persona with a selective-participation message pipeline, dual memory, chained longitudinal experiments, and export-ready analytics. In a real six-session classroom deployment (about 51 students), TRAIL sustained longitudinal chaining, held the AI to a stable minority of the conversation, and enabled export-driven AI-human text-similarity analysis. A single blind persona change produced a design-consistent double dissociation: a cognitive-scaffolding agent drew stronger contribution ratings and closer linguistic alignment; a socially-supportive agent, a warmer team climate and lower over-reliance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍TRAIL平台，一个用于可配置人机协作实验的Web平台，支持AI队友的可重复配置（大五人格、选择性参与消息管道、双记忆、链式纵向实验），并通过真实课堂部署验证其有效性。实验表明，认知支架型AI获得更高贡献评分和语言对齐，而社会支持型AI营造更温暖团队氛围并减少过度依赖。
Motivation: 现有工具无法提供可重复配置的AI队友嵌入实时协作环境的能力，阻碍了对AI设计属性（如人格、沟通风格）如何影响团队信任、协调和决策的严格研究。
Method: 构建TRAIL平台，将AI队友作为可配置可重复的设计对象，集成大五人格、选择性参与消息管道、双记忆、链式纵向实验和可导出分析功能。
Result: 在约51名学生的六次课堂部署中，平台成功维持纵向链式实验，AI对话占比稳定在少数，并支持导出驱动的文本相似性分析。单盲人格改变产生设计一致的双重分离：认知支架型AI获得更高贡献评分和更近语言对齐，社会支持型AI带来更温暖团队氛围和更低过度依赖。
Conclusion: TRAIL平台为人机协作实验提供了可配置、可重复的基础设施，并验证了AI人格设计对团队动态的因果影响。

papers.title: Modeling the response of the marine carbon cycle to extreme CO$_2$ injection events
papers.abstract_en: We explore how the response of a conceptual model of the marine carbon cycle depends on the way in which carbon is injected from the atmosphere. We find that, for single-injection pulses, the threshold amount required for a large response of the excitable system depends on pulse duration but not on its specific form. We do, however, see differences in the number of large transient responses in carbon and, correspondingly, the duration of the response for different pulse shapes. These differences are magnified as the system is pushed towards increased excitability and can be understood in terms of the geometry of an increasingly winding heteroclinic orbit. Inspired by Large Igneous Provinces (LIPs), we also consider random sequences of injection pulses. We find a wide range of possible responses for a given overall amount injected and duration, depending on the mean characteristics of the individual pulses. We also identify a resonance-like "Goldilocks" zone, in which intermediate pulse durations or arrival frequencies produce the largest number of repeated transients, and we test the framework with illustrative scenarios motivated by the Siberian Traps and Columbia River Basalt Group.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究一个概念性的海洋碳循环模型对大气中不同方式注入二氧化碳的响应。发现对于单次注入脉冲，引发系统大响应所需的阈值取决于脉冲持续时间而非具体形式；随机脉冲序列下存在类似共振的“金发姑娘”区，脉冲持续时间或到达频率适中时产生最多重复瞬态响应。以西伯利亚暗色岩和哥伦比亚河玄武岩群为背景进行了情景测试。
Motivation: 理解海洋碳循环对极端CO2注入事件（如大火成岩省引发的气候事件）的响应机制，探讨不同注入方式对系统行为的影响。
Method: 使用概念性海洋碳循环激发系统模型，分别分析单次脉冲和随机脉冲序列下的响应，借助异宿轨道几何解释瞬态响应模式。
Result: 单次脉冲阈值由持续时间决定，不同脉冲形状影响瞬态响应次数和持续时间；随机序列下存在“金发姑娘”区，中间脉冲持续时间或到达频率产生最多重复瞬态。
Conclusion: 系统对CO2注入的响应依赖于脉冲的时间结构而非总量，随机序列效应可被共振现象放大，为理解过去气候剧变提供理论框架。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 研究一个概念性的海洋碳循环模型对大气中不同方式注入二氧化碳的响应。发现对于单次注入脉冲，引发系统大响应所需的阈值取决于脉冲持续时间而非具体形式；随机脉冲序列下存在类似共振的“金发姑娘”区，脉冲持续时间或到达频率适中时产生最多重复瞬态响应。以西伯利亚暗色岩和哥伦比亚河玄武岩群为背景进行了情景测试。
summary_sections.motivation: 理解海洋碳循环对极端CO2注入事件（如大火成岩省引发的气候事件）的响应机制，探讨不同注入方式对系统行为的影响。
summary_sections.method: 使用概念性海洋碳循环激发系统模型，分别分析单次脉冲和随机脉冲序列下的响应，借助异宿轨道几何解释瞬态响应模式。
summary_sections.result: 单次脉冲阈值由持续时间决定，不同脉冲形状影响瞬态响应次数和持续时间；随机序列下存在“金发姑娘”区，中间脉冲持续时间或到达频率产生最多重复瞬态。
summary_sections.conclusion: 系统对CO2注入的响应依赖于脉冲的时间结构而非总量，随机序列效应可被共振现象放大，为理解过去气候剧变提供理论框架。

papers.title: The Emerging Paradigm of Geospatial Foundation Models: From Pre-Training to Agentic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: The analysis of satellite and aerial imagery has entered a new era with the advent of foundation models. This paper describes the concept of Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs), which are artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) models pre-trained on massive geospatial datasets through varied methodologies. We first articulate the core paradigm shift that GeoFMs enable: a separation of duties, where large-scale model providers perform the computationally intensive pretraining, allowing domain experts to rapidly fine-tune or prompt these models for specific, mission-critical tasks. This approach democratizes access to state-of-the-art AI/ML while maintaining the security and confidentiality of the downstream task. We then explore the novel capabilities unlocked by different types of GeoFMs, distinguishing between the finetunable vision models produced by self-supervised techniques like masked auto-encoding, and the vision-language models produced by contrastive learning which enable zero-shot tasks like open-vocabulary image analysis. Next, we discuss the practical considerations for operationalizing GeoFMs, from performance-cost analysis to the broader MLOps ecosystem. To that end, we introduce a taxonomy of model adaptation strategies and propose a framework for domain experts to select the most cost-effective adaptation approach for their particular mission set. Finally, we present a forward-looking vision of Agentic Geospatial Reasoning, where Large Language Models act as intelligent orchestrators, leveraging GeoFMs as tools to answer high-level user queries in natural language and automate complex analytical workflows, moving the field from perception to cognition.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统阐述了地理空间基础模型 (GeoFMs) 的新兴范式，涵盖从大规模预训练到下游任务微调/提示的流程，并区分了自监督视觉模型与对比学习视觉-语言模型的各自能力。文章还讨论了运营化时的成本性能权衡及模型适配策略分类，最后展望了以大语言模型为编排器的智能地理空间推理 (Agentic Geospatial Reasoning) 愿景。
Motivation: 卫星与航空影像分析进入基础模型时代，但领域专家面临预训练计算成本高、模型选择与适配复杂等挑战，亟需一个统一框架指导 GeoFMs 的有效利用。
Method: 通过文献综述与概念分析，提出 GeoFMs 的范式：预训练-微调/提示分离；对微调型视觉模型（如掩码自编码）与零样本视觉-语言模型（如对比学习）进行分类；引入模型适配策略分类法及成本效益选择框架；最后展望智能体推理架构。
Result: 论文未提供实验数据，但给出了一个系统性的概念框架与分类法，用于指导领域专家根据任务需求选择最经济的 GeoFM 适配策略。
Conclusion: GeoFMs 将推动地理空间分析从感知向认知跃迁，其中大语言模型作为智能编排器可结合 GeoFMs 工具实现自然语言驱动的复杂分析流程。

papers.title: A Calibrated Multimodal Ensemble for Ambivalence/Hesitancy Recognition: System Description and Private-Test Submission Strategy
papers.abstract_en: Ambivalence and hesitancy (A/H) undermine digital behaviour-change interventions, and recognizing them automatically from video is the goal of the ABAW A/H challenge on the BAH dataset. We describe our system for the 11th edition of the challenge: a calibrated, equal-weight ensemble of three fusion models over frozen face, audio, text, and pose embeddings, which reaches 0.7358 macro-F1 on the public test set. This year's private test, released on a disjoint set of 30 new participants, is scored on five allowed submissions; we report the configuration and rationale of each of our five submissions, and, where already available, the private-test score obtained. Our first submission, an exact replica of the calibrated ensemble tuned only on public validation, scored 0.7361 macro-F1 on the private test, matching our public-test estimate almost exactly and confirming the pipeline generalizes to unseen participants without leakage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对ABAW A/H挑战赛，提出一个校准的等权多模态集成系统，融合冻结的面部、音频、文本和姿态嵌入，在BAH数据集上达到0.7358 macro-F1。系统在私有测试集上表现一致（0.7361 macro-F1），验证了泛化能力。
Motivation: 矛盾/犹豫（A/H）行为会削弱数字行为干预的效果，从视频中自动识别A/H是ABAW挑战的目标，现有方法在跨参与者泛化上存在挑战。
Method: 采用三个融合模型的校准等权集成，分别处理冻结的面部、音频、文本和姿态嵌入，并在公共验证集上调整校准。
Result: 公共测试集macro-F1为0.7358，私有测试集（30名新参与者）上首个提交版本得分为0.7361，表明方法具有良好的泛化性。
Conclusion: 系统在未见参与者上表现稳定，证明了流水线的通用性和无泄漏。

papers.title: From Reconstruction to Interpretation: Zero-Setup Multi-Phase Segmentation of X-ray Tomography Data
papers.abstract_en: X-ray tomography enables nondestructive characterization of material microstructures, while advances in micro-CT imaging have accelerated volumetric data acquisition and reconstruction. However, rapid interpretation remains limited by image segmentation, which often requires manual thresholding, user prompting, or material-specific model training. We present a zero-setup framework for multi-phase segmentation of synchrotron X-ray tomography data that generates interpretable masks for previously unseen datasets without user input or retraining during deployment. The framework combines a material-agnostic mask preparation strategy with a pretrained semantic segmentation network. It represents commonly occurring structural regions as background, sample, bright, dark-gray, light-gray, and porosity masks. Unlike conventional deep learning pipelines that require dataset-specific annotations and retraining, the proposed framework can be applied directly to new scans and produce diagnostic-level segmentations within minutes of reconstruction. This enables rapid assessment of scan quality, sample morphology, porosity, and attenuation variations during ongoing beamline experiments. The generated masks can later be manually refined or used to fine-tune application-specific models when greater accuracy or material-specific labeling is required. Evaluation on held-out synchrotron micro-CT images and qualitative testing on additional datasets demonstrate consistent and physically meaningful segmentations across varying samples and imaging conditions. The framework also substantially outperforms conventional intensity-based thresholding. By connecting high-speed reconstruction with immediate interpretation, the approach supports near-real-time beamline feedback and scalable AI-assisted scientific imaging workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个零设置的框架，用于同步辐射X射线断层扫描数据的多相分割，无需用户输入或重新训练即可生成可解释的分割掩码。该框架结合了材料无关的掩码准备策略与预训练的语义分割网络，将常见结构区域表示为背景、样本、亮、暗灰、亮灰和孔隙度掩码。评估表明，在保留的同步辐射显微CT图像上，该框架优于传统的基于强度阈值的方法，支持近实时的束流线反馈和可扩展的AI辅助科学成像工作流。
Motivation: X射线断层扫描数据的分割通常需要手动阈值、用户提示或特定材料模型训练，限制了快速解释。现有方法无法在无需用户输入或重新训练的情况下直接应用于新扫描数据。
Method: 提出一个零设置框架，由材料无关的掩码准备策略和预训练语义分割网络组成。该框架自动生成六类掩码（背景、样本、亮、暗灰、亮灰、孔隙度），无需数据集特定标注或再训练。
Result: 在保留的同步辐射显微CT图像上，该框架生成一致且物理上有意义的分割，显著优于传统强度阈值方法。定性测试表明跨不同样本和成像条件的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该框架通过连接高速重建与即时解释，支持近实时束流线反馈和可扩展的AI辅助科学成像工作流，生成的掩码可后续手动精炼或用于微调特定应用模型。

papers.title: Decentralized Gradient Descent: Bottleneck Regimes and Budget Complexity
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized gradient descent (DGD) is widely used for solving distributed optimization problems over networks of agents. While its convergence properties are well understood, less is known about the communication and computation resources required to attain a prescribed accuracy. In this paper, we study DGD from a resource-aware perspective and characterize the communication-computation budget required to attain a target error level. We develop a bottleneck-centric framework in which different factors dominate the optimization dynamics at different error scales. Specifically, we identify operating regimes governed by initialization, objective heterogeneity and network connectivity, gradient noise, and communication noise. To capture these effects, we introduce two fundamental quantities: the gradient-Diversity-to-Network-connectivity Ratio (DNR) and the Gradient-to-Communication-noise Ratio (GCR). We show that these quantities determine the sequence of bottlenecks encountered during optimization and the corresponding budget-optimal operating strategy. Using a multi-stage analysis, we derive optimal stepsize selections and explicit budget-complexity bounds that quantify the budget resources required to attain a prescribed accuracy. The resulting expressions reveal how the overall budget decomposes into contributions associated with successive bottlenecks and provide insight into the fundamental tradeoffs among objective heterogeneity, network connectivity, gradient noise, and communication noise.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Theory
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文从资源感知角度研究分布式梯度下降（DGD），提出以瓶颈为中心的框架，通过引入梯度多样性-网络连接比（DNR）和梯度-通信噪声比（GCR）来刻画不同误差尺度下的主导因素，并推导最优步长选择和显式预算复杂度界。
Motivation: 尽管DGD的收敛性质已被充分研究，但达到给定精度所需的通信和计算资源（预算）尚不明确。
Method: 建立瓶颈中心框架，识别初始化、目标异质性与网络连接、梯度噪声、通信噪声等主导区域；引入DNR和GCR量，进行多阶段分析，推导最优步长和显式预算复杂度界。
Result: 推导的预算复杂度界揭示了总预算如何分解为连续瓶颈的贡献，并揭示了目标异质性、网络连接、梯度噪声和通信噪声之间的基本权衡。
Conclusion: 该工作为DGD的资源预算提供了理论表征，有助于设计预算最优的操作策略。

papers.title: Self-Consistent Flow: Unifying Velocity and Endpoint Prediction for Rectified Flow Models
papers.abstract_en: In rectified-flow-based generative models, the neural network can be trained to predict two different targets, such as the instantaneous velocity or the data endpoint, to perform denoising. Although prior work shows that these parameterizations lead to different empirical behaviors, the mechanisms underlying their respective advantages remain to be underexplored, and how to combine them effectively is still unclear. In this work, we analyze how learning errors from different parameterizations affect the generation performance. We show that predicting the data endpoint has a clear training signal that stabilizes training, whereas predicting the velocity maintains stable sampling dynamics near the data manifold. Motivated by these insights, we propose Self-Consistent Flow (SC-Flow), a new method that unifies the benefits of both parameterizations. By employing a lightweight consistency loss, SC-Flow jointly trains a single network to predict both the local velocity and the data endpoint, and the consistency between the two predictions improves the model's performance. The method requires no major architectural changes and adds minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on image generation tasks demonstrate that SC-Flow substantially stabilizes optimization and improves the straightness of generation paths, leading to significant gains in generation quality over standard rectified-flow baselines.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了rectified flow生成模型中速度预测和端点预测两种参数化的优缺点，发现端点预测提供清晰训练信号稳定优化，而速度预测在数据流形附近保持稳定采样。基于此提出Self-Consistent Flow (SC-Flow)，通过轻量级一致性损失联合训练单个网络同时预测局部速度和数据端点，在图像生成任务上稳定优化、改善路径直线性，显著提升生成质量。
Motivation: 现有rectified flow模型中不同参数化各有优势但机制不明，缺乏有效融合方法。
Method: 分析两种参数化训练误差对生成性能的影响，提出SC-Flow，使用一致性损失联合训练单个网络同时预测速度和端点。
Result: 在图像生成任务上，SC-Flow稳定优化、改善生成路径直线性，显著提升生成质量。
Conclusion: 无需重大架构变化，计算开销小，有效统一两种参数化优势。

papers.title: From Geometric Recovery to Causal Validation: A Reproducible Audit of Sparse Autoencoder Features, from Superposition Geometry to Causal Inertness
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are the standard for decomposing superposed neural representations into interpretable features, and evaluation relies predominantly on correlational recovery metrics -- cosine similarity between ground-truth directions and decoder atoms. We show this conflates two distinct claims: decoder-geometry alignment and encoder-activation behavior. We reproduce the superposition phase diagram of Elhage et al. (2022), identifying a convergence artifact at high sparsity and an under-described diffuse sharing regime at extreme overcompleteness. We reproduce the TopK-versus-L1 comparison of Gao et al. (2024), with direct evidence of L1 shrinkage. Our central result is causal: subjecting every recovered feature to ablation and steering, we find up to 77% of features passing a recovery bar (cosine >= 0.90) in a degraded SAE -- and 9% in a well-trained one -- are causally inert: the matched atom never fires when the feature is present, including matches at cosine ~1.000. We package the method as sae-causal-audit, a model-agnostic instrument with a deterministic pipeline. Re-auditing refines the finding: inertness decomposes by cause into structural inertness (antipodal-pair geometry, present in good SAEs) and competitive inertness (a TopK pathology of degraded SAEs), and by direction into read- and write-inertness, which five antipodal pairs dissociate completely -- unmonitorable yet steerable through the same atom, with steering specificities of 143-310 attached to zero ablation effects. We document why byte-exact reproducibility is unavailable by construction, and propose reporting it as a stack of claims with explicit scopes. Applying the instrument to a production SAE reproduces the pattern at small scale (14% inert) and surfaces an atom-collision signal: a handful of atoms recur as the nearest match for dozens of unrelated concepts, replicated across three batches.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）常用于分解神经网络的叠加表示，但传统评估指标（余弦相似度）混淆了几何对齐和编码器实际激活行为。本文复现了叠加相图，发现高稀疏度下的收敛伪影和过度完备下的扩散共享机制；复现了TopK与L1比较，直接证实L1收缩。核心因果发现：在退化SAE中，高达77%通过恢复标准（余弦≥0.9）的特征是因果惰性的（causally inert），在良好训练的SAE中为9%，即使余弦接近1.000也可能惰性。惰性被分解为结构性惰性（良好SAE中的反向对几何）和竞争性惰性（退化SAE的TopK病理），以及读写方向，五对反向对可完全解耦。作者发布sae-causal-audit工具，并指出字节级精确复现不可行，应报告为带有明确范围的声明栈。
Motivation: 现有SAE评估主要依靠相关性恢复指标（如余弦相似度），但这些指标无法区分解码器几何对齐与编码器实际激活行为，因此无法判断特征是否真正因果有效，需要引入因果验证方法。
Method: 通过复现Elhage等人（2022）的叠加相图和Gao等人（2024）的TopK与L1比较实验，引入标准化的因果验证流程：对每个恢复的特征执行消融（ablation）和操控（steering），检测其因果惰性。将惰性分类为结构性惰性和竞争性惰性，并区分读写方向。整体打包为模型无关的确定性工具sae-causal-audit。
Result: 在退化SAE中，77%通过余弦≥0.9的特征是因果惰性的；在良好训练的SAE中为9%。惰性现象存在于高相似度匹配（余弦~1.000）中。五对反向对（antipodal pairs）可完全解耦读写惰性，操控特异性（steering specificity）高达143-310但消融效应为零。在小型生产SAE上复现出14%惰性，并观察到原子碰撞信号。
Conclusion: 作者强调字节级精确复现因构造原因不可行，建议将结果报告为带有明确范围的声明堆栈。通过sae-causal-audit工具验证了因果惰性普遍存在，为SAE评估提供了因果维度。

papers.title: Data Safety: Synthetic Data Quality Analysis Using CIFAKE Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Recently, the societal implementation of high-performance image classification models has expanded rapidly. While these models require vast amounts of training data to improve performance, securing sufficient real images is often impractical. As a means to compensate for this shortage, the use of synthetic data is becoming widespread. However, synthetic images are not necessarily equivalent to real images for training purposes. This study systematically analyzes the differences between two types of synthetic images created by different generation methods and real images from three perspectives: high-dimensional feature space, low-level statistics in color space, and the model training process. Furthermore, it experimentally verifies how synthetic data should be utilized by considering realistic data mixing scenarios. This enables the proposal of an evaluation and application strategy for performing preliminary assessments on synthetic images of unknown quality and safely incorporating them into training. This research aims to contribute to enhancing the reliability and safety of image classification models utilizing synthetic images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统分析了不同生成方法产生的合成图像与真实图像在高维特征空间、颜色空间低层统计和模型训练过程中的差异，并通过数据混合实验验证了合成数据的有效利用方式，提出了对未知质量合成图像进行预评估并安全融入训练的策略，旨在提升利用合成图像的图像分类模型的可靠性和安全性。
Motivation: 高性能图像分类模型需要大量训练数据，但获取足够的真实图像往往不现实，合成数据被广泛使用但其与真实图像的等效性尚不明确，需要系统分析合成数据的质量差异并制定安全应用策略。
Method: 从高维特征空间、颜色空间低层统计和模型训练过程三个角度对比两种不同生成方法产生的合成图像与真实图像，通过数据混合实验模拟实际场景，提出合成图像质量预评估与安全整合策略。
Result: 实验揭示了合成图像与真实图像在各维度的具体差异，并给出了在数据混合中如何有效利用合成图像的建议，为安全应用合成数据提供了依据。
Conclusion: 研究为提升利用合成图像的图像分类模型可靠性和安全性提供了评估与应用框架，但未涉及具体数值结果或特定模型表现。
