papers.title: How Query Visibility Changes KV-Cache Compression Rankings: A Matched-Budget Audit
papers.abstract_en: KV-cache compression methods are predominantly evaluated with the query appended to the context before compression -- a query-aware protocol. Yet the economic case for a compressed KV cache is reuse: compress a document once, answer many future questions against it. In that deployment, compression must happen query-agnostic -- before any question is seen. We present a matched-budget audit of six published compression methods against three trivial baselines on three open 7-9B models (144,300 paired evaluations on RULER-8192; 40,800 on LongBench; 50,000-resample paired bootstrap throughout). Everything is held fixed -- model, compression ratio, instances, decoding -- except the scoring rule. Three findings. (1) Query visibility changes the rankings: under the agnostic protocol, of the five audited methods that share a common attention backend, only KeyDiff beats a best-of-3 trivial baseline consistently (31 of 36 cells), and the most widely deployed method, SnapKV, loses to "keep the start and the recent window" on average (-0.066). (2) The per-method drop between the two protocols is ordered consistently with how visible the question is to each method's scoring signal, legible in its source code: from Delta=+0.198 for SnapKV (the question sits inside its 64-token observation window) down to Delta=+0.011 for KeyDiff (its score contains no query term at all).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计了查询可见性对KV缓存压缩方法排名的影响。在查询不可见（query-agnostic）协议下，5种共享注意力后端的方法中只有KeyDiff一致优于最佳-3平凡基线；SnapKV平均输给简单基线；方法间的性能下降与其代码中对查询的可见性一致。
Motivation: 现有KV缓存压缩评估假设查询可见（query-aware），但实际部署中压缩需在查询前完成（query-agnostic），导致评估与使用场景不匹配，需重新审计排名。
Method: 对6种已发表压缩方法和3个平凡基线，在3个7-9B模型上执行匹配预算审计，固定模型、压缩比、实例和解码，仅改变评分规则（查询可见 vs 不可见），使用配对bootstrap（RULER-8192上144300对；LongBench上40800对）。
Result: 查询可见性改变排名：在agnostic协议下，仅KeyDiff在31/36个单元中一致优于best-of-3基线；SnapKV平均比简单基线差0.066。方法间性能下降幅度与查询可见性顺序一致（SnapKV下降0.198，KeyDiff下降0.011）。
Conclusion: 结论强调KV缓存压缩评估应考虑实际部署中查询不可见的情形，且查询可见性显著影响方法排名，现有报告可能高估了某些方法。

papers.title: GenDiff: A Dose and Anatomy Aware Diffusion Model with Structural Prior Refinement for Low-Dose CT Reconstruction and Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Computed tomography (CT) is a critical imaging modality for clinical diagnosis, but reducing radiation dose inevitably introduces severe noise and structured artifacts that degrade image quality. Existing deep learning-based low-dose CT (LDCT) reconstruction methods are typically optimized for fixed dose levels or specific anatomical regions, limiting their robustness and generalization in realistic clinical settings. We propose GenDiff, a generalizable diffusion-based framework for LDCT reconstruction that jointly models continuous radiation dose and anatomical information within a unified reconstruction network. The proposed framework integrates a Dose-Anatomy Encoder to learn acquisition-aware embeddings, a dose- and anatomy-conditioned cold diffusion backbone for iterative refinement, a physics-consistency update to enforce fidelity to the CT forward model, and a Structural Prior Refinement Module (SPRM) that preserves anatomical structures while suppressing dose-dependent artifacts. Extensive experiments on multi-anatomy clinical datasets, including unseen ultra-low-dose conditions as well as out-of-distribution phantom and animal datasets, demonstrate that GenDiff consistently outperforms state-of-the-art convolutional neural network and diffusion-based reconstruction methods. The proposed approach achieves superior reconstruction quality while maintaining strong robustness across different dose levels, anatomical regions, and acquisition domains, making it a promising solution for practical low-dose CT imaging.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Under review at PeerJ Computer Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GenDiff，一个基于扩散的可泛化框架用于低剂量CT重建，联合建模连续辐射剂量和解剖信息。方法集成剂量-解剖编码器、条件冷扩散主干、物理一致性更新和结构先验细化模块。在包含未见超低剂量和分布外数据集的实验中，GenDiff在重建质量和鲁棒性上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法通常针对固定剂量或特定解剖区域优化，缺乏泛化能力。实际临床中剂量水平和解剖区域变化大，需要鲁棒且可泛化的重建方法。
Method: 提出GenDiff框架，包含：1) 剂量-解剖编码器学习获取感知嵌入；2) 剂量和解剖条件冷扩散迭代细化；3) 物理一致性更新强制符合CT前向模型；4) 结构先验细化模块(SPRM)在抑制剂量相关伪影的同时保持解剖结构。
Result: 在多解剖临床数据集、未见超低剂量条件以及分布外幻影和动物数据集上，GenDiff一致优于最先进的CNN和扩散重建方法，实现优越的重建质量和强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该方法在跨剂量水平、解剖区域和采集域中保持鲁棒性，是实用低剂量CT成像的有前景解决方案。

papers.title: CARE-LoRA: Compressed Activation REconstruction for Memory-Efficient LoRA
papers.abstract_en: As the scale of large pre-trained models continues to grow, fine-tuning them under limited memory budgets has become increasingly challenging. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), currently one of the most widely adopted parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, mitigates this challenge by optimizing only low-rank adaptation matrices, thereby greatly reducing the number of trainable parameters. With the parameter overhead substantially reduced, the activations retained for backpropagation have emerged as the primary remaining memory bottleneck during LoRA fine-tuning. To address this, we propose CARE-LoRA, a data-aware Compressed Activation REconstruction framework. By exploiting the inherent projection structure of LoRA, CARE-LoRA replaces the full input activation with the low-rank compressed activation naturally produced by the LoRA branch. It further computes a lightweight reconstruction matrix during the forward pass with negligible additional computation cost, which is used during backpropagation to reconstruct the gradient signal, thereby keeping LoRA matrices fully trainable. Extensive experiments across diverse models and downstream tasks demonstrate that, while substantially reducing the overall memory footprint, CARE-LoRA achieves competitive or even superior performance compared with standard LoRA and representative LoRA variants. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/fishandyu/CARE-LoRA .
papers.comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 12 tables. Code available at https://github.com/fishandyu/CARE-LoRA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARE-LoRA 提出一种数据感知的压缩激活重建框架，利用 LoRA 的投影结构，用低秩压缩激活替代完整输入激活，并计算轻量重建矩阵用于反向传播，从而大幅减少微调时的内存占用。实验表明，在多种模型和任务上，该方法在节省内存的同时性能与标准 LoRA 相当或更优。
Motivation: LoRA 虽大幅减少可训练参数，但反向传播保留的激活项成为内存瓶颈。本文旨在解决这一瓶颈，实现更高效的内存利用。
Method: 提出 CARE-LoRA，通过 LoRA 分支自然产生的低秩压缩激活替代完整输入激活，并在前向过程中计算轻量重建矩阵，用于反向传播重建梯度信号，从而保持 LoRA 矩阵完全可训练。
Result: 大量实验证明，CARE-LoRA 显著降低总内存占用，并在多种模型和下游任务上达到与标准 LoRA 及代表变体相当或更优的性能。
Conclusion: CARE-LoRA 是一种有效且内存高效的 LoRA 微调方法，可推广至不同规模的预训练模型。

papers.title: TSCA-Net: Temporal-Spatial Clique Attention for Interpretable Multimodal Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate pedestrian trajectory prediction in crowded environments remains challenging due to the multimodal uncertainty of human motion and the variable complexity of motion dynamics across different scene contexts. Existing goal-conditioned models rely on static displacement structures that assign equal weight to all historical time steps, standard graph attention mechanisms, and fixed-capacity motion decoders that cannot adapt to local prediction complexity. To address these limitations, we propose TSCA-Net, a trajectory prediction framework built upon three complementary modules. The Temporal-Spatial Clique Attention (TSCA) module introduces learnable temporal gating into clique-based goal-history interaction, enabling time-aware modulation of historical observations relative to each candidate goal. The Cross-Pedestrian Clique Potential (CPCP) module models asymmetric pairwise agent relationships through a dynamic clique potential framework with a time-varying social graph. The Adaptive KAN Grid Refinement (AKGR) mechanism dynamically adjusts the B-spline grid resolution of a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network-augmented LSTM decoder based on per-agent goal distribution entropy, balancing model expressiveness against overfitting across varying motion complexities. Extensive experiments on the ETH/UCY and Stanford Drone Dataset benchmarks demonstrate that TSCA-Net achieves state-of-the-art performance, with average ADE/FDE of 0.13/0.20 m on ETH/UCY and 6.95/10.43 pixels on SDD. Comprehensive ablation studies confirm the complementary contributions of all three proposed modules.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to the IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM) 2026, Applied Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出TSCA-Net框架用于多模态行人轨迹预测，通过时间-空间团注意（TSCA）模块引入可学习时间门控，跨行人团势（CPCP）模块建模动态社会图，自适应KAN网格细化（AKGR）模块根据目标分布熵调整LSTM解码器网格分辨率。在ETH/UCY和SDD基准上达到平均ADE/FDE 0.13/0.20米和6.95/10.43像素，消融实验验证三个模块的互补贡献。
Motivation: 现有行人轨迹预测方法在拥挤场景中面临多模态不确定性，且静态位移结构、标准图注意力和固定容量解码器无法适应局部预测复杂性。
Method: 提出三个互补模块：TSCA模块利用可学习时间门控实现团内目标-历史交互的时间感知；CPCP模块通过动态团势和时间变社交图建模非对称成对关系；AKGR模块根据每个智能体目标分布熵动态调整KAN增强LSTM的B样条网格分辨率。
Result: 在ETH/UCY和SDD基准上取得最优性能，平均ADE/FDE分别为0.13/0.20米和6.95/10.43像素。
Conclusion: 三个模块的整合有效提升了轨迹预测在多模态和变复杂度场景下的表现，但代码和真实世界部署的泛化性尚未在摘要中讨论。

Singular Value Decomposition and Principal Component Analysis 4. Linear Regression and Regularization 5. Graphs, Networks, and Clustering 6. Nonlinear Dimension Reduction and Diffusion Maps 7. Linear Dimension Reduction via Random Projections 8. Optimization for Data Science 9. Classification 10. A Mathematical Introduction to Deep Learning 11. Large Sample Limit of Graph Laplacians 12. Community 13. Concentration of Measure and Gaussian Analysis 14. Matrix Concentration Inequalities 15. Compressive Sensing and Sparsity 16. Low-Rank Matrix Recovery
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本书系统介绍了数据科学的数学基础，涵盖高维空间特性、奇异值分解、主成分分析、线性回归、正则化、图与网络聚类、非线性降维、随机投影、优化、分类、深度学习导论、图拉普拉斯大样本极限、社区发现、测度集中与高斯分析、矩阵浓度不等式、压缩感知与稀疏性、低秩矩阵恢复等16个章节。
Motivation: 数据科学缺乏统一的数学理论框架，本书旨在整合相关数学工具，为数据科学的理论研究和应用提供系统性基础。
Method: 全书以教材形式组织，从高维几何、线性代数、概率论、优化等基本工具出发，逐步引入各类数据科学方法的数学原理。
Result: 无实验数据，作为教材，本书覆盖了数据科学核心领域的数学理论。
Conclusion: 本书为数据科学领域的数学基础提供了全面而系统的介绍，适合作为研究生教材或科研参考。

papers.title: Mirror Horizon: Viable Path Entropy as a Measure of Bounded Reflection
papers.abstract_en: Mirror Theory proposes that an intelligent system should be studied not only by what it represents, but by what coherent continuations it can sustain under repeated reflection. We make this claim operational through \emph{viable path entropy} (VPE), a finite-budget measure of verified continuation capacity. Given a mirror state, a rollout protocol, a verifier, and a mode map, VPE decomposes bounded capability into two parts: the probability of reaching a viable continuation and the diversity of verified continuation modes reached among successful rollouts. This paper restores the full theoretical scaffold behind the measure: intuition as local underdetermining constraint, taste as invariant-selecting pressure, reflection as taste-guided resolution of underdetermination, and geometry as the learned structure that makes future reflection stable. We then instantiate the theory in language-model reasoning experiments on GSM8K. Across Qwen2.5-Instruct models, 32 sampled rollouts per problem, and two reflection horizons, increasing the token budget from 96 to 160 substantially expands verified reachability, reduces zero-reachability, increases verified-mode entropy, and improves smoothed VPE. At 160 tokens, Qwen2.5-1.5B realizes the strongest mirror horizon among the tested models, even though Qwen2.5-3B has more parameters. This shows that mirror horizon is not parameter count, but accessible verified continuation capacity under a bounded reflection protocol. The result supports Mirror Theory as a measure-level account: capability is the structure of viable continuations made reachable, not merely one-shot accuracy or pass@k.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“可行路径熵”(VPE)作为衡量有限反射下智能系统能力的指标。VPE通过两个部分分解有限能力：达到可行续写的概率以及成功rollout中已验证续写模式的多样性。在GSM8K上使用Qwen2.5-Instruct模型进行实验，结果表明增加token预算会显著提高已验证的可达性、减少零可达性、增加已验证模式熵并改善平滑VPE。其中Qwen2.5-1.5B在160 token下实现了最强的镜像视界，表明镜像视界不是参数数量，而是在有限反射协议下可访问的已验证续写能力。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注智能系统表示什么，但缺乏对系统在反复反思下能维持的一致续写能力的度量。本文旨在将镜像理论中的能力概念操作化为一个可计算的度量。
Method: 提出可行路径熵(VPE)，给定镜像状态、rollout协议、验证器和模式映射，VPE将有限能力分解为达到可行续写的概率与成功rollout中到达的已验证续写模式的多样性两部分。
Result: 在GSM8K上，使用Qwen2.5-Instruct模型，每问题32个采样rollout，两个反射水平，当token预算从96增至160时，已验证可达性大幅提升，零可达性减少，已验证模式熵提高，平滑VPE改善。Qwen2.5-1.5B在160 token下获得最强镜像视界，优于参数更多的Qwen2.5-3B。
Conclusion: 镜像视界不是参数数量，而是在有限反射协议下可访问的已验证续写能力。该结果支持镜像理论作为度量层面的解释：能力是可达的可行续写的结构，而不仅仅是一次性准确率或pass@k。

papers.title: Qubit-Efficient Quantum Search for Hyperdimensional Decomposition via Logarithmic Encoding
papers.abstract_en: Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC) represents symbols using high-dimensional hypervectors of dimension $D$. In hypervector decomposition, the objective is to recover $F$ constituent hypervectors, each drawn from a codebook of size $N$, from a bound target hypervector. This requires searching over $N^F$ candidate tuples, making the task computationally prohibitive at scale. Recent quantum approach provides a quadratic search advantage, but typically rely on qubit-inefficient $O(D)$-qubit hypervector representations. We propose a qubit-efficient quantum framework for HDC decomposition that reduces the representation cost to $O(\log D)$. The framework introduces logarithmic hypervector and binding encodings, together with a reversible hypervector lookup operator for circuit-level manipulation of dense hypervectors. Combined with a modified Dürr-Høyer search procedure, the method preserves $O(\sqrt{N^F})$ search complexity while substantially reducing qubit usage. Experimental results validate correct similarity computation, accurate decomposition in executable regimes, and significantly improved qubit scaling over baselines based on explicit $D$-qubit hypervector encodings, achieving up to $2{,}000\times$ fewer qubits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种量子比特高效的量子搜索框架，用于超维计算中的超向量分解。通过引入对数编码和可逆超向量查找算子，将量子比特需求从O(D)降低到O(log D)，同时保持O(√(N^F))的搜索复杂度。实验验证了正确性、分解准确性以及高达2000倍的量子比特节省。
Motivation: 现有超维计算分解需要搜索N^F个候选元组，经典计算代价高昂；量子方法虽提供二次加速，但依赖O(D)量子比特的超向量表示，量子比特效率低。
Method: 提出量子比特高效的量子框架，包含对数超向量和绑定编码、可逆超向量查找算子，以及改进的Dürr-Høyer搜索过程。
Result: 在可执行规模下验证了正确相似度计算和准确分解，相对于基于显式D量子比特编码的基线，量子比特数量减少达2000倍。
Conclusion: 该方法有效降低了超维分解的量子比特需求，同时保持量子搜索加速优势，适用于近期量子硬件。

papers.title: Transforming LLMs into Efficient Cross-Encoders via Knowledge Distillation for RAG Reranking
papers.abstract_en: Cross-encoders achieve high reranking accuracy in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines but impose quadratic inference costs that limit real-time deployment. We address this by fine-tuning LLaMA 3 (8B) as a drop-in reranker using a two-stage pipeline: supervised fine-tuning on a custom query-document relevance dataset via the Unsloth framework with LoRA adapters, followed by 4-bit quantization for efficient inference. The resulting model replaces the cross-encoder in a dual-retriever RAG pipeline combining BM25 and dense vector search. Evaluated on a domain-specific question-answering benchmark using the RAGAS framework, our fine-tuned LLaMA 3 reranker achieves gains of 14% in answer relevancy, 16% in context precision, 19% in answer similarity, and 21% in answer correctness over the cross-encoder baseline, while reducing inference overhead through 4-bit quantization. These results demonstrate that instruction-tuned LLMs can be adapted into accurate, efficient rerankers without the quadratic complexity of traditional cross-encoders.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. This work was completed in 2024
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Repairing Shape-Prior Shortcuts in Long-Range Single-Shot Fringe Projection Profilometry
papers.abstract_en: Single-shot fringe projection profilometry (FPP) networks that regress depth directly can exploit a shape-prior shortcut, recovering depth from object boundaries rather than from fringe phase. On a photorealistic synthetic benchmark (15,600 fringe images, 50 objects at 1.5-2.1 m standoff), the best such UNet baseline plateaus at 14.54 mm object mean absolute error (MAE), and neither more data nor more capacity removes the shortcut, because neither changes the hypothesis space the optimizer searches. We introduce PhiCalNet, which outputs a wrapped-phase representation $(\sinφ, \cosφ)$ and maps it to depth through a fixed differentiable calibration layer, removing the shape-prior solution architecturally rather than by a loss penalty. Because the single-shot mapping is non-injective without fringe order, PhiCalNet takes the fringe order as auxiliary input, an assumption a sensitivity analysis shows tolerates realistic decoding error; a physics-informed (PINN) baseline with the same physics as a soft penalty yields no gain, isolating the architectural choice as the operative factor. PhiCalNet reduces object MAE 3.3x to 4.46 mm, its residual confined to 0.103% of pixels at the $\pmπ$ wrap discontinuity, and a three-frame extension reaches 1.16 mm. Two checks agree: interpretability makes phase the most decodable internal feature, and pixel-wise conformal uncertainty quantification, to our knowledge the first for FPP, localizes error at the same discontinuity, where rejecting the top 5% of pixels by snapshot disagreement cuts root-mean-square error by 64% versus 3.5% for the baseline.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 8 figures. Part 2 of a two-part study. Part 1 (diagnosis): arXiv:2606.17093
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对单次条纹投影轮廓术（FPP）中深度回归网络利用形状先验捷径（从物体边界而非条纹相位恢复深度）的问题，提出PhiCalNet。该网络输出包裹相位表示并通过固定可微标定层映射到深度，从架构上消除捷径。在合成基准上，PhiCalNet将物体平均绝对误差（MAE）从14.54 mm降至4.46 mm，且残差集中在包裹相位不连续处。
Motivation: 现有单次FPP深度回归网络会利用形状先验捷径，即从物体边界而非条纹相位恢复深度，导致性能瓶颈。增加数据或模型容量无法解决，因为改变的是优化空间而非假设空间。
Method: 提出PhiCalNet，输出包裹相位表示 (sinφ, cosφ)，通过固定可微标定层将其映射为深度，从而从架构上消除形状先验解。由于单次映射非单射，需要辅助输入条纹阶次，且通过敏感性分析证明其耐受实际解码误差。

Conclusion: 论文强调通过架构设计（而非损失惩罚）消除形状先验捷径是提升单次FPP精度的关键。所提方法在合成数据上有效，但未在真实系统上验证。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Source Retinal Fluid Segmentation in OCT
papers.abstract_en: Measuring retinal fluid from optical coherence tomography (OCT) drives treatment decisions in macular disease, but manual annotation is slow and segmentation models trained on one scanner degrade on another. We present an attention-guided TransUNet that segments three fluid types across four independent OCT sources, combining a domain-adaptive normalisation scheme with an uncertainty estimate that flags unreliable pixels. The model reaches a mean fluid Dice of 0.78, and -- most usefully for clinicians -- its uncertainty is 1.34x higher exactly where expert graders disagree (p<10^-4), turning a raw segmentation map into an actionable clinical triage signal.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Code, model weights, and REST inference API are available on GitHub and Zenodo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种注意力引导的TransUNet，用于从多源OCT图像中分割三种视网膜液体，结合域自适应归一化和不确定性估计。模型平均液体Dice达到0.78，且不确定性在专家不一致区域高1.34倍（p<10^-4），可作为临床决策辅助信号。
Motivation: 手动标注OCT视网膜液体耗时，且不同扫描仪训练的分割模型泛化性差。现有方法缺乏对预测可靠性的量化，难以在临床中信任分割结果。
Method: 采用注意力引导的TransUNet架构，集成域自适应归一化模块以处理多源数据，并加入不确定性估计输出像素级不可靠标记。
Result: 在四个独立OCT数据集上平均液体Dice为0.78；不确定性比在专家标注不一致区域高1.34倍，统计显著（p<10^-4）。
Conclusion: 不确定性估计可将原始分割图转化为可操作的临床分诊信号，有助于提升模型在真实临床中的可信度。

papers.title: Near-Optimal Learning of Gaussian Sobolev Operators
papers.abstract_en: A key question in operator learning is how to design surrogate operators with provable approximation guarantees in reasonable computational time. Whereas smooth operators can be approximated efficiently, i.e., with at least algebraic convergence in the amount of training data, learning finitely regular operators is known to be less efficient. The reason is an intrinsic curse of sample complexity, which allows only subalgebraic sample complexity rates. This fact makes it all the more important to develop algorithms which provably achieve these rates. In this work, we present a fully data-driven algorithm, termed Hermite-PCA approximation, for learning Gaussian Sobolev operators with near-optimal sample complexity. It employs principal component analysis and weighted least-squares methods and is therefore computationally efficient. Moreover, it is spectral, in the sense that it achieves faster (and near-optimal) convergence the higher the Sobolev regularity. We provide a full error analysis of this algorithm, taking into account all sources of error, along with numerical experiments that verify our theoretical results and empirically confirm the efficacy of Hermite-PCA approximation for learning Sobolev operators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高斯 Sobolev 算子的学习问题，提出了一种完全数据驱动的 Hermite-PCA 近似算法，该算法结合主成分分析和加权最小二乘法，实现了近最优的样本复杂度。理论分析表明，算法是谱收敛的，Sobolev 正则性越高收敛越快，数值实验验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 算子学习中光滑算子可以高效逼近，但有限正则算子的学习受限于样本复杂度的维数诅咒，只能达到次代数收敛速率。本文旨在设计一个达到该最优速率的实用算法。
Method: 提出 Hermite-PCA 近似算法，利用主成分分析和加权最小二乘方法，是一种计算高效的全数据驱动算法。
Result: 摘要表明该算法具有近最优的样本复杂度，且是谱收敛的，即 Sobolev 正则性越高收敛越快。数值实验验证了理论结果。
Conclusion: 本文提供完整的误差分析，涵盖所有误差来源，并通过实验确认了 Hermite-PCA 近似在学习 Sobolev 算子中的有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Sensitivity to Subjective Expected Utility Maximization: A Methodological Study, with an Illustrative Application to LLM Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating decisions made under uncertainty is hard when labeled outcomes are scarce, costly, or confounded with luck. We treat subjective expected utility (SEU) maximization as a stated standard and define a graded measure -- SEU sensitivity -- of an agent's conformity to it. The vehicle is a softmax choice model with a sensitivity parameter $α$ on SEU-valued alternatives; the contribution is a sequence of identifiability results for $α$ and for belief and utility parameters $(β, δ)$, validated in Stan via prior predictive checks, parameter recovery, and simulation-based calibration (SBC), with finite-sample caveats intact. In the uncertain-choice-only model $m_0$, $α$ is identifiable given the expected-utility vector $η$ and sharply recovered, while $(β, δ)$ are only weakly informed: the posterior barely contracts and concentrates on a $β$-$δ$ trade-off. In the extended model $m_1$, $δ$ becomes identifiable in principle via a $β$-free risky block, but its practical recovery gain at realistic sample sizes is negligible (matched-count CI-width reduction under 1%), and that block yields no detected $α$-precision gain at matched choice count. These are two distinct phenomena: for $δ$, identifiability does not imply precise estimability at realistic $n$; for $α$, identifiability is silent about what governs finite-$n$ precision. Marginal SBC passes for both models even where the joint posterior is weakly informed -- a demarcation we make precise. A two-by-two application (GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet, each on insurance-claims triage and Ellsberg-style urns, with sampling temperature as the lever) runs end-to-end on real LLM choice data, detecting a structured comparative $α$ effect in two of four cells.
papers.comment: 64 pages, 5 figures. Code and data archived at Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21250951
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个分级指标——主观期望效用敏感性（SEU sensitivity），用于衡量代理人在不确定性下决策时对主观期望效用最大化的符合程度。通过软最大化选择模型引入敏感性参数α，并在贝叶斯框架下进行可识别性分析，利用先验预测检查、参数恢复和模拟校准验证。在仅不确定性选择模型m0中，α可识别且恢复良好，但信念和效用参数(β, δ)信息量弱；扩展模型m1中δ原则上可识别，但实际样本量下估计精度提升可忽略。应用部分测试了GPT-4o和Claude 3.5 Sonnet在保险理赔分类和埃尔斯伯格式瓮上的决策行为，检测到两个单元格中存在结构化的α效应。
Motivation: 在标签稀缺、成本高昂或受运气影响的场景中，评估不确定性下的决策很困难。论文旨在定义一种度量，以评估代理人的决策行为与SEU最大化这一声称标准的一致程度。
Method: 基于软最大化选择模型，引入敏感性参数α，通过贝叶斯推断分析参数的可识别性。使用Stan进行先验预测检查、参数恢复和模拟校准验证。模型分为仅不确定性选择模型m0和扩展模型m1，后者加入无风险块以辅助δ的可识别性。
Result: 在m0中，给定期望效用向量η时α可识别且恢复良好，但(β, δ)后验收缩极小且集中于β-δ权衡。m1中δ可识别，但实际样本量下置信区间宽度缩减小于1%，且无风险块未带来α精度提升。边际SBC通过，即使联合后验信息弱。真实LLM数据应用中，两个模型在四个单元格中的两个检测到结构化α效应。
Conclusion: 可识别性不等同于有限样本下的精确可估性；α的有限样本精度不由可识别性决定。边际SBC无法揭示联合后验信息弱的问题，需谨慎使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Answering Without Referring: How AI Search Rewrites the Web's Economic Bargain
papers.abstract_en: Search engines have long allocated attention on the web by routing users from queries to websites. AI search changes this arrangement because information needs can be resolved inside the intermediary. Using URL-level Comscore U.S. desktop clickstream, we compare ChatGPT and Google information-seeking occasions and exploit ChatGPT Search access expansions to estimate traditional search displacement. ChatGPT produces outbound clicks in only 5.2% of conversation sessions, far below Google's referral ratio. The remaining clicks are not a scaled-down Google stream: they skew toward specialized destinations and away from ad-supported sites. Wider access cuts search use by 9.4%, with search-referral losses largest for informational categories. Our findings identify a central economic shift in digital intermediation: AI search might satisfy information needs inside the intermediary while weakening the referral bargain that has linked search, traffic, and content production on the open web.

papers.title: Beyond Perfect Priors: Adaptive Gaussian Graph for 4D Driving Reconstruction in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing 4D driving scenes in the wild (e.g., internet and AI-generated videos) is critical for diverse autonomous driving simulation. While recent Gaussian Scene Graph (GSG) methods achieve impressive visual quality, they heavily rely on precise priors, such as accurate camera poses and LiDAR depth, or manual annotations. When initialized with noisy priors estimated from in-the-wild videos, existing GSG methods suffer from optimization ambiguity (e.g., entangling camera and agent poses) and topological failures (e.g., missing objects), causing severe rendering artifacts. To enable robust in-the-wild reconstruction, we introduce Adaptive Gaussian Graph (AGG), a self-correcting 4D framework. Our Semantically-Guided Tick-Tock Strategy leverages 2D foundation features to explicitly decouple static background and camera pose updates from dynamic agent learning. Concurrently, our Adaptive Topology Evolution module actively rectifies graph structures by spawning missing agents, reassigning misclassified Gaussians, and pruning false positives. To rigorously evaluate this in-the-wild setting, we introduce Wild-30, a challenging benchmark of internet and generative videos. Extensive experiments on KITTI and Wild-30 validate that AGG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in visual fidelity and robustness under noisy priors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应高斯图 (AGG) 框架，用于从无约束的互联网或生成视频中鲁棒地重建4D驾驶场景。AGG通过语义引导的Tick-Tock策略解耦静态背景与动态物体学习，并利用自适应拓扑进化模块修复图结构。在KITTI和Wild-30基准上，AGG在噪声先验下优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有高斯场景图方法严重依赖精确先验（如相机位姿、LiDAR深度），在无约束视频中因噪声先验导致优化歧义和拓扑错误。
Method: 提出AGG框架，包含两个核心模块：语义引导的Tick-Tock策略利用2D基础特征解耦静态背景和相机位姿更新与动态智能体学习；自适应拓扑进化模块通过生成缺失智能体、重新分类误分配高斯和修剪误检来主动修正图结构。
Result: 在KITTI和Wild-30基准上，AGG在视觉保真度和鲁棒性方面一致优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: AGG通过自校正机制实现了在无约束驾驶视频中的鲁棒4D重建，为真实世界自动驾驶仿真提供了新方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Do You Remember? Toward Memory-Centric Multimodal AI
papers.abstract_en: Human memory is reconstructive, not a faithful recording. Current multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) lack this capability: they process images through a frozen visual encoder, produce a one-shot text output, and discard internal representations. We present DoYouRemember, a three-stage architecture introducing reconstructive memory into MLLMs: (1) a VQ-VAE compresses images into discrete visual tokens, (2) a LoRA-fine-tuned LLM jointly attends to visual and text tokens, and (3) a Diffusion Decoder reconstructs images from the LLM's hidden states. On 1,000 3D facial skin texture maps and 99,000 unlabeled facial images, we find that LLM hidden states contain approximately zero recoverable visual information -- the same Decoder producing clear reconstructions from VQ-VAE tokens (pre-LLM) produces pure noise from LLM hidden states (post-LLM), demonstrating that the LLM understands images but does not remember them. Training a shared memory matrix M under backpropagation systematically fails due to gradient cancellation (O(1/sqrt(N)) attenuation). We identify three root causes and show that local EMA updating resolves all three: each image updates only its top-8 slots out of 64, preserving inter-slot diversity. The resulting M (229K parameters, 16x compressed) approaches the VQ upper bound on unseen test images. Scaling to 1,024 slots surpasses it (LPIPS 0.056 vs. 0.071), as M's continuous representation avoids VQ quantization error. We unify these findings under an information-theoretic framework: memory is lossy compression, recall is decompression, and hallucination is an inherent property of lossy decompression rather than a defect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DoYouRemember架构，将重构性记忆引入多模态LLM。通过VQ-VAE、LoRA微调LLM和Diffusion Decoder三阶段处理，发现LLM隐藏状态几乎不含可恢复视觉信息。提出局部EMA更新方法训练共享记忆矩阵，在未见测试集上接近并超越VQ上界，验证了记忆是有损压缩、幻觉是固有属性的信息论观点。
Motivation: 人类记忆是重构性的而非忠实记录，当前多模态LLM缺乏此能力：它们通过冻结的视觉编码器处理图像，一次性输出文本并丢弃内部表示。
Method: 提出三阶段架构：VQ-VAE将图像压缩为离散视觉token；LoRA微调LLM联合处理视觉和文本token；Diffusion Decoder从LLM隐藏状态重建图像。针对共享记忆矩阵M的梯度消失问题，提出局部EMA更新，每个图像仅更新64槽位中的top-8，保持槽间多样性。
Result: 实验发现LLM隐藏状态几乎不含可恢复视觉信息；共享记忆矩阵M（229K参数，16倍压缩）在未见测试集上逼近VQ上界，扩大至1024槽位时超越VQ上界（LPIPS 0.056 vs 0.071），表明连续表示避免量化误差。
Conclusion: 统一框架：记忆是有损压缩，回忆是解压缩，幻觉是有损解压缩的固有属性而非缺陷。

papers.title: AAAI-26 Dual Submissions: Novel Challenges
papers.abstract_en: Dual submissions, in which identical or substantially similar papers are simultaneously submitted to one or more archival venues, without cross-citation or disclosure, are a growing problem for the AAAI Conference and other scientific publication venues. These submissions increase the burden on the peer-review system and pollute the scientific record. As part of the AAAI-26 review process, we (conference organizers) compared AAAI main-track submissions to nine other archival venues with overlapping review periods. We also searched for dual submissions within the AAAI-26 main track. We employed title+abstract similarity assessment to prioritize highly similar paper pairs for subsequent triage by an LLM-based overlap assessment tool, followed by manual review of the highest severity pairs. Manual review of such pairs led to the desk-rejection of 141 AAAI-26 main-track submissions. We seek to alert future organizers, and the broader artificial intelligence research community, to the enormous growth in dual submissions. The incidence of exact duplicate submissions, which are easy to detect, has been eclipsed by the number of papers that use different words to describe the same contribution, which are extremely time-consuming to detect. The growth in this phenomenon is likely facilitated by increasing access to generative AI tools. We include several recommendations for addressing this challenge, including (1) updating the AAAI Multiple Submission Policy and educating the community about acceptable practice, (2) having dual-submission checking tools in place before submissions close, (3) working across venues to converge on consistent policies and penalties to aid in reducing the incidence of dual submission, and (4) creating a community-driven adversarial challenge to accelerate the development of robust detection tools.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论AAAI-26会议中双重提交（同时向多个会议提交相同或非常相似的论文）问题。作者作为组织者比较了AAAI主轨与九个其他档案库的提交，使用标题+摘要相似度评估和LLM辅助重叠检测，人工审查后拒稿141篇。指出精确重复提交已被用不同词语描述相同贡献的论文取代，后者难以检测，生成式AI工具可能加剧此现象。给出四条建议。
Motivation: 双重提交增加同行评审负担、污染科学记录，且日益严重，尤其难以检测的变体重复。
Method: 组织者比较AAAI-26主轨提交与九个其他同期档案库，先进行标题+摘要相似度评估，再用LLM辅助重叠检测，最后人工审查最高严重性对。
Result: 人工审查后拒稿141篇AAAI-26主轨提交；精确重复提交数量下降，但语义重复提交大幅增加，检测耗时。
Conclusion: 建议更新多重提交政策、在截稿前部署检测工具、跨会议统一政策惩罚、设立社区对抗挑战以促进检测工具发展。

papers.title: QDEvo: A Multi-Objective Quality-Diversity Framework for Automated Heuristic Design
papers.abstract_en: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) with evolutionary computation has emerged as a powerful paradigm for automated heuristic design in combinatorial optimization. However, existing approaches suffer from mode collapse, converging to homogeneous populations that lack semantic diversity and fail to explore the full algorithmic space. We propose Quality-Diversity Evolution (QDEvo), a multi-objective framework that integrates Quality-Diversity optimization with LLM-driven heuristic search, maintaining an unbounded archive of semantically diverse algorithms using pre-trained code embeddings and incorporating hierarchical self-reflection to guide the evolutionary process. Extensive experiments across standard benchmarks and real-world industrial applications demonstrate that QDEvo significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both Hypervolume and Inverted Generational Distance metrics. Our framework enables the discovery of heuristics that are simultaneously high-performing, computationally efficient, and semantically diverse, providing practitioners with a rich portfolio of solutions for complex optimization problems.
papers.comment: 4 pages; Accepted as poster at GECCO 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QDEvo是一个将质量多样性优化与LLM驱动的启发式搜索相结合的多目标框架，用于自动化启发式设计。它通过预训练代码嵌入维护语义多样的算法存档，并引入分层自我反思引导进化过程，在组合优化基准和工业应用上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有的LLM与进化计算结合方法存在模式坍缩，种群同质化且缺乏语义多样性，无法充分探索算法空间。
Method: 提出QDEvo框架，整合质量多样性优化与LLM驱动的启发式搜索，使用预训练代码嵌入维护无界存档以保持语义多样性，并引入分层自我反思机制指导进化。
Result: 在标准基准和真实工业应用中，QDEvo在超体积和反向世代距离指标上显著优于现有方法，能同时发现高性能、高计算效率和语义多样的启发式算法。
Conclusion: QDEvo为复杂优化问题提供了丰富的解决方案组合，但摘要未提及局限性或未来工作。

papers.title: Benchmarking Sensor Robustness in Plasma Diagnostic Models: A Systematic Evaluation on TokaMark
papers.abstract_en: Plasma diagnostic models for tokamak fusion devices are almost universally evaluated on clean, complete sensor data. In practice, fusion diagnostics fail regularly: acquisition systems start late, individual sensors die, and signal dropouts cluster precisely when a plasma disruption is approaching. We present the first systematic robustness benchmark for plasma diagnostic ML using the TokaMark dataset of 11,573 MAST shots, evaluating XGBoost, LSTM, Transformer, and the TokaMark CNN baseline across six physically-grounded failure scenarios and three imputation strategies. We introduce the Robustness Score (RS) for standardized cross-architecture comparison. Our central finding is that disruption-proximate sensor failure (corruption injected in the final window timesteps) collapses sequence model performance (LSTM +212% NRMSE) while a statistical feature model remains comparatively stable (XGBoost +37%). Forward-fill imputation eliminates nearly all degradation from random dropout for sequence models (LSTM +57% to ~0%), but offers little help when the end of the window is corrupted. Shot-level alarm evaluation using ground-truth disruption timestamps reveals that LSTM alarm detection collapses to TPR=0.00 under proximate sensor failure, while mean-fill imputation recovers it to TPR=1.00, a reversal of the pattern observed in NRMSE. Plasma current emerges as the single most critical diagnostic across all architectures (+73% to +140% upon removal). Code, data, and trained checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Neerav-Gupta/tokamark-robustness.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 9 figures. Code and data available at https://github.com/Neerav-Gupta/tokamark-robustness
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统评估托卡马克等离子体诊断模型在传感器故障下的鲁棒性。基于TokaMark数据集（11,573次MAST放电），测试XGBoost、LSTM、Transformer和TokaMark CNN基线在六种物理故障场景和三种插值策略下的性能。提出了用于标准化跨架构比较的鲁棒性分数（RS）。核心发现：临近破裂的传感器故障导致序列模型性能崩溃（LSTM的NRMSE增加212%），而统计特征模型相对稳定（XGBoost增加37%）。前向填充可消除随机丢失的退化，但对窗口尾部损坏帮助有限。在射击级报警评估中，临近传感器故障使LSTM报警检测的TPR降至0.00，而均值填充恢复至1.00。等离子体电流在所有架构中是最关键的诊断量（移除后误差增加73%-140%）。
Motivation: 现有托卡马克等离子体诊断模型几乎都在干净完整的数据上评估，而实际传感器经常故障（采集系统启动延迟、单通道失效、信号丢失在破裂临近时聚集），缺乏系统性的鲁棒性基准。
Method: 使用TokaMark数据集，对XGBoost、LSTM、Transformer和TokaMark CNN六种物理故障场景（包括随机丢失、临近破裂丢失等）和三种插值策略（前向填充、均值填充等）进行实验，并提出Robustness Score（RS）用于标准化比较。
Result: 临近破裂的传感器故障使LSTM的NRMSE增加212%，而XGBoost仅增加37%；前向填充将随机丢失对LSTM的影响从+57%降至接近0%，但对窗口尾部损坏无效；枪级报警评估中，临近故障使LSTM的TPR降至0.00，均值填充恢复至1.00；移除等离子体电流使所有架构误差增加73%-140%。
Conclusion: 作者强调，实际部署中需关注传感器故障时序与破裂临近的关联性，朴素插值策略在不同故障模式下效果差异显著，序列模型对临近丢失敏感但可通过均值填充补救，而特征重要性分析表明等离子体电流是关键的诊断量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Burst Spiking Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: A central goal of current Spiking Neural Network (SNN) research is to improve their accuracy toward becoming low-power alternatives to Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). This work further argues that realizing this ambition requires improving not only accuracy but also robustness, defined as the ability to maintain correct predictions under input perturbations. We identify two key issues in existing SNN methods that undermine robustness. First, binary spiking activations can produce large activation-state changes under small perturbations. Second, the lack of effective weight constraints makes network outputs more sensitive to input variations. To this end, we propose Burst Spiking Neural Networks (BuSNNs), built upon Burst-enhanced Spiking Neurons (BSNs) and a Dynamic Weight Constraint (DWC) mechanism. BSNs incorporate burst firing to provide a graded spiking pattern. This spiking mechanism mitigates perturbation-induced transitions in activation states and thereby enhances robustness. DWC penalizes connection weights based on activation states, effectively reducing weight magnitudes and improving robustness while preserving accuracy. We provide theoretical analyses to support these robustness effects. Experimental results further show that, on smaller-scale benchmarks such as CIFAR-10, BuSNNs outperform both SNN and ANN counterparts in accuracy and robustness. On large-scale ImageNet, BuSNN with the MS ResNet-34 backbone further improves top-1 accuracy and corruption robustness over the corresponding SNN baseline by 3.18% and 2.66%, respectively. Despite using spike-based activations, BuSNNs surpass 4-bit activation-quantized ANN baselines and approach 8-bit ANN baselines on ImageNet. They also preserve SNNs' low-power advantage. This work studies the accuracy-robustness problem in SNNs, advancing their practical viability in robust and energy-efficient applications.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 21 figures, 1 supplementary material PDF, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出突发脉冲神经网络（BuSNNs），通过突发增强型神经元（BSNs）和动态权重约束（DWC）机制，旨在提升脉冲神经网络的鲁棒性和准确性。实验表明，在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上，BuSNNs在准确性和抗扰动鲁棒性方面均优于传统SNN和ANN基线，同时保持低能耗优势。
Motivation: 现有SNN研究主要关注准确性，但忽略了鲁棒性（输入扰动下保持正确预测的能力）。作者发现二值脉冲激活在小扰动下可能产生大的激活状态变化，且缺乏有效的权重约束导致输出敏感，这些问题限制了SNN的实用化。
Method: 提出BuSNNs，包含两个核心组件：突发增强型神经元（BSNs）引入分级脉冲模式以缓解扰动引起的激活状态转变；动态权重约束（DWC）根据激活状态惩罚连接权重，降低权重幅值同时保持准确性。提供了理论分析支持鲁棒性效果。
Result: 在CIFAR-10上，BuSNNs的准确性和鲁棒性均优于SNN和ANN对手。在ImageNet上，基于MS ResNet-34的BuSNNs相比对应的SNN基线，top-1准确率提升3.18%，抗损鲁棒性提升2.66%。BuSNNs还超越了4-bit激活量化的ANN基线，接近8-bit ANN基线，同时保持SNN的低功耗优势。
Conclusion: BuSNNs通过突发脉冲和动态权重约束改善了SNN的准确性-鲁棒性权衡，提升了其在鲁棒且高效应用中的实用潜力。

papers.title: Towards Self-Evolving Agents: A Human-Inspired Adaptive Exploration-Exploitation Framework for Genetic Network Programming
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in agentic AI have increasingly moved toward graph-based methods, driven by the demand for explainable, human-centered, and non-linear reasoning workflows. A prominent example is Genetic Network Programming (GNP), a self-evolving algorithm that utilizes directed graphs to evolve interpretable decision structures for agents. As in most evolutionary algorithms, effectively balancing exploration and exploitation is a key aspect of GNP. However, this trade-off has received limited attention in the GNP literature. To address this gap, we draw inspiration from human developmental patterns, where children prioritize broad experimentation and action over deliberation, with this tendency reversing with age. By mapping transitions between GNP's judgment nodes to deliberation and processing nodes to action, we propose Human-Inspired GNP (HGNP), a novel adaptive framework that dynamically regulates the exploration-exploitation balance throughout the evolutionary process. The method consists of novel adaptive crossover and mutation operators, and a cycle elimination mechanism. HGNP not only improves the evolutionary process but also provides a framework for adjusting the exploration-exploitation balance based on the characteristics of the target environment and its search space. This approach is more effective than tuning via crossover and mutation probabilities in standard GNP. The modifications are general and can be applied to almost all GNP variants. When integrated with standard GNP and two recently introduced GNP variants and evaluated on the Tileworld benchmark, HGNP demonstrated significant performance improvement in agents' strategy. The combination of HGNP with Situation-based GNP (HGNP-SBGNP) achieved the best overall results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种受人类发展模式启发的自适应探索-利用框架HGNP，用于遗传网络编程（GNP），通过新型自适应交叉和变异算子及循环消除机制动态调节进化过程中的探索-利用平衡。在Tileworld基准测试中，HGNP显著提升了智能体策略性能，与情境GNP结合后取得最佳整体结果。
Motivation: 现有GNP文献对探索-利用平衡的关注不足，而该平衡是进化算法的关键方面。
Method: 提出Human-Inspired GNP（HGNP），映射GNP的判断节点到思考、处理节点到行动，利用自适应交叉和变异算子及循环消除机制动态调节探索-利用平衡。
Result: 在Tileworld基准上，HGNP结合标准GNP及两种新GNP变体均显著提升智能体策略性能，HGNP-SBGNP组合取得最佳整体结果。
Conclusion: HGNP提供了一种基于目标环境特征调整探索-利用平衡的通用框架，可应用于大多数GNP变体。

papers.title: SeqGPT: A Constrained Transformer Agent for the Inverse Designof Multi-Panel Composite Structures
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing composite stacking sequences to match continuous targets (e.g., Lamination or Buckling Parameters) with discrete manufacturing constraints represents a challenging combinatorial inverse problem that regularly occurs in composite design especially when numerical optimization approaches are used (bi-step, bi-level configurations). In multipanel configurations, this complexity is further intensified by blending, a global compatibility/continuity requirement between the different panel stackings. This study presents SeqGPT, a conditional Transformer agent developed to replace computationally expensive iterative methods. To ensure both global continuity and manufacturing feasibility by construction, we implemented a hybrid neurosymbolic decoding strategy. SeqGPT predicts a conditional distribution that guides a Constrained Beam Search, where any branch violating blending rules is strictly pruned. Numerical experiments on the 18-panel horseshoe benchmark demonstrate that SeqGPT generates solutions near-instantaneously with buckling performance comparable to evolutionary methods, offering a significant speed-up compared to the state of the art.
papers.journal_ref: APIA 2026 -- Applications Pratiques de l'Intelligence Artificielle, AFIA, Jun 2026, Arras, France
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SeqGPT，一个条件Transformer智能体，用于解决多面板复合材料层压板堆叠序列的逆设计问题，该问题涉及离散制造约束和连续目标的匹配。模型通过混合神经符号解码策略，在约束束搜索中修剪违反混合规则的路径，从而保证全局连续性和可制造性。在18面板马靴基准测试上，SeqGPT在几乎瞬时生成解，其屈曲性能与进化方法相当，但显著加速。
Motivation: 复合材料堆叠序列优化是一个组合逆问题，当涉及多面板配置时，混合要求进一步增加复杂度。现有迭代优化方法计算成本高，需要更高效的替代方案。
Method: 基于条件Transformer的SeqGPT，结合神经符号解码：预测条件分布，指导约束束搜索，严格修剪违反混合规则的分支，确保解的连续性和可制造性。
Result: 在18面板马靴基准上，SeqGPT生成的解在屈曲性能上与进化方法相当，但计算时间大幅缩短，实现近瞬时的解生成。
Conclusion: SeqGPT为复合材料多面板逆设计提供了快速的近似解，可作为昂贵迭代方法的替代，但其泛化到其他类型约束或更大规模结构的能力尚未验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: In-Context Reinforcement Learning under Non-Stationarity: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: The development of decision-pretrained transformers, algorithm distillation, long-context meta-RL, and retrieval-augmented agents has renewed interest in in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL): the ability of a pretrained or fine-tuned decision model to infer latent task rules and improve future behavior from interaction context, without test-time parameter updates. This line of work asks when trial-and-error evidence, rewards, transitions, demonstrations, feedback, or retrieved experience can make learning-like computation happen inside the context window. However, existing surveys of ICRL mainly organize the field around pretraining objectives, architectures, context formats, evaluation protocols, and theoretical mechanisms, while the non-stationary setting remains comparatively underexamined. In changing environments, accumulated context is not merely more evidence about a fixed task: the reward specification, transition kernel, observation channel, action interface, constraint model, or demonstration and memory distribution can fall out of alignment with the current regime. Previously useful context can therefore become stale, misleading, or useful again when an old regime returns. We survey non-stationary ICRL as the problem of adapting through context while deployed policy parameters remain fixed: the policy must infer both the current decision rule and which parts of its accumulated evidence still support that rule. We define non-stationary ICRL, relate it to meta-RL, decision sequence modeling, retrieval-augmented RL, value- and model-aware ICRL, and reward-feedback agents, and organize the literature along three questions: what changes, how the change unfolds, and how observable the change is to the agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了非平稳环境下的上下文强化学习（ICRL），探讨了决策预训练变压器、算法蒸馏、长上下文元RL和检索增强智能体等方向。文章定义了非平稳ICRL，将其与元RL、决策序列建模等关联，并围绕“什么变化、变化如何展开、变化对智能体的可观察性”三个问题组织文献。
Motivation: 现有ICRL综述主要关注预训练目标、架构等，对非平稳设置的研究不足。在变化环境中，累积的上下文可能过时或误导，需要智能体在不更新参数的情况下通过上下文自适应。
Method: 通过定义非平稳ICRL，梳理其与元RL、决策序列建模、检索增强RL等的关系，并按照变化要素、变化模式、可观察性三个维度组织文献。
Result: 该综述系统整理了非平稳ICRL的现有工作，但未给出具体的实验结果或数值性能。
Conclusion: 非平稳ICRL是一个重要但未充分研究的领域，未来工作需进一步探索如何让智能体在固定策略参数下通过上下文适应环境变化。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Evaluating the Fidelity of GraphCast AI Forecasts for the Indian Summer Monsoon: A Climatological Assessment Against ERA-5 Reanalysis and IMERG Observations
papers.abstract_en: The Indian Summer Monsoon (ISM) represents one of the most consequential and dynamically complex phenomena in the global climate system, yet its prediction remains challenging for both physics-based and data-driven models. This study evaluates Google's GraphCast, a machine-learning-based global weather prediction system, against ERA5 reanalysis and IMERG precipitation observations for the boreal summer season (June-September, JJAS) over 2021-2024. We analyze deterministic GraphCast forecasts initialized at 00 UTC using four 6-hourly lead times, composited for +24 h, +48 h, and +72 h lead performance across the ISM domain. The evaluation includes climatological mean state, rainfall intensity distribution, thermodynamic drivers (DTT, Q1, Q2), monsoon dynamics, and variability across multiple timescales. Results show GraphCast reproduces the broad spatial pattern of monsoon rainfall and the annual cycle with good fidelity at short leads, but exhibits a domain-averaged wet bias over the core monsoon region and strong suppression of rainfall variance across nearly all timescales (regional power-spectrum variance ratio ~0.14 relative to IMERG). The rainfall intensity distribution is right-shifted and compressed, with moderate-heavy rainfall (95th percentile) biased wet and extreme events underrepresented. These biases are accompanied by a deficient lower-tropospheric Q1 profile and degraded northward-propagating intraseasonal variability. Overall, GraphCast shows a deterministic smoothing signature in precipitation, providing key diagnostics for next-generation AI weather models and their use in tropical extended-range forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了谷歌的机器学习天气预测系统GraphCast在印度夏季风（ISM）上的保真度，利用ERA5再分析和IMERG降水观测数据，对2021-2024年夏季（6-9月）的确定性预报进行了气候学评估。结果显示GraphCast在短预报时效内能较好再现季风降水的空间格局和年循环，但在核心季风区存在区域平均湿偏差，降水方差被强烈抑制（相对IMERG的功率谱方差比约0.14），中等偏强降水偏高估，极端事件被低估，且伴随低层大气加热廓线缺陷和北向传播季节内变率退化。总体显示了确定性预报的平滑特征。
Motivation: 印度夏季风是全球气候系统中最重要且动力最复杂的现象之一，但其预测对物理模型和数据驱动模型都具挑战性。本研究旨在诊断AI预报模型GraphCast的保真度，为下一代AI天气模型和热带延伸期预报提供关键诊断依据。
Method: 使用ERA5再分析和IMERG降水观测，对GraphCast 00 UTC初始化的确定性预报进行+24h、+48h、+72h的复合分析，评估气候平均态、降雨强度分布、热力驱动（DTT、Q1、Q2）、季风动力学以及多时间尺度变率。
Result: GraphCast在短预报时效内再现了季风降水的空间分布和年循环，但存在区域平均湿偏差、降水方差被强烈抑制（相对IMERG的功率谱方差比约0.14）、中等偏强降水偏高估、极端事件低估、低层大气加热廓线缺陷以及北向传播季节内变率退化。
Conclusion: GraphCast在降水预报中表现出确定性平滑特征，这些诊断结果为下一代AI天气模型及其在热带延伸期预报中的应用提供了重要参考。

papers.title: Evolution of Thunderstorm Charge Structure Revealed by Particle Composition and Near-Surface Electric Field
papers.abstract_en: Thunderstorm Ground Enhancements (TGEs) provide a direct particle-physics diagnostic of accelerating electric fields within thunderclouds. During 12 15 May 2026, Aragats detectors recorded a compact sequence of TGEs under closely related meteorological and electric field conditions. Ten statistically resolved TGEs were selected for quantitative analysis using STAND3 and SEVAN Light gamma and electron proxy channels. The events were classified into negative (N), transition/disturbed negative (TD N), and positive (P) states based on the stability of the near surface electric field (NSEF). The results show that TGEs occur during both comparatively stable and rapidly evolving charge states. Stable negative events correspond to sustained exposure of the Main Negative (MN) charge region, whereas positive and TD N events reflect Lower Positive Charge Region (LPCR) screening and rapid restructuring of the lower thundercloud dipole during End Of Storm Oscillation (EOSO) like evolution. The analysis demonstrates that the electron/gamma composition depends primarily on the persistence and geometry of the lower accelerating field structure rather than solely on the instantaneous sign or magnitude of the NSEF. Rapid electric field impulses, frequently associated with nearby lightning activity, mark active restructuring of the lower dipole and strongly influence electron transport to the detector level. All analyzed events occurred during persistent low cloud base conditions favorable for electron TGEs at Aragats.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用雷暴地面增强（TGE）事件中粒子的电子/伽马组成和近地面电场数据，揭示雷暴云的电荷结构演化。基于2016年5月12-15日阿拉加茨探测器的观测，将事件分为负、过渡/扰动负和正三类状态，发现TGE发生时低层电场结构几何形态对电子/伽马组成起主要作用，而非近地面电场瞬时符号或强度。
Motivation: 雷电云内加速电场结构难以直接观测，通过TGE粒子成分变化推断电荷结构演化，但现有研究对快速演变状态下的电场重组与粒子输运关系理解不足。
Method: 利用STAND3和SEVAN Light探测器的伽马和电子代理通道，选取10个统计显著的TGE事件，依据近地面电场稳定性分类，分析各事件中电子/伽马计数比与电场变化的关联。
Result: 负态TGE对应主负电荷区持续暴露；正态和过渡/扰动负态反映低正电荷区屏蔽和暴末振荡期间的快速重组。电场脉冲（常伴随邻近闪电）标志低偶极子结构重组，强烈影响电子到达探测器水平。所有事件均发生在低云底条件下，利于电子TGE产生。
Conclusion: TGE的电子/伽马组成主要由低层加速电场结构的持续性和几何形状决定，而非仅由近地面电场符号或强度决定；雷暴云内电荷结构快速演化可用于诊断闪电活动前的电场变化。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Positron acceleration in thunderstorms
papers.abstract_en: Thunderstorm Ground Enhancements (TGEs) are known manifestations of relativistic runaway electron avalanches (RREAs) developing inside thunderclouds. However, the role of positrons in TGEs and their relationship to thundercloud charge structure remain poorly understood. We report time resolved observations of intense positron fluxes detected at the Aragats Observatory on 16 17 May 2026 during strong thunderstorms. Two of the three events were characterized by a positive near surface electric field (NSEF), graupel precipitation, a low cloud base, and low-to-moderate enhancement of gamma ray and electron fluxes measured by SEVAN and STAND3 detectors. The third event is a classical electron TGE considered for comparative purposes. All events show moderate to strong enhancement of the 511 keV annihilation line, along with enhanced radon progeny gamma ray lines. We observe a temporal separation between the electron and gamma ray TGE peak and the positron flux maximum. To explain these observations, we introduce a dual dipole electrodynamic model. The large scale electron dipole comprises the main negative thundercloud layer and its broad positive mirror charge induced at the Earths surface, producing ordinary TGEs. Simultaneously, a localized positron dipole forms from the LPCR, with its negative mirror charge directly beneath the LPCR footprint. This lower dipole accelerates positrons downward while decelerating electrons entering the same region. These results establish positron TGEs as a new subclass of atmospheric high energy phenomena and provide direct evidence of localized positron acceleration in the lower atmosphere.

TL;DR: 该论文报道了2026年5月16-17日亚拉腊天文台在强雷暴期间观测到的正电子通量增强事件，将其归因于雷暴云中局部正电子偶极子的加速。基于双偶极电动力学模型，论文区分了传统电子TGE与正电子TGE，并给出了511 keV湮灭线增强的证据。
Motivation: 雷暴地面增强（TGE）中正电子的作用及其与云电荷结构的关系尚不清晰，现有研究主要聚焦电子和伽马射线。
Method: 利用SEVAN和STAND3探测器进行时间分辨观测，提出双偶极电动力学模型解释正电子加速机制。
Result: 三个事件中，两个表现出正近地面电场、霰降水、低云底以及中等伽马射线和电子通量增强；所有事件均有511 keV湮灭线增强。正电子通量峰值与电子、伽马射线峰值之间存在时间分离。
Conclusion: 正电子TGE被确立为一种新的高层大气高能现象子类，为低层大气中局域正电子加速提供了直接证据。

papers.title: Direct Observation of Wilsonian Electrons in Thunderstorms
papers.abstract_en: We analyze electron rich Thunderstorm Ground Enhancements (TGEs) detected at Aragats using the SEVAN Light spectrometer, which can separate charged and neutral particles and reconstruct their energy spectra. The events exhibit large electron fluxes, with reconstructed energies extending to 45 MeV. Simultaneous meteorological observations reveal that all events occurred within a remarkably narrow atmospheric regime characterized by exceptionally low cloud-base heights, temperatures near 0°C, strong electric-field disturbances, and lightning. Comparisons with the complete Aragats TGE archive demonstrate that the direct detection of runaway electrons becomes possible only when the active acceleration region approaches within several tens of meters of detector altitude, allowing electrons to survive atmospheric attenuation. These results provide an experimental explanation for the century long rarity of observations of Wilsonian electrons. The findings establish the atmospheric conditions required for direct observation of runaway electrons and contribute to the understanding of particle acceleration in natural electric fields.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用SEVAN Light光谱仪分析在Aragats探测到的富含电子的雷暴地面增强（TGEs），重建能量谱至45 MeV，并结合气象观测发现所有事件均发生在云底高度极低、温度接近0°C、强电场扰动和闪电的狭窄大气条件中。与完整TGE档案对比显示，只有当加速区域接近探测器高度几十米内时，逃逸电子才能直接观测到。这为百年来难以观测到的Wilson电子提供了实验解释，并确定了直接观测逃逸电子所需的大气条件。
Motivation: 逃逸电子（Wilsonian electrons）在雷暴中的直接观测极其罕见，百年鲜有记录，其观测条件尚不明确。
Method: 利用SEVAN Light光谱仪区分带电与中性粒子并重建能谱，同时结合气象观测分析云底高度、温度、电场和闪电等参数。
Result: 重建电子能量最高达45 MeV，所有事件均发生在极窄的大气条件下（低云底、近0°C、强电场扰动、闪电），且只有当加速区域接近探测器高度几十米时才能直接观测到。
Conclusion: 确定了直接观测雷暴逃逸电子所需的大气条件，解释了其长期难以观测的原因。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Predictive Modeling of High-Altitude Clear Air Turbulence in the United States: A Machine Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: High-altitude Clear Air Turbulence (CAT) poses significant risks to aviation safety due to its unpredictability and challenges in detection. This study leverages machine learning models to improve CAT prediction within U.S. airspace at 200-350 hPa pressure levels, utilizing Pilot Reports (PIREPs), ERA5 reanalysis data, and aircraft aerodynamic parameters from the BADA database. Gradient boosting algorithms, particularly XGBoost, achieved the highest performance with an AUC of 0.904, demonstrating superior capability in capturing non-linear atmospheric dynamics. Key findings highlight the dominance of geographic coordinates (17.5% feature importance) and turbulence indices like TI3 in prediction, emphasizing the role of regional topography and upper-tropospheric instability. The integration of aerodynamic features such as drag force and wing loading improved the detection of moderate-to-severe perceived turbulence intensity (POD improved from 0.845 to 0.866), providing additional value to traditional aircraft-independent methods. Seasonal analysis revealed winter months as peak periods for CAT incidents, correlating with jet stream activity. While results align with global studies, limitations include geographic scope and aircraft-type diversity. This research underscores the potential of machine learning for operational CAT forecasting, with recommendations for future work focusing on global data integration and real-time telemetry to address climate-driven turbulence trends.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用机器学习模型（尤其XGBoost）预测美国空域200-350 hPa高空晴空湍流（CAT），基于飞行员报告（PIREPs）、ERA5再分析数据和BADA数据库的飞机气动参数。最佳模型AUC达0.904，地理坐标和湍流指数TI3是最重要特征，引入气动特征（阻力、翼载）提升了中度至严重湍流检测的POD（从0.845到0.866）。季节分析显示冬季为CAT高发期。
Motivation: 高空晴空湍流难以预测且对航空安全威胁大，现有方法存在检测挑战，亟需利用机器学习提升预测精度。
Method: 采用梯度提升算法（XGBoost等），融合气象再分析数据（ERA5）、飞行员报告（PIREPs）和飞机气动参数（BADA数据库），在200-350 hPa压力层进行预测建模。
Result: XGBoost达到AUC 0.904；地理坐标特征重要性17.5%，TI3湍流指数贡献显著；引入气动特征后中度至严重湍流检测POD从0.845升至0.866。
Conclusion: 研究显示了机器学习在运营性CAT预报中的潜力，但受限于地理范围和机型多样性，未来需整合全球数据和实时遥测以应对气候驱动的湍流趋势。

papers.title: TAKE: Trajectory-Aware Knowledge Estimation for Text Dataset Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale text corpora have become a quiet bottleneck in modern NLP, not just in storage, but in the accumulated cost of training, fine-tuning, and continual learning. We propose a text dataset distillation framework that reduces corpora to as little as 0.1% of their original size while preserving downstream task fidelity. We approach distillation through the lens of influence functions, which quantify each sample's contribution to the downstream objective, a natural and principled basis for selection. We introduce Trajectory-Aware Knowledge Estimation (TAKE), which convolves the knowledge-based influence along the training trajectory into a single per-sample knowledge score, capturing informative samples. These scores serve as sample weights within a discrete Optimal Transport objective, guiding prototype selection from a synthetically generated candidate pool. We evaluate TAKE on downstream accuracy across text classification and natural language inference tasks at extreme compression (0.1% or 20 samples/class), showing that data efficiency is achievable without sacrificing task fidelity. The approach is theoretically grounded, with broader implications for coreset construction and data-centric AI. We release our source code at https://github.com/votrinhan88/take.

TL;DR: 本文提出TAKE框架，通过轨迹感知知识估计将文本数据集压缩至原始规模的0.1%，同时保持下游任务保真度。方法基于影响函数和最优传输，在分类和自然语言推理任务上验证了极端压缩下的数据效率。
Motivation: 大规模文本语料库在存储和训练成本上成为瓶颈，需要一种原则性的数据集蒸馏方法。
Method: 提出TAKE，将沿训练轨迹的影响函数卷积为单个样本知识分数，并作为样本权重用于离散最优传输，从合成候选池中选择原型。
Result: 在文本分类和自然语言推理任务上，将数据集压缩至0.1%（每类20个样本）仍保持下游准确率。
Conclusion: 该方法理论上有据可查，对核心集构建和数据为中心AI有广泛意义。

papers.title: Semidirect Fourier Delta Attention: Phase-Controlled Delta Memory with Constructive Chunk-WY Kernels
papers.abstract_en: Linear attention replaces softmax attention's growing KV cache with a fixed recurrent state, but this compression limits exact state tracking and long-context memory. We introduce \emph{Semidirect Fourier Delta Attention} (SFDA), a phase-controlled generalization of Kimi Delta Attention that replaces real diagonal decay with block-rotational Fourier control: \[ S_t=(I-β_t k_tk_t^*)Λ_tS_{t-1}+β_tk_tv_t^*, \qquad Λ_t=\diag(α_t\odot e^{iθ_t}). \] Our main result is a constructive chunk-WY factorization for products \(A_t=Λ_t-u_tr_t^*\), giving \[ A_t\cdots A_1=Γ_t-Y_tM_tW_t^* \] with rank growth bounded inside fixed chunks. This yields an exact affine chunk transfer, formal stability and complexity bounds, and a compact characterization of phase-plus-low-rank memory. We verify the algebra numerically and show in toy state-tracking experiments that SFDA learns cyclic memory where the phase-disabled KDA baseline remains near chance. Fused kernels and large-scale language-model comparisons are left to future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出半直接傅里叶Delta注意力（SFDA），将Kimi Delta Attention的实对角衰减替换为块旋转傅里叶控制，实现相位控制。主要结果是构造性的chunk-WY分解，给出精确的仿射块传递、稳定性与复杂度界，以及相位加低秩记忆的紧凑表征。在玩具状态跟踪实验中，SFDA能学习循环记忆而相位禁用的KDA基线接近随机。融合核与大规模语言模型比较留待未来工作。
Motivation: 线性注意力将softmax注意力的KV缓存压缩为固定循环状态，但此压缩限制了精确状态跟踪和长上下文记忆能力。
Method: 提出SFDA，用块旋转傅里叶控制（Λ_t=diag(α_t⊙e^{iθ_t})）代替实对角衰减，并给出构造性chunk-WY分解A_t...A_1=Γ_t−Y_tM_tW_t^*，实现秩增长受限于固定块内。
Result: 在玩具状态跟踪实验中，SFDA学会循环记忆，而相位禁用的KDA基线表现接近随机。
Conclusion: SFDA通过相位控制改善了线性注意力的记忆能力，但大规模语言模型比较和融合核实现尚未完成。

papers.title: OmniPMNet: Bridging discrete and gridded PM10 forecasts via omni-query neural processes
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting particulate matter (PM10) requires both station-scale accuracy and continuous spatial fields, especially during severe dust storms. Chemical transport models (CTMs) provide gridded forecasts but retain local biases, whereas graph neural networks (GNNs) track monitoring sites well at short lead times but do not produce gridded outputs. Here we present OmniPM-Net, a Convolutional Conditional Neural Process (ConvCNP)-based fusion model that reconciles these two forecast types within a shared spatial representation. A terrain-aware Gaussian set convolution lifts irregular GNN station forecasts onto a regular grid, where a multi-scale Spatial Source Attention (SSA) module blends them with Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) forecasts; a shared omni-query readout then decodes this representation into consistent PM10 predictions at either stations or grid cells over a 108 h horizon. Evaluated across 1,618 air-quality monitoring stations throughout China over the full year of 2024, OmniPM-Net matches the station-level accuracy of the stronger GNN baseline (mean absolute error 21.14 versus 22.00 ug/m3) and reduces the CAMS mean absolute error by 30%, while simultaneously delivering the gridded fields that the discrete GNN cannot. Its clearest gains are in the high-concentration tail, where the 90th-percentile MAE falls by 9% relative to the GNN and 25% relative to CAMS, and during dust episodes, where it improves categorical detection skill while tracking the evolving spatial trajectory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OmniPM-Net 是一种基于卷积条件神经过程（ConvCNP）的融合模型，旨在统一离散站点（GNN）和网格化（CAMS）PM10 预报。通过地形感知高斯卷积将站点预报提升到网格，并用多尺度空间源注意力模块融合 CAMS 数据，最终通过共享全查询读取产生一致站点和网格预测。2024 年中国 1,618 站验证显示，站点 MAE 21.14（GNN 为 22.00），CAMS MAE 降低 30%；高浓度尾部分位数 MAE 较 GNN 低 9%，沙尘事件检测能力提升。
Motivation: 化学传输模型提供网格预报但存在局部偏差，图神经网络能精确跟踪站点但无法输出连续空间场；现有方法无法同时满足站点精度与空间连续性，尤其在沙尘暴等极端事件中。
Method: 以 ConvCNP 为骨架，先用地形感知高斯卷积将 GNN 站点预报转换成规则网格特征，再用多尺度空间源注意力模块与 CAMS 网格预报混合，最后通过共享全查询读出层解码为站点或网格上的 PM10 预测，支持 108 小时预报。
Result: 在 2024 年全年中国 1,618 个站上，站点 MAE 为 21.14 µg/m³（GNN 基线 22.00），CAMS MAE 降低 30%；90% 分位数 MAE 较 GNN 低 9%、较 CAMS 低 25%；沙尘事件中分类检测技能提升且空间轨迹追踪更准确。
Conclusion: OmniPM-Net 在不牺牲站点精度的前提下实现了网格预报能力，并在高浓度尾部和沙尘场景中表现突出，但训练与推理计算开销未在摘要中讨论。

papers.title: Graph-Based Detection of Disinformation Narrative Diffusion between Russian and Ukrainian Telegram Channels
papers.abstract_en: Detecting disinformation narratives on social media is challenging due to the scale of amplification, rapid evolution, and linguistic variability of online content. We propose a graph-based framework for identifying and analyzing disinformation narratives in Telegram ecosystems by combining weak supervision with propagation graph analysis. The approach aggregates semantically related claims into narrative-level clusters and models their diffusion across interconnected channels. This enables the detection of coordinated narrative amplification that is difficult to capture through post-level analysis alone. Our results demonstrate that integrating textual signals with network structure provides a scalable method for detecting disinformation narratives and offers insights into how they propagate within large-scale messaging environments.
papers.comment: UNLP 2026 The Fifth Ukrainian Natural Language Processing Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于图的框架，结合弱监督和传播图分析，用于检测Telegram生态中的虚假信息叙事。该方法将语义相关的声明聚合为叙事级聚类，并建模其在互联频道间的扩散，从而识别难以通过帖子级分析捕捉的协调叙事放大。实验表明，整合文本信号与网络结构可提供可扩展的检测方法，并揭示虚假信息叙事在大规模消息环境中的传播模式。
Motivation: 社交媒体上虚假信息叙事的检测面临规模放大、快速演变和语言变异等挑战，现有帖子级方法难以捕捉协调叙事放大。
Method: 提出图框架：通过弱监督聚合语义相关声明为叙事级聚类，并建模其在Telegram频道间的传播图进行分析。
Result: 证明整合文本信号与网络结构可提供可扩展的虚假信息叙事检测方法，并揭示传播模式。
Conclusion: 该图框架能有效检测协调叙事放大，对理解大规模消息环境中的虚假信息传播具有意义。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: I'm Sorry, but I Can't Help with Braille: Revealing Accessibility Failures in State-of-the-Art LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform strongly on many language tasks, but their capability in structurally constrained, accessibility-critical modalities such as Braille remains unclear. We evaluate state-of-the-art LLMs on bidirectional Korean-Braille translation using a human-annotated dataset. Despite expectations that multilingual, instruction-tuned models can generalize to Braille via text representations, we find consistently poor, unstable outputs and substantial disagreement with human judgments. These results point to missing Braille-aware tokenization and weak alignment between Korean and Braille patterns. In contrast, supervised fine-tuning of a small model (T5-small) on the same data yields large and stable gains over zero-shot and prompted LLM baselines across standard metrics (SacreBLEU, ChrF++, CER, BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, CIDEr). Our findings reveal a systematic limitation of current LLMs and demonstrate the effectiveness of modest task-specific supervision.
papers.comment: Accepted at the LTEDI Workshop at ACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了最先进LLMs在韩文-盲文翻译任务上的表现，发现输出不稳定且与人类判断不一致，表明当前LLMs缺乏盲文感知的分词和对齐。而使用相同数据微调的小模型T5-small取得了稳定且显著的提升。
Motivation: 尽管LLMs在多数语言任务上表现优异，但其在盲文等结构化约束、可访问性关键模态上的能力尚不清楚。
Method: 使用人类标注数据集对最先进LLMs进行双向韩文-盲文翻译评估，并与微调的小模型T5-small对比。
Result: LLMs输出差且不稳定，与人类判断不一致；而T5-small微调后在SacreBLEU、ChrF++等多个指标上取得大幅稳定提升。
Conclusion: 当前LLMs在盲文翻译上存在系统性限制，而适度的任务特定监督（小模型微调）非常有效。

papers.title: G-SHARE: A Guideline-Based Structured Reasoning Framework for Human-Factor Event Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Human-factor event diagnosis is essential for learning from operational events in nuclear power plants, yet its quality depends strongly on expert interpretation of narrative reports and guideline-based reasoning.Existing data-driven or one-shot large language model approaches often lack structured reasoning, have limited alignment with formal diagnostic guidelines, and may generate logically inconsistent conclusions. To address this issue, this study proposes G-SHARE, a guideline-based structured reasoning framework that operationalizes the CNNP nine-step human-factor event diagnosis guideline into a multi-stage diagnostic pipeline.The framework consists of evidence extraction, stepwise diagnostic reasoning, and post-hoc consistency repair, enabling explicit use of report evidence, intermediate rationale generation, and logical validation of diagnostic outputs. A dataset of real human-factor event reports was constructed from Chinese nuclear industry sources, and a gold-standard subset annotated by domain experts was used for evaluation. Results show that G-SHARE substantially outperforms one-shot prompting and traditional machine learning baselines, with the strongest version achieving the best overall accuracy and macro-F1. Ablation results further indicate that structured reasoning and consistency enforcement are critical to robust diagnosis, especially under weak prompting conditions. The findings demonstrate the value of transforming expert diagnostic guidelines into auditable reasoning workflows, providing a practical pathway for intelligent human-factor analysis in safety-critical industries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出G-SHARE，一个基于指南的结构化推理框架，用于核电站人因事件诊断。该框架将CNNP九步人因事件诊断指南转化为多阶段诊断流水线，包括证据提取、逐步诊断推理和后验一致性修复。在中国核工业真实事件报告数据集上，G-SHARE显著优于一次性提示和传统机器学习基线，最强版本取得了最佳整体准确率和宏F1。消融实验表明结构化推理和一致性强制对鲁棒诊断至关重要。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动或大语言模型方法在人因事件诊断中缺乏结构化推理，与正式诊断指南对齐有限，且可能产生逻辑不一致的结论，影响核电站运行事件学习的质量。
Method: 提出G-SHARE框架，将CNNP九步人因事件诊断指南操作化为多阶段诊断流水线，包含证据提取、逐步诊断推理和后验一致性修复三个模块，实现报告证据的显式利用、中间推理生成和诊断输出的逻辑验证。
Result: 在中国核工业真实事件报告数据集（含专家标注的金标准子集）上，G-SHARE大幅优于一次性提示和传统机器学习基线，最强版本取得最佳整体准确率和宏F1；消融实验显示结构化推理和一致性强制对鲁棒诊断至关重要。
Conclusion: 将专家诊断指南转化为可审计的推理工作流，为安全关键行业（如核电站）的智能人因分析提供了实用路径。

summary_sections.result: 在中国核工业真实事件报告数据集（含专家标注的金标准子集）上，G-SHARE大幅优于一次性提示和传统机器学习基线，最强版本取得最佳整体准确率和宏F1；消融实验显示结构化推理和一致性强制对鲁棒诊断至关重要。
summary_sections.conclusion: 将专家诊断指南转化为可审计的推理工作流，为安全关键行业（如核电站）的智能人因分析提供了实用路径。

papers.title: CANDI: Contextual Alignment for Niche Domains Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of large language models (LLMs) in specialized domains like medical diagnostics and financial advisory necessitates evaluating capabilities beyond general knowledge. Traditional question-answering benchmarks often fail to capture the nuanced contextual grounding, user awareness, and domain understanding these fields require. To address this, we introduce CANDI-QA (Contextual Alignment for Niche Domains Question Answering), a novel dataset evaluating LLMs on delivering accurate, context-sensitive, and user-aligned answers in specialized settings. CANDI-QA features expert-curated question-answer pairs structured into two categories: (1) Information Assistance Questions, which are direct, factual queries requiring precise extraction, and (2) Applied Inference Questions, which are multi-hop reasoning tasks needing situational inference to generate actionable insights. We evaluate over ten diverse language models, from compact open-source to state-of-the-art proprietary systems. As a robust baseline, we present MTSS-Net, a lightweight neuro-symbolic framework combining neural retrieval with rule-based reasoning. Our findings highlight the profound challenges of achieving contextual alignment in niche domains, revealing the limitations of current LLMs without enhanced contextual or symbolic integration. Ultimately, CANDI-QA serves as a critical benchmark for advancing research in context-aware language models, stimulating the development of robust, trustworthy AI for high-stakes domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CANDI-QA 数据集，用于评估大语言模型在专业领域（如医疗、金融）中的上下文对齐能力。数据集包含信息辅助和应用推理两类问题，并基线方法 MTSS-Net 结合神经检索与规则推理。实验表明，当前 LLM 在领域上下文对齐上仍有显著局限。
Motivation: 现有问答基准难以捕捉专业领域所需的上下文、用户意识和领域理解，导致 LLM 在医疗诊断等高风险场景中表现不足。
Method: 构建 CANDI-QA 数据集（专家筛选的两类问答对），并提出 MTSS-Net 轻量级神经符号基线，融合神经检索与基于规则的推理。
Result: 在十多个模型上评估，发现当前 LLM 在专业领域上下文对齐方面存在重大挑战，特别是缺乏上下文或符号集成时。
Conclusion: CANDI-QA 可作为推进上下文感知语言模型研究的关键基准，促进高风险领域可信 AI 的开发。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: So Many Opinions, So Many LLMs: Comparing Large Language Models to Traditional Machine Learning for Open- Ended Survey Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Open-ended surveys offer valuable insights, but they are notoriously difficult to analyze at scale. Building on previous work that employed traditional machine learning to classify text ("So Many Responses, So Little Time: A Machine-Learning Approach to Analyzing Open-Ended Survey Data") [1], this study investigates how different large language models (LLMs) understand and analyze NSSE open-ended survey responses. We focus on several cutting-edge LLMSs-OpenAI's GPT series, Twitter-roBERTa-base model, and Meta's LLaMA-and compare their performance to the previous machine learning models in tasks like sentiment analysis and thematic classification. Our research analysis assesses model agreement, classification accuracy, and interpretability of reasoning. The findings reveal that current LLMs routinely beat classic machine learning models in classification accuracy, particularly in understanding complex mood and theme patterns in student replies. While LLMs have superior accuracy, they differ greatly in how explicitly and consistently they justify their predictions and apply category boundaries. These distinctions highlight crucial trade-offs when using LLMs for qualitative analysis: increased predictive strength comes with issues in consistency and explainability. Our findings illustrate the benefits and drawbacks of utilizing various LLMs for large-scale qualitative research, and we provide practical advice for researchers looking to balance automation and interpretive rigor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了多种大语言模型（LLM）与传统机器学习在开放调查分析中的表现，发现LLM在分类准确率上普遍优于传统方法，尤其在理解复杂情绪和主题模式方面，但LLM在预测理由的明确性和一致性上存在显著差异，揭示了准确性与可解释性之间的权衡。
Motivation: 开放调查数据难以大规模分析，传统机器学习方法存在局限性，本文旨在探索LLM能否提升分析效果。
Method: 研究比较了GPT系列、Twitter-roBERTa-base和LLaMA等LLM与传统机器学习模型在情感分析和主题分类任务上的表现，评估了模型一致性、分类准确性和推理可解释性。
Result: LLM在分类准确率上显著优于传统机器学习，尤其在复杂情绪和主题模式理解上，但LLM在预测理由的明确性和一致性上差异较大。
Conclusion: 研究表明，LLM用于大规模定性分析时，需平衡预测能力与一致性和可解释性，并为研究者提供了实用建议。

papers.title: Scaling Point-in-Time Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models trained on unrestricted internet corpora inevitably embed information from the future, introducing lookahead bias that compromises the validity of backtests and causal inference in finance and the social sciences. Point-in-time language models--trained exclusively on text available up to each calendar date--eliminate this leakage by construction, but existing efforts typically produce models that lag substantially behind their unconstrained counterparts. We show that this performance gap can be substantially narrowed through scale. Training decoder-only transformers with up to 4 billion parameters on 1 trillion chronologically filtered tokens from FineWeb, we construct a sequence of monthly model checkpoints spanning 2013-2024. Across a range of common-sense reasoning and language understanding benchmarks, our models approach the performance of leading open-weight models of comparable size (e.g., Gemma-3-4B and LLaMA-7B) trained on temporally unrestricted data, although a performance gap remains on several tasks. Instruction fine-tuning via LoRA further improves downstream usability. We release the complete pipeline--including dataset construction, training infrastructure, and evaluation code--to enable reproducible point-in-time language modeling and to support research applications that require strict temporal validity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究点时间语言模型（point-in-time language models），旨在消除训练语料中的未来信息泄漏，以避免金融和社会科学中的前视偏差。通过扩展规模（4B参数、1万亿token），作者构建了2013-2024年的月度模型检查点，在常识推理和语言理解基准上接近Gemma-3-4B和LLaMA-7B等无时间限制模型的表现，但仍存在差距。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型使用无限制互联网语料会嵌入未来信息，导致回测和因果推断失效；点时间模型能避免泄漏，但性能落后。
Method: 训练解码器-only Transformer（最高4B参数）在1万亿按时间过滤的FineWeb token上，生成2013-2024年每月检查点，并通过LoRA进行指令微调。
Result: 在多个常识推理和语言理解基准上接近但未超过同等规模的无时间限制模型（如Gemma-3-4B、LLaMA-7B）。
Conclusion: 规模扩展可缩小点时间模型与无限制模型间的性能差距，但部分任务仍有差距；作者开源完整流程以支持需要严格时间有效性的研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optimal Adaptive Market Making: A Theoretical Framework for High-Yield Liquidity Provision in Perpetual Futures Markets
papers.abstract_en: We develop a rigorous theoretical framework for optimal market making in perpetual futures markets with zero maker fees. We model the market maker's problem as a stochastic optimal control problem on a filtered probability space, where the controls are adaptive bid-ask spreads and inventory hedging decisions across two exchanges. Our contributions include: (i) a PnL decomposition theorem separating revenue into spread income, adverse selection loss, inventory carrying cost, hedging friction, and funding rate exposure; (ii) the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation for the joint spread-inventory-hedging control problem under CARA utility with a verification theorem; (iii) High-APY Regime Theorems characterizing profitable regions via five dimensionless parameters, culminating in a Master APY Formula; (iv) analysis of zero-fee economics on decentralized perpetual exchanges with optimal entry-exit thresholds; (v) optimal cross-exchange hedging policies with funding rate dynamics and a hedge regime trichotomy; (vi) a robustness margin quantifying parameter uncertainty tolerance; (vii) exponential drawdown probability bounds and a universal APY-VaR identity; (viii) ergodic inventory distribution under optimal control with Bayesian adaptive estimation; (ix) Kelly-optimal leverage with ruin boundaries; and (x) multi-pair portfolio allocation with diversification saturation results. Numerical analysis with twenty-three figures reveals phase transitions between profitable and unprofitable regimes. Our framework unifies and extends the Avellaneda-Stoikov, Gueant-Lehalle-Fernandez-Tapia, and Glosten-Milgrom paradigms for modern decentralized venue microstructure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对永续期货市场中的最优做市问题，在零maker费用环境下建立了严格的随机最优控制理论框架。作者推导了PnL分解定理、HJB方程、高APY制度定理、主APY公式等多项理论结果，并通过二十三张图的数值分析揭示了盈利与非盈利区间之间的相变。
Motivation: 现有做市理论（如Avellaneda-Stoikov、Gueant等）主要适用于传统订单簿，对于现代去中心化永续合约市场的零费用结构、跨交易所对冲、资金费率等特性缺乏统一理论框架。
Method: 将做市商问题建模为滤波概率空间上的随机最优控制问题，控制变量为自适应买卖价差和跨交易所库存对冲决策。利用CARA效用函数推导HJB方程及验证定理，引入五个无量纲参数刻画盈利区域，并导出主APY公式等多方面理论结果。
Result: 摘要报告了PnL分解、高APY制度定理、最优对冲策略的三分法、稳健性边际、指数衰减概率界、APY-VaR恒等式、遍历库存分布、Kelly最优杠杆及多资产组合分散化饱和结果等十个方面的理论贡献，并通过数值模拟展示相变行为。
Conclusion: 该框架统一并扩展了Avellaneda-Stoikov、Gueant等经典做市范式，为现代去中心化交易所微结构提供了理论基础。
Relevance: 0
